title: HakemBench: A Turkish Benchmark of Typed Decisions
comment: 9 pages including references. Data, harness, scorer and board: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ufakai/HakemBench, https://github.com/ufakai/hakembench
summary: HakemBench is a Turkish benchmark of typed decisions, in which the model under test reads a text, a question and a fixed set of options and returns a probability for every option. Version 1.0 is released fully open under CC BY 4.0, with 2,346 items and 4,275 choice, yes/no and score questions in seven tracks (fact-check triage, education, guardrails, legal routing, moderation, spam and phishing, and customer support). One harness scores decision quality (macro F1), calibration (from the normalised Brier score) and selective automation (from the normalised area under the generalised risk-coverage curve), combines them by a geometric mean and reports intervals from 2,000 bootstrap draws; probes for option order, paraphrase, English translation and substituted names are reported alongside. Most gold labels come from blind passes of one AI model family compared with the votes of a panel of large language models from other model families; they are not human-verified. On a board of 16 rows the leader scores a composite of 0.888 and the lab's own model is 7th at 0.660. Its numbers are not blind. Earlier runs' test results shaped its training data, so its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers are flagged; with every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16.

AI.tldr: HakemBench 1.0 是一个土耳其语类型化决策基准（2,346 项、4,275 道题、七条赛道），开放发布，同时给出决策质量、校准与选择性自动化的综合评分，但金标签多为AI盲测而非人工核验。
AI.motivation: 提供一个土耳其语的类型化决策评测基准，覆盖事实核查、教育、护栏、法律路由、内容审核、垃圾邮件/钓鱼和客服等实际场景，并同时衡量决策质量、概率校准与选择性自动化能力。
AI.method: 模型读取文本、问题与固定选项，输出每个选项的概率。评测框架用宏F1衡量决策质量、归一化Brier分数衡量校准、归一化广义风险-覆盖率曲线下面积衡量选择性自动化，三者取几何平均，并用2000次bootstrap给出区间；另设选项顺序、改写、英译与替换姓名等探针。多数金标签来自单一AI模型家族的盲测，并与来自其他模型家族的大模型评审团投票比对，未经人工核验。
AI.result: 16行榜单中最高综合分0.888，该实验室自身模型以0.660排第7，且其成绩非盲测；由于早期测试结果影响了其训练数据，其护栏、内容审核与客服成绩被标记。仅在其余四条赛道上对所有模型评分时，该模型综合分为0.678，在16个中排第6。
AI.conclusion: HakemBench 提供了多维度综合评分与鲁棒性探针的土耳其语决策基准；但金标签缺乏人工验证、榜单中部分模型的成绩非盲测且存在训练数据污染，其可比性与评估效度受限。

title: Finding the Move Is Not Winning the Game: XiangqiBench for Closed-Loop Evaluation of LLM Agents
summary: Static evaluations credit a language model for naming the right move, but an agent must carry a plan through to a verified outcome while an opponent responds. We introduce XiangqiBench, an executable benchmark that measures this difference in Chinese chess: starting from 119 tactical endgames with forced mates supported by engine or checks-only search, an LLM agent must deliver checkmate against an engine defender. An interactive REPL interface separates real moves, state queries, and forward simulation, and we record 8,568 multi-turn trajectories from 12 frontier LLMs under two observation protocols. Three signals that look like competence each overstate closed-loop success. (i) The Conversion Gap: models play the stored reference first move in 26.1\% of Sighted trials, yet only 13.9\% of these trials end in a win. (ii) The Consistency Gap: the leading model reaches 38.7\% pass@3 but only 5.9\% pass^3, winning all three trials on 7 of the 46 positions it ever wins. (iii) The Simulation Gap: 32.3\% of accepted simulation calls stop on an illegal move, and in 49.3\% of comparable cases the real defender replies differently from the line the agent simulated; self-authored rollouts check legality but cannot anticipate the opponent. Finding the move is not winning the game: agent evaluations should score closed-loop outcomes and report reliability alongside coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出 XiangqiBench 可执行基准，检验 LLM 在象棋中从"选对招"到"真正赢棋"的闭环差距，发现三种貌似胜任的信号均高估实际胜率。
AI.motivation: 静态评测只奖励"命名正确招法"，但真实智能体需在对手应对下把计划执行到可验证结果，两者存在本质差异。
AI.method: 构建 119 个有强制杀棋的残局，让 LLM 智能体对抗引擎防守者；用交互式 REPL 区分真实走子、状态查询与前向模拟，采集 12 个前沿 LLM 在两种观察协议下的 8,568 条多轮轨迹。
AI.result: 三个"看似胜任"信号均高估闭环成功：(i) 转化差距——26.1% 试次首步正确但仅 13.9% 获胜；(ii) 一致性差距——最佳模型 pass@3 达 38.7% 而 pass^3 仅 5.9%；(iii) 模拟差距——32.3% 被接受的模拟调用止于非法走子，49.3% 情况下真实对手回招与模拟线不符。
AI.conclusion: 找到招法不等于赢下对局；智能体评测应评分闭环结果，并将可靠性（pass^3）与覆盖率（pass@k）并列报告。

title: Counterexample Generation via Per-Theorem Symbolic Verifiers: When Imitation Hurts and Reinforcement Repairs
summary: Large language models often solve a theorem forward yet fail to disprove a closely related false one: a falsification gap that supervised fine-tuning does not close and can actively worsen. We frame counterexample generation as constrained witness emission against a deterministic per-theorem Python verifier, and release SymCE, a corpus of 4,707 false undergraduate-algebra and real-analysis conjectures, each paired with executable verifiers. The verifier also serves as the reward function, making SymCE a training environment. Training Qwen3-4B with SFT followed by GRPO under this oracle reveals an imitation trap: counterexample-only SFT collapses true-theorem recognition from 0.27 to 0.00, while RLVR with a sparse outcome-only reward repairs this and exceeds the base, to 0.66. The collapse replicates across four seeds and on Gemma-3-4B. Sparse and dense rewards yield statistically indistinguishable in-domain success yet diverge by 33 points on a held-out calibration probe, a dissociation we trace to the partial-credit term. Our 4B model outperforms every evaluated 7B open-weights math specialist, remains competitive with six frontier commercial APIs, and transfers under unchanged prompting to GSM8K, MATH-500 and MMLU-college-math. A human audit of 177 verifier decisions finds 97.7% accuracy. Code, data, verifier modules and annotations: https://github.com/ce-rlvr/SymCE.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示LLM定理证伪差距，提出SymCE基准（4707个假猜想+可执行验证器），发现SFT模仿陷阱，RLVR可修复，4B模型超越7B专家并接近商用API。
AI.motivation: LLM能正向证明定理，却无法反驳相关的假命题，形成"证伪差距"；监督微调无法弥合甚至加剧该问题，需专门环境与方法。
AI.method: 将反例生成建模为针对每个定理确定性Python验证器的受限见证生成；发布SymCE（4707个本科代数与实分析假猜想+可执行验证器），验证器兼作奖励函数。用SFT+GRPO训练Qwen3-4B，对比稀疏与稠密奖励。
AI.result: 反例-only SFT导致真定理识别从0.27崩溃至0.00（四种子及Gemma-3-4B复现），稀疏RLVR修复并升至0.66；稀疏与稠密奖励域内相当但校准探针相差33分；4B模型超越所有评测的7B开源数学专家，媲美六个前沿商用API，并迁移至GSM8K等；人工审计177项验证器决策准确率97.7%。
AI.conclusion: 约束见证生成+验证器即奖励的训练范式可有效弥合证伪差距，RLVR优于SFT，且小模型具备强泛化能力；验证器可靠，代码数据开源。

title: FinDialogLens: Event Extraction over Multi-Party Dialogue for Missed-Trade Identification in Financial Chatrooms
summary: Multi-party financial chatrooms are vital for sales-and-trading professionals, but their complexity makes manual recovery of missed trades infeasible: each Request for Quote (RFQ) is an event whose final price and trade outcome appear many messages after the RFQ-trigger message (the inquiry message), interleaved with concurrent RFQs from other participants. We cast this as event extraction (EE) over multi-party dialogue and present FinDialogLens, a hybrid LLM pipeline in which compact fine-tuned classifiers act as inference-time scaffolds: they detect RFQ-triggers and price/trade outcome metadata, an RFQ-Level Module segments per-event RFQ windows, and a Trade Engine fills argument roles. With GPT-4o, FinDialogLens reaches 92.1% and 94.3% accuracy on final price and trade outcome, respectively, outperforming full-chatroom CoT prompting methods; fine-tuned open-source LLMs with as few as 3B parameters achieve comparable performance with modest in-domain data. To make the LLM-based solution practical at scale, a difficulty-aware router balances cost and accuracy by allocating RFQs between a low-cost rule-based engine and the higher-performing LLM-powered Trade Engine, cutting LLM calls by 85% on final price while recovering half of the accuracy gap to FinDialogLens (GPT-4o), saving over $300/day at our 70,000-RFQ/day scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FinDialogLens，将多方金融聊天室中的遗漏交易恢复建模为对话事件抽取任务，用混合 LLM 流水线达到 92.1% 最终价格与 94.3% 交易结果准确率，并通过难度感知路由降低成本。
AI.motivation: 多方金融聊天室对销售交易人员至关重要，但人工恢复遗漏交易不可行：每个 RFQ 的最终价格与交易结果出现在触发消息之后很远处，且与其他参与者的并发 RFQ 交错。
AI.method: 将问题建模为多方对话上的事件抽取（EE）。FinDialogLens 采用混合 LLM 流水线，以紧凑微调分类器作为推理期脚手架：检测 RFQ 触发消息与价格/交易结果元数据，RFQ-Level Module 按事件切分 RFQ 窗口，Trade Engine 填充论元角色。另设难度感知路由器，在低成本规则引擎与 LLM Trade Engine 间分配 RFQ。
AI.result: GPT-4o 下最终价格与交易结果准确率分别为 92.1% 和 94.3%，优于全聊天室 CoT 提示方法；仅 3B 参数的微调开源 LLM 在少量领域数据下即可达到相当性能。路由器减少 85% 的 LLM 调用，同时恢复一半与 GPT-4o 的准确率差距，在每天 7 万 RFQ 规模下节省超 300 美元/天。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明将多方对话事件抽取与混合 LLM 流水线结合，可有效且经济地恢复金融聊天室中的遗漏交易，兼具高准确率与可扩展的低成本部署。

title: EditHero: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Part-Level 3D Editing and Vibe Modeling
summary: 3D editing methods are usually tested on a single edit, yet an asset is built through a long sequence of revisions, each of which must implement the requested change while leaving everything else unchanged. We introduce EditHero, to our knowledge the first benchmark for long-horizon, part-level 3D editing, with natural-language instructions and target images for both geometry and texture. A deterministic assembly engine produces the exact target after every edit, and every sequence is reviewed by hand. We use EditHero to compare 2 opposite approaches to 3D editing. Non-agentic methods operate top down, regenerating the object from a learned 3D representation and inferring what to keep. In contrast, LLM/VLM agents operate bottom up, editing through code that inspects the mesh and rewrites only the parts required by instructions. The non-agentic methods often miss the requested change and disturb regions that should stay fixed. Most LLMs follow instructions more closely, and all of them preserve the unedited parts better, but each of their edits takes minutes. We will release the engine and the edit sequences to support research on reliable iterative 3D editing.

AI.tldr: 提出EditHero，首个长程、部件级3D编辑基准，含自然语言指令与目标图像，比较非智能体方法与LLM/VLM智能体两类编辑范式。
AI.motivation: 现有3D编辑方法通常在单次编辑上测试，但真实资产由一长串修订构建而成，每次编辑都需实现目标改动同时保持其余部分不变，缺乏针对长程迭代编辑的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建EditHero基准：确定性装配引擎在每次编辑后生成精确目标，且每条序列经人工审查；据此对比两种对立方法——自上而下重新生成对象的非智能体方法，与自下而上通过代码检查网格并仅重写所需部分的LLM/VLM智能体。
AI.result: 非智能体方法常漏掉目标改动并扰动应保持不变的区域；多数LLM更严格遵循指令，且所有智能体都更好地保留未编辑部分，但每次编辑耗时数分钟。
AI.conclusion: 将发布引擎与编辑序列以支持可靠的迭代式3D编辑研究。

title: Adaptive Sparsity Optimization with Learnable Soft Top-K and Per-Term Thresholding for Efficient Retrieval
summary: Recent work on neural sparse retrieval has demonstrated strong relevance by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic term expansion. However, learned models paired with previous sparsification techniques still yield overly long document and query vectors partly due to a large LLM vocabulary, imposing a serious challenge to retrieval time and space efficiency. This paper proposes a scheme for optimizing model sparsity through a synergy of adaptive strategies, including learnable soft top-K, per-term thresholding, and FLOPs regularization to increase the sparsity of query and document vectors. Experimental results with Lion-SP model on the MS MARCO and BEIR datasets demonstrate that the proposed scheme can outperform the baselines by significantly reducing the average query and document lengths. Our scheme can achieve much shorter retrieval latency and lower storage cost while maintaining highly competitive relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过自适应策略协同优化神经稀疏检索的模型稀疏性，显著缩短查询和文档向量长度，在保持相关性的同时降低检索延迟和存储成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM语义扩展的神经稀疏检索，因LLM词表庞大，导致文档和查询向量过长，检索时间与空间效率面临严重挑战。
AI.method: 提出自适应策略协同的稀疏性优化方案，包括可学习软top-K、逐项阈值处理和FLOPs正则化，以提升查询和文档向量的稀疏度。
AI.result: 在MS MARCO和BEIR数据集上以Lion-SP模型进行实验，相比基线显著缩短平均查询和文档长度，实现更低的检索延迟和存储成本，同时保持高度竞争力相关性。
AI.conclusion: 该方案有效提升神经稀疏检索的效率，在大幅降低向量长度与成本的同时维持检索相关性。

title: SEDIMA: Cross-Run Hierarchical Insight Memory for Evolutionary Search Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolutionary search is a powerful paradigm for automated program and algorithm discovery, yet existing systems are largely memoryless: each run explores from scratch, so agents repeatedly rediscover the same improvements and re-encounter the same dead ends. We introduce SEDIMA, a persistent hierarchical insight memory for evolutionary search agents. SEDIMA distills raw traces into natural-language insights, clusters them by semantic similarity using attention-weighted centroids, and retrieves relevant guidance to condition future mutations, accumulating transferable knowledge across runs and problems rather than within a single trajectory. As a drop-in module that leaves the search operators unmodified, SEDIMA improves average final performance by 5.5% on AlgoTune and 6.6% on ALE-Bench LITE under a fixed budget of 100 evaluated candidates. Under OpenEvolve, SEDIMA requires 32.3% fewer iterations on average to reach baseline-best performance across the five evaluated backbones.

AI.tldr: SEDIMA 提出一种持久化层次化洞见记忆模块，用于LLM驱动的进化搜索，跨运行与跨问题积累可迁移知识，提升搜索效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的进化搜索系统大多无记忆，每次运行都从零开始探索，导致重复发现相同改进、重复遭遇相同死路。
AI.method: SEDIMA将原始轨迹蒸馏为自然语言洞见，用注意力加权质心按语义相似度聚类，并检索相关指导以条件化未来变异；作为即插即用模块，不修改搜索算子，实现跨运行与跨问题的知识积累。
AI.result: 在固定100个候选评估预算下，AlgoTune平均最终性能提升5.5%，ALE-Bench LITE提升6.6%；在OpenEvolve中，五个评测骨干平均需减少32.3%迭代次数即可达到基线最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: SEDIMA通过持久化层次化洞见记忆，有效提升LLM进化搜索的性能与效率，验证了跨任务知识迁移的价值。

title: SimuVerity: Benchmarking Agents for Engineering-Grade Simulink Model Generation
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SimuVerity/SimuVerity
summary: Existing Simulink benchmarks mainly evaluate whether generated models compile, execute, or resemble a reference model. These criteria do not establish whether a model satisfies its engineering requirements. We introduce SimuVerity, a benchmark of 101 text-to-executable Simulink model-generation tasks across ten engineering domains. For each task, executable-system profiles ground the engineering specification and four families of native simulation scenarios. A hierarchical evaluator first checks artifact delivery, native executability, and engineering qualification, then scores qualified models across six dimensions covering accuracy, output quality, mechanistic fidelity, control and causal integrity, operating-domain robustness, and dynamic response. We evaluate six agent systems with SimuVerity. The best system achieves an overall score of only 42.86. The results show that structural similarity is a poor proxy for engineering performance: capability bottlenecks arise both in producing qualified implementations and in satisfying multidimensional requirements after qualification. Meanwhile, some high-scoring models still exhibit severe visual-layout disorder. SimuVerity provides a systematic basis for assessing agents' engineering capabilities and diagnosing failures in executable Simulink model generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SimuVerity 基准，用 101 个文本到可执行 Simulink 模型生成任务评估代理是否满足工程需求，而非仅编译或相似度。六系统评测最高仅 42.86 分，说明结构相似度无法代表工程性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 Simulink 基准只评估模型能否编译、运行或是否近似参考模型，这些标准无法判断模型是否真正满足工程需求，因此需要面向工程正确性的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建 SimuVerity：覆盖十个工程领域的 101 个文本到可执行 Simulink 模型生成任务；每任务用可执行系统画像支撑工程规范与四类原生仿真场景；设计分层评估器，先检查产物交付、原生可执行性与工程合格性，再对合格模型从准确性、输出质量、机理保真、控制与因果完整性、工况鲁棒性、动态响应六个维度打分。
AI.result: 评测六个代理系统，最高总分仅 42.86；结构相似度是工程性能的差代理；瓶颈既在产生合格实现，也在合格后满足多维需求；部分高分模型仍存在严重视觉布局混乱。
AI.conclusion: SimuVerity 为评估代理工程能力、诊断可执行 Simulink 模型生成失败提供了系统化依据。

title: Prompt framing governs LLM default following in collective-action
summary:
Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that make or recommend decisions on behalf of users, often operating through interfaces that pre-fill suggested values or default options. Whether models treat such defaults as merely informational or as suggestions that systematically alter their choices remains unclear. We study default deference in two one-shot social dilemmas: a common-pool resource (CPR) extraction game and a threshold public-good (TPG) contribution game. We measure how defaults shift each model's choice distribution relative to its no-default baseline, across default values, wordings, and action-space granularities.
  We find that pre-filled defaults pull probability mass on the default value in both games, but the magnitude depends strongly on wording: the same model can show high pull under one formulation and near-zero pull under another. Permission-style wording reduces default pull in both games, more strongly in CPR than in TPG. Default pull is weaker in coarse action spaces, and conflict defaults attract more mass than agreement ones.
  These results indicate that default deference depends on the model, the wording of the interface, and the structure of available choices. For agentic systems, evaluating model behaviour without controlling the surrounding choice architecture can miss an important source of behavioural variation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM智能体在预填默认值下的"默认顺从"现象，发现默认值会拉动选择概率，但其幅度强烈依赖措辞、行动空间粒度和默认值类型。
AI.motivation: LLM日益作为替用户决策的智能体，界面常预填建议值或默认选项；但模型究竟把默认值视为纯信息还是系统性影响其选择的建议，尚不明确。
AI.method: 在两种一次性社会困境（公共池资源CPR开采博弈、阈值公共品TPG贡献博弈）中研究默认顺从；相对于无默认基线，测量默认值对模型选择分布的影响，变化默认值、措辞和行动空间粒度。
AI.result: 预填默认值在两种博弈中都把概率质量拉向默认值，但幅度强依赖措辞（同一模型在不同表述下可从高拉动到近零）；许可式措辞降低默认拉动，CPR中比TPG更强；粗粒度行动空间默认拉动更弱；冲突型默认值比一致型吸引更多概率质量。
AI.conclusion: 默认顺从取决于模型、界面措辞与可选行动结构；对智能体系统而言，若不控制周围的选择架构来评估模型行为，会遗漏一个重要的行为变异来源。

title: Hybrid Machine Learning-Assisted Raman Spectroscopy with Generative Feature Augmentation for Pharmaceutical Identification
summary: Rapid and reliable identification of pharmaceutical residues is important for safeguarding public health, ensuring food safety, and enabling practical Raman-based screening. In this study, we propose HyMLRaman, a hybrid Raman spectroscopy framework that combines deep spectral feature extraction, generative models, and classical machine-learning classifiers to identify six pharmaceutical compounds, including amoxicillin, chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, ibuprofen, and paracetamol. Raman spectra are converted into spectral images and encoded with several deep neural-network backbones, among which EfficientNet-B3 yields the most effective representation. The resulting 1536-dimensional embeddings are then used to train downstream classifiers, including SVM, KNN, logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and ANN, using stratified 10-fold cross-validation. The hybrid EfficientNet-B3--SVM configuration achieves the strongest baseline performance, reaching 96.31% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.36%, outperforming the standalone CNN baseline. To address limited-data conditions, a generative model, a DDPM-based feature augmentation, is introduced in a PCA-reduced EfficientNet-B3 latent space. The low-data ablation results show that DDPM augmentation provides selective benefits, particularly for KNN with reduced training fractions, and that its effect remains classifier-dependent. Finally, an application-level Raman Pharmaceutical Analyzer demonstrates the feasibility of embedding the trained model into an interactive Raman analysis workflow. These results suggest that HyMLRaman provides a practical and interpretable route for rapid Raman-based pharmaceutical screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyMLRaman混合拉曼光谱框架，结合深度特征提取、生成模型和经典机器学习分类器，用于识别六种药物残留，EfficientNet-B3+SVM达到96.31%准确率。
AI.motivation: 药物残留的快速可靠识别对公共健康、食品安全和基于拉曼的筛查至关重要，需要兼顾性能与实用性的方法。
AI.method: 将拉曼光谱转为光谱图像，用多种深度网络（EfficientNet-B3效果最佳）提取1536维嵌入，训练SVM、KNN、逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、ANN等分类器，采用分层10折交叉验证；并用DDPM在PCA降维特征空间进行数据增强。
AI.result: EfficientNet-B3+SVM取得最佳基线性能，准确率96.31%、宏F1 96.36%，优于单独CNN；DDPM增强在低数据下对KNN等有选择性收益，效果依赖分类器。
AI.conclusion: HyMLRaman为快速、可解释的拉曼药物筛查提供了实用途径，并可通过交互式分析器嵌入实际工作流。

title: MintFlow: Minimal Trajectory Intervention for Constrained Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching models excel at generative modeling, and many downstream applications require their samples to satisfy prescribed constraints, such as observed measurements and physical laws. However, existing constrained samplers often face a trade-off: \textit{enforcing constraints can substantially displace samples from the pretrained data distribution}. To address this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{MintFlow}, a training-free constrained sampling framework that formulates constraint enforcement as a minimal intervention on the pretrained flow trajectory. MintFlow seeks the minimal perturbation of an intermediate flow state such that its subsequent evolution under the pretrained flow field satisfies the target constraint. By minimally perturbing the flow state while keeping the pretrained flow field unchanged, MintFlow enforces the constraint while minimizing unnecessary deviation from the pretrained distribution. An adjoint formulation yields a closed-form expression for this perturbation, eliminating expensive iterative optimization. Furthermore, MintFlow adaptively selects the intervention time to balance the required perturbation magnitude with its amplification by the remaining flow. Across a range of tasks in generative vision and physical system modeling, MintFlow achieves competitive constraint satisfaction while preserving the pretrained generative distribution substantially better than state-of-the-art constrained methods.

AI.tldr: MintFlow是一种无需训练的约束采样框架，通过最小干预预训练流轨迹的方式，使生成样本满足约束（如观测值、物理定律），同时最大程度保留预训练数据分布。
AI.motivation: 现有约束采样器面临权衡：强制满足约束往往使样本大幅偏离预训练数据分布。需要一种既能满足约束、又能最小化分布偏移的方法。
AI.method: 将约束执行建模为对预训练流轨迹的最小干预——寻找对中间流状态的最小扰动，使其在保持预训练流场不变的情况下，后续演化满足目标约束。通过伴随（adjoint）公式得到该扰动的闭式解，避免昂贵的迭代优化；并自适应选择干预时间，以平衡所需扰动幅度与其在剩余流中的放大效应。
AI.result: 在生成视觉与物理系统建模的多项任务中，MintFlow在约束满足方面具有竞争力，且相比最先进的约束方法，能显著更好地保留预训练生成分布。
AI.conclusion: MintFlow作为无需训练的约束采样方法，通过最小扰动流状态实现了约束满足与分布保真度的良好平衡，优于现有SOTA约束采样方法。

title: From Expression to Reaction: Role-aware Visual Transfer and Stimulus-guided Reasoning for Interlocutor Emotion Recognition
comment: Technical report of the second-place solution in Track 1 (MER-Cross) of the MER Grand Challenge at ACM MM 2026
summary: In this paper, we propose a Role-aware Stimulus-guided (RASG) framework for interlocutor emotion recognition, which predicts listener emotions from listener-only videos and speaker-only audios. RASG consists of Role-aware Visual Transfer (RVT) and Stimulus-guided Boundary Reasoning (SBR) modules, which address supervision mismatch due to the lack of labeled listener data and ambiguity among visually similar listener reactions whose interpretation depends on speaker context, respectively. More specifically, RVT selects speaker samples whose facial expressions support their emotion labels. It then filters listener tracks and uses reliable pseudo-labels to train a listener-centric visual expert. SBR uses a two-class language reasoner only when the visual model is uncertain. It treats speaker audio and text as context rather than direct emotion evidence to distinguish similar listener reactions. Experiments conducted on MER-Cross dataset shows that RASG achieves 76.25\% on MER-Cross and improves the performance of the baseline over 17\%. Our team ranks second in Track 1 (MER-Cross) of the MER Grand Challenge at ACM MM 2026.

AI.tldr: 提出RASG框架，用于对话者情绪识别，从仅含听众的视频和仅含说话者的音频预测听众情绪，在MER-Cross上达76.25%，比基线提升超17%。
AI.motivation: 听众情绪识别面临两个问题：缺乏标注的听众数据导致监督不匹配，以及视觉上相似的听众反应存在歧义（需依赖说话者上下文理解）。
AI.method: RASG含两模块：RVT（角色感知视觉迁移）选取面部表情与情绪标签一致的说话者样本，过滤听众轨迹并用可靠伪标签训练以听众为中心的视觉专家；SBR（刺激引导边界推理）仅在视觉模型不确定时启用二分类语言推理器，将说话者音频与文本作为上下文而非直接情绪证据来区分相似听众反应。
AI.result: 在MER-Cross数据集上达76.25%，比基线提升超17%；在ACM MM 2026 MER Grand Challenge Track 1中排名第二。
AI.conclusion: RASG有效解决听众情绪识别中的监督不匹配与反应歧义问题，通过角色迁移和上下文引导推理显著提升性能，并在挑战赛中取得领先成绩。

title: CUEing User Simulators: Calibrated User Embeddings for Multi-Turn Benchmarking
summary: Recent benchmarks rely on user simulators to evaluate AI agents in multi-turn interaction. While existing simulation techniques demonstrate surface fidelity to human style and behavior, ecologically valid interactive benchmarking also requires alignment in when and how agents fail across simulated and real user populations. We find that existing simulators lack outcome calibration: agreement with observed success rates and failure patterns when real users interact with the same agent. We introduce Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE), a framework that both encodes observed sessions and samples continuous representations, then decodes them into persona commands to steer LLMs to act as user simulators without training. Through this, we evaluate user-conditioned replay of past sessions and aggregate metric agreement when sampling novel personas for the same tasks. On $τ^2$-Bench, CUEd simulators commit fewer simulator-attributed errors and more faithfully reproduce real-user agent failure modes, aggregate success rates, and outcomes for specific task-user pairs than other persona-based simulation methods. These gains coexist with competitive user fidelity as measured using metrics established in prior work. After being fit to mostly customer support interactions, the same CUEd simulators generalize to document creation, math tutoring, and casual conversation, and remain effective across different simulator LLMs without CUE retraining.

AI.tldr: 现有用户模拟器缺乏"结果校准"——与真实用户交互时的成功率及失败模式不一致。本文提出 Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE) 框架，将观测会话编码为连续表示再解码为 persona 指令来引导 LLM 模拟用户，无需训练。在 τ²-Bench 上，CUE 模拟器产生更少模拟器归因错误，更忠实复现真实用户的失败模式与成功率，同时在既有用户保真度指标上保持竞争力，并可泛化到文档创作、数学辅导等任务及不同 LLM。
AI.motivation: 多轮交互 AI agent 评测依赖用户模拟器，但现有技术在表层风格/行为上虽像人，却缺乏"结果校准"：模拟器下 agent 的成功率和失败模式与真实用户群体不一致，导致评测的生态效度不足。
AI.method: 提出 Calibrated User Embeddings (CUE)：先编码观测到的真实会话，采样连续表示，再解码为 persona 命令(commands)来引导 LLM 充当用户模拟器，全程无需训练。通过用户条件回放已见会话，以及为同一任务采样新 persona 来评估聚合指标一致性。
AI.result: 在 τ²-Bench 上，CUEd 模拟器模拟器归因错误更少，更忠实复现真实用户的 agent 失败模式、聚合成功率及特定任务-用户对结果，优于其他 persona 方法；用户保真度指标保持竞争力。主要拟合客服交互后，可泛化到文档创作、数学辅导和日常对话，且跨不同模拟器 LLM 无需重训仍有效。
AI.conclusion: CUE 为多轮交互评测提供了具备结果校准的用户模拟方法，兼顾真实用户复现能力与泛化性，可跨任务、跨 LLM 应用。

title: DeskForge: Dense Supervision from Desktop Environments for Computer-Use Agents
comment: 37 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/
summary: Computer-use agents need to reliably ground action targets in complex desktop scenes, where multiple applications, overlapping windows, and visually similar controls compete for attention. Existing training data rarely pair such scenes with dense annotations or vary them in a controlled way. We introduce DeskForge, a controllable desktop environment that composes and explores real applications to generate large-scale supervision for computer-use agents. It varies application states, content, window layout, appearance, and resolution, and fuses screenshots, accessibility trees, and window geometry into dense element annotations while recording the outcome of each executed action. Using this environment, we construct DeskForge-1M, a corpus of 1.2M annotated desktop observations containing 159.7M element instances. We fine-tune four vision-language models on 200K grounding examples drawn from DeskForge-1M. All four improve across held-out desktop conditions and on all five external GUI grounding benchmarks; for Qwen3.5-4B, accuracy increases by 11.51 percentage points on ScreenSpot-Pro and 10.11 points on OSWorld-G. The gains also translate to long-horizon task completion: under a fixed planner, the fine-tuned action models solve more WebArena-Infinity and OpenApps tasks, with Qwen3.5-4B increasing from 31 to 50 of 119 tasks and from 3 to 15 of 100 tasks, respectively. These results show that controllable composition of real desktop environments provides a scalable source of supervision for improving both GUI grounding and long-horizon computer use. The framework code, the dataset, and the fine-tuned model are available from the project page: https://saidgurbuz.github.io/deskforge/

AI.tldr: 提出 DeskForge 可控桌面环境，自动组合真实应用生成大规模标注数据 DeskForge-1M，微调四个 VLM 显著提升 GUI grounding 与长程任务完成能力。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体需在复杂桌面场景中可靠定位操作目标，但现有训练数据很少将此类场景与密集标注配对，也缺乏可控的变化方式。
AI.method: 构建可控桌面环境 DeskForge，变化应用状态、内容、窗口布局、外观与分辨率，融合截图、无障碍树与窗口几何生成密集元素标注并记录动作结果；据此构建含 120 万条观测、1.597 亿元素实例的 DeskForge-1M，并用其中 20 万条 grounding 样本微调四个 VLM。
AI.result: 四个模型在留出桌面条件及五个外部 GUI grounding 基准上均提升；Qwen3.5-4B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 提升 11.51 个百分点、OSWorld-G 提升 10.11 点；固定规划器下 WebArena-Infinity 从 31/119 增至 50/119，OpenApps 从 3/100 增至 15/100。
AI.conclusion: 可控地组合真实桌面环境可为提升 GUI grounding 与长程计算机使用提供可扩展的监督来源；代码、数据集与微调模型已开源。

title: When History Misleads: Asymmetric Margin Supervision for Instruction-Guided LLM Generative Recommendation
summary: In instruction-guided generative recommendation, LLM-based recommenders need to balance two goals: responding to the user's current request and aligning with the preferences in their interaction history. When the two conflict, history events can override the request. We show that turning the effect of individual history events into supervision faces two obstacles. First, the events that most influence a recommendation are not necessarily the ones that support the target item. Second, removing a misleading event can raise the target's score but a competing item's score even more, so a higher target score alone does not guarantee a better ranking. We propose Asymmetric Intervention-Guided Margin Supervision (AIMS), which converts the effect of removing individual history events into ranking supervision. For training requests already ranked correctly, a frozen reference model identifies request-specific deletions that improve both the target's score and its margin over a competitor near the recommendation cutoff. These margins serve as training targets, while the complete history is retained as input. Training combines cross-entropy with an asymmetric auxiliary loss that penalizes margin shortfalls and routes its gradient only through the competitor score. Inference is unchanged, requiring no history editing or deletion search. Across six LLM backbones on an industrial dataset and two public benchmarks, AIMS improves Recall and NDCG over strong baselines. Ablations support request-specific margins and asymmetric supervision, and the selected deletions preferentially remove constraint-violating history.

AI.tldr: 提出AIMS方法，将移除历史事件的影响转化为排序监督，解决指令引导推荐中请求与历史冲突问题。
AI.motivation: LLM推荐需平衡用户当前请求与历史偏好，二者冲突时历史会覆盖请求。利用单个历史事件影响做监督面临两个障碍：影响最大的事件未必支持目标物品；移除误导事件虽提升目标分数，但竞争者分数提升更多，故目标分数提升不等于排序更好。
AI.method: AIMS将移除单个历史事件的效应转化为排序监督。对已正确排序的训练请求，用冻结参考模型找出能同时提升目标分数及其对截断点附近竞争者margin的请求特定删除。这些margin作为训练目标，完整历史仍作输入。训练结合交叉熵与非对称辅助损失，惩罚margin不足且梯度仅通过竞争者分数回传。推理不变，无需编辑或搜索删除。
AI.result: 在工业数据集和两个公开基准上，跨六个LLM骨干，AIMS在Recall和NDCG上优于强基线。消融支持请求特定margin与非对称监督，所选删除优先移除违反约束的历史。
AI.conclusion: AIMS通过非对称干预引导的margin监督有效提升排序性能，且推理零改动，验证了请求特定margin监督的有效性。

title: Evolutionary Computation for Trustworthy AI: From Attacks and Defenses to Self-Evolving Era
summary: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) has evolved from task-specific models to foundation models and agents, the scope of trustworthy AI has expanded from model-level robustness to the reliability and safety of broader AI systems. This evolution has also expanded the attack surface from individual models to broader system-level interactions, including tool use, context, and interaction trajectories with dynamic environments. As a result, maintaining reliable and safe behavior under changing or deliberately manipulated conditions has become increasingly challenging. The search for effective attacks and defenses often relies on black-box feedback to navigate discrete choices among words, actions, system components, or their combinations. Multiple objectives and expensive candidate evaluations further limit what can be explored. Evolutionary Computation (EC), with its population-based, gradient-free search and flexible variation and selection mechanisms, is well suited to these settings. This survey reviews how EC has been applied to trustworthy AI across three directions: evolutionary attacks, evolutionary defenses, and trustworthy self-evolving AI systems. Unlike prior reviews that treat trustworthy AI, EC, and self-evolving systems largely separately, we connect these lines through a common evolutionary perspective. For self-evolving AI, we examine how trustworthiness governs the generation and retention of updates that shape subsequent adaptation. We further synthesize evaluation methods and benchmark resources from both trustworthiness and evolutionary-search perspectives. Finally, we discuss key challenges and future research directions toward more effective and reliable use of EC in trustworthy AI.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了进化计算（EC）如何应用于可信AI的三个方向：进化攻击、进化防御和可信自演化AI系统，并以共同的进化视角将此前分散研究的领域联系起来。
AI.motivation: AI从任务专用模型发展到基础模型与智能体，可信AI的范围从模型级鲁棒性扩展到整个AI系统的可靠性与安全性，攻击面也随之扩大（工具使用、上下文、与环境交互的轨迹）。在动态或被恶意操纵条件下维持可靠安全行为日益困难；寻找有效攻击与防御常依赖黑盒反馈在离散选择（词、动作、系统组件及其组合）中搜索，加上多目标与高昂的候选评估成本，限制了可探索空间。EC的群体式、无梯度搜索及灵活的变异与选择机制恰好适合此类场景。
AI.method: 采用综述方式，建立统一的进化视角来串联三条研究线索：进化攻击、进化防御、可信自演化AI系统；针对自演化AI，考察可信性如何约束更新（updates）的生成与保留，从而影响后续适应过程；并从可信性与进化搜索双重视角综合评估方法与基准资源。
AI.result: 提出了一个将可信AI、EC与自演化系统三者贯通的共同进化框架，梳理了三类应用方向的研究现状，汇总了可信性与进化搜索两个角度的评估方法与基准资源，并指出关键挑战与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: EC在可信AI中具有广阔应用前景，今后的研究应致力于更有效、更可靠地发挥EC作用，推动可信AI与自演化系统的协同发展。

title: Compound AI System Reliability: A Failure Taxonomy and Resilience Pattern Catalog from 150 Production Incidents
comment: Accepted at the AIWILD Workshop, ICML 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Deploying compound AI systems reliably and safely requires understanding failure modes that emerge at component boundaries, not within individual models. Cascading errors propagate across component boundaries, silent quality degradation evades standard monitoring, and coordination failures yield incorrect collective behavior from individually correct parts. We analyze 150 production incident reports from open-source compound AI projects and anonymized enterprise deployments to construct a taxonomy of 23 failure modes organized into five categories: retrieval failures, generation failures, tool failures, orchestration failures, and integration failures. For each category, we propose resilience patterns with measured effectiveness from controlled fault injection experiments. Circuit breakers reduce cascade propagation by 89%, output quality gates catch 73% of silent degradation before user impact, and component isolation reduces blast radius by 64%. Systems implementing three or more resilience patterns from our catalog reduce mean-time-to-recovery (MTTR) by 71% compared to unstructured monitoring baselines. We release the incident taxonomy and pattern catalog as a practitioner resource.

AI.tldr: 论文分析150个复合AI系统生产事故报告，构建包含23种失效模式的分类法（分五大类），并提出韧性模式，实验证明可显著降低级联传播、静默退化与故障影响，并缩短MTTR。
AI.motivation: 复合AI系统的可靠性安全部署需理解组件边界处涌现的失效模式，而非单模型内部；级联错误、静默质量退化和协调失败等边界问题难以被标准监控发现。
AI.method: 分析150个来自开源复合AI项目及匿名企业部署的生产事故报告，构建23种失效模式分类法（检索、生成、工具、编排、集成五类）；针对每类提出韧性模式，并通过受控故障注入实验测量其有效性。
AI.result: 断路器将级联传播降低89%；输出质量门在用户受影响前捕获73%的静默退化；组件隔离将爆炸半径降低64%；采用三种及以上韧性模式的系统相比无结构监控基线，MTTR降低71%。
AI.conclusion: 论文发布事故分类法与韧性模式目录作为实践者资源，为复合AI系统的可靠部署提供指导。

title: Normal-Form Correlation in Markov Games
summary:
There has been a surge of recent work on correlated equilibrium concepts in Markov games. However, existing results focus on concepts weaker than normal-form correlated equilibria (NFCEs), leaving open the more challenging question of computing such equilibria, which goes back to the seminal work of Papadimitriou and Roughgarden (JACM'08). Here, we establish the first efficient algorithm for NFCEs in finite-horizon Markov games with a fixed number of players $n$. In particular, with $S$ states, horizon $H$, and at most $A$ actions per player, it computes an $ε$-NFCE in time $S(AH/ε)^{O(n)}$. This is the first algorithm polynomial in $1/ε$ and the description of the game for NFCEs in an interesting class of problems beyond the normal-form setting. Moreover, under the usual assumption that recommendations are independent across states, we show PPAD-completeness---that is, computational equivalence to Nash equilibria---either in many-player games or when the precision is exponentially small.
  The key idea behind our approach is to run backward induction on a sequence of auxiliary stage games, but with the twist that in each step we compute a constant-expectation correlated equilibrium. This is a natural refinement of correlated equilibrium in which the conditional expected payoff from obeying is independent of the recommendation. In fact, our reduction goes both ways, establishing an equivalence between constant-expectation CEs and NFCEs in Markov games. For a fixed number of players, we observe that a constant-expectation CE can be computed approximately by combining linear programming with suitable discretization. In contrast, it is PPAD-hard in i) polymatrix (many-player) games at constant precision, and ii) two-player games at exponentially small precision. The latter result follows from an unexpected connection to rank-2 two-player games.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次为有限时域Markov博弈中的正规型相关均衡（NFCE）给出高效算法，并提出"常数期望相关均衡"作为核心工具，同时在特定假设下证明PPAD完全性。
AI.motivation: 已有关于Markov博弈相关均衡概念的工作仅限于比NFCE更弱的概念，而计算NFCE这一更具挑战性的问题自Papadimitriou和Roughgarden（JACM'08）的开创性工作以来一直悬而未决。
AI.method: 对一系列辅助阶段博弈进行反向归纳，每一步计算"常数期望相关均衡"（服从推荐的条件下期望收益与推荐无关）；对固定玩家数，结合线性规划与合适的离散化近似求解该均衡。
AI.result: 对n个玩家、S个状态、时域H、每人至多A个动作的博弈，可在S(AH/ε)^{O(n)}时间内计算ε-NFCE，这是首个对1/ε和博弈描述多项式时间的NFCE算法；在推荐跨状态独立的假设下，证明该问题PPAD完全（多玩家或精度指数小时）；常数期望CE与NFCE之间建立了双向归约等价关系。
AI.conclusion: 常数期望CE与Markov博弈中的NFCE等价；其在固定玩家数下可近似高效计算，而在多玩家多项式矩阵博弈（常数精度）和两人博弈（指数小精度）中是PPAD难的，后者源于与秩2两人博弈的意外联系。

title: The Price of Greenwashing: Algorithmic Verification and Market Discipline using Conformal Machine Learning
summary: While corporate sustainability mandates are expanding, the systemic reliance on self-reported emissions data exposes financial markets to pervasive greenwashing. Current literature relies heavily on subjective ESG ratings or textual sentiment analysis, leaving a critical econometric gap in objectively quantifying physical climate realities. To resolve this information asymmetry, we fuse U.S. SEC financial fundamentals with facility-level EPA greenhouse gas registries to establish a mathematically guaranteed baseline of physical corporate emissions. Leveraging a gradient boosting architecture and Mondrian Conformal Prediction, we quantify the shortfall between self-reported data and this algorithmic baseline into a novel Conformal-Weighted Continuous Divergence (CWCD) metric. Evaluating this divergence via a cross-sectional lead-lag econometric design, we uncover a robust mechanism of market discipline: algorithmic emissions divergence exhibits a severe, statistically significant negative relationship with subsequent market valuation (Tobin's Q) and operational profitability (ROA). Providing definitive evidence against the market blindness hypothesis, this study proves that institutional capital actively prices environmental deception not merely as an ethical lapse, but as a leading indicator of fundamental corporate mismanagement. Ultimately, these findings provide the quantitative justification necessary for asset managers and regulators to deploy algorithmic auditing infrastructure at scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过融合SEC财务数据与EPA设施级排放数据，用梯度提升和Mondrian保形预测构建"保形加权连续背离(CWCD)"指标量化企业绿漂，发现算法排放背离与后续市场估值及盈利显著负相关，证明机构资本会对环境欺骗定价。
AI.motivation: 企业可持续性强制披露扩张，但依赖自报排放数据导致金融市场面临普遍绿漂风险；现有文献依赖主观ESG评级或文本情感分析，缺少客观量化物理气候现实的计量经济学方法。
AI.method: 融合美国SEC财务基本面与EPA设施级温室气体登记数据，建立有数学保证的物理排放基线；采用梯度提升架构与Mondrian保形预测，将自报数据与算法基线的缺口量化为CWCD指标；再用横截面领先-滞后计量设计评估该背离。
AI.result: 算法排放背离与后续市场估值(Tobin's Q)和运营盈利能力(ROA)呈显著、统计上稳健的负相关，反驳市场盲视假说。
AI.conclusion: 机构资本将环境欺骗定价为根本性公司管理不善的领先指标而非单纯伦理失误；为资产管理者和监管者大规模部署算法审计基础设施提供了量化依据。

title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.

AI.tldr: 本文对开源(Laya)与托管(Jev)两种System-1决策模型在11个智能体决策点上进行配对评测，发现Jev在9个点上显著更优，但两者在模型路由上都不及随机，并审计出自身流水线中的三处分析错误与一处设计混淆。
AI.motivation: System-1决策模型以单次前向传播给出类别概率，理论上相比LLM调用能大幅节省成本与延迟，但其在真实智能体决策任务上的可靠性缺乏严格的配对评测，尤其是鲁棒性与可复现性方面。
AI.method: 构建11个决策点、来自18个公开数据源的评测集（7,283基础案例+6,640鲁棒性变体），采用字节一致输入、配对检验，并进行跨硬件与跨天复现性检查，对比Laya与Jev两个System-1模型。
AI.result: Jev在9/11决策点上显著更准（+10.8至+46.0个百分点）；两者在零样本模型路由上均未超过随机，在RAG相关性门控上持平；Laya在选项顺序反转时改变30%答案，且随候选数量增多或相似度提高而急剧退化（50个近邻工具时仅31%，Jev在唯一正确工具项上为98%）。
AI.conclusion: System-1模型可用于部分决策点但鲁棒性堪忧；作者审计发现三处分析错误和一处设计混淆曾夸大部署收益（如省略预筛成本使节省从4.3%误报为23.9%，门控精度被当作端到端质量等），强调严谨评测与自查的必要性，并公开全部数据与代码。

title: Low-Cost Video--Time Priors as a Strong Baseline for EEG--fNIRS Emotion Regression on Familiar Videos
summary: Continuous emotion regression estimates moment-to-moment valence and arousal while a viewer watches a video. In familiar-video deployment, responses fron training participant-specific estimate, and prior-dominating fixed fusion tests whether physiology adds residual correction. In five-fold subject-held-out evaluation on 24was within 0.05 and 0.32 MAE of fusion in the internal and external evaluations, respectively. Source-explicit ablations showed that video identity and within-video tine accounted for most of the reduction, while EG-FNIRS gains were smaller and varied across participants and videos. These results identify the video-time prior as a strong, low-cost baseline and position EEG-fNIRS as an optional residual signal for familiar-video emotion regression.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究连续情绪回归（valence与arousal），提出以"视频-时间先验"作为强基线，并将EEG-fNIRS定位为可选的残差校正信号。
AI.motivation: 在熟悉视频场景中，训练参与者特定的反应本身就能很好地估计情绪；需要检验生理信号是否能在此先验之上提供额外的残差校正。
AI.method: 采用先前支配的固定融合策略；在24名被试上进行五折、subject-held-out评估；并做来源显式消融，分析视频身份、视频内时间与EEG-fNIRS的贡献。
AI.result: 融合与基线的MAE差距在内部评估约0.05、外部评估约0.32以内；消融显示视频身份与视频内时间贡献了大部分性能提升，而EEG-fNIRS增益较小且跨被试和视频差异较大。
AI.conclusion: 视频-时间先验是强且低成本的基线，EEG-fNIRS可作为熟悉视频情绪回归的可选残差信号。

title: APDMem: Agent-Controlled Progressive Disclosure for Query-Adaptive Long-Term Memory
summary: Personalized LLM assistants must recover sparse evidence from long conversation histories across queries of varying complexity. We introduce APDMem (Agent-controlled Progressive Disclosure Memory), a hierarchical long-term memory architecture that applies progressive disclosure to memory retrieval. Rather than relying on a flat memory store or fixed retrieval granularity, APDMem represents conversation history as four progressively detailed layers: thematic summaries, personalized key facts, turn-level evidence notes, and raw messages. At inference time, a controller applies progressive disclosure to the memory hierarchy: it first reads high-level summaries and drills into finer evidence only when needed. This creates an adaptive cost-fidelity trade-off: simple queries can terminate early, while complex temporal, multi-hop, or exact-evidence queries trigger deeper inspection. A note synthesizer converts retrieved evidence into a query-focused structure that consolidates facts, orders events, and flags contradictions before final answer generation. Experiments on LongMemEval show that APDMem achieves strong performance for long-context memory reasoning while accessing only 8% of the total conversations.

AI.tldr: APDMem 提出一种分层长期记忆架构，通过渐进式披露在对话历史中自适应检索稀疏证据，仅访问8%对话即可在 LongMemEval 上实现强性能。
AI.motivation: 个性化 LLM 助手需从长对话历史中恢复稀疏证据，且查询复杂度各异。扁平记忆存储或固定检索粒度难以兼顾成本与保真度。
AI.method: 将对话历史表示为四层渐进细化结构：主题摘要、个性化关键事实、轮次级证据笔记、原始消息；推理时由控制器先读高层摘要，按需下钻至更细证据，实现自适应成本-保真度权衡；笔记合成器将检索证据转为查询导向结构，整合事实、排序事件并标记矛盾。
AI.result: 在 LongMemEval 上实现长上下文记忆推理的强性能，同时仅访问全部对话的8%。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式披露的记忆层级能在保持推理质量的同时显著降低检索成本，适合长对话历史下的个性化助手。

title: SCION: Scene Composition with Instanced Neural Primitives
summary: Real-world scenes are compositional: bricks, blades of grass, pebbles, and tree leaves recur across human-built and natural environments. Existing neural scene representations model these elements independently. Most 3D Gaussian Splatting and follow-up abstraction and compression methods treat each element as unique, fitting millions of independent Gaussians per scene. Prior methods like Splat and Replace fit template objects, but they require mostly manual selection of repeated elements. As a result, these representations store redundant parameters and provide weak manipulation handles for downstream tasks. We introduce SCION, a hier- archical compositional scene representation that replaces independent Gaussians with a compact vocabulary of reusable primitives and lightweight world-space instances that place transformed copies throughout the scene. We fit this represen- tation to multi-view captures via a joint optimization over discrete and continuous scene parameters, combining two-level densification over splats and instances with an adversarial loss that preserves detail across shared primitives. The recovered structure yields a compact, controllable representation while maintaining high quality even at 1.2 MB. SCION achieves rate-distortion favorable to existing Gaussian compression methods, and it enables instance-level scene editing and animation without retraining. Our results show that neural scene representations need not memorize scenes as independent primitives; they can discover reusable parts. Project webpage: https://light.princeton.edu/SCION

AI.tldr: SCION 提出层次化组合式场景表示，用可复用图元词汇表和世界空间实例替换独立高斯的冗余，实现紧凑可控的高质量场景建模。
AI.motivation: 现实场景具有组合性（砖块、草叶、卵石、树叶等元素反复出现），但现有 3D Gaussian Splatting 及其后续抽象/压缩方法将每个元素视为独特个体，为每个场景拟合数百万独立高斯，导致参数冗余、操作能力弱；Splat and Replace 等方法虽拟合模板对象，却需大量人工选择重复元素。
AI.method: 用可复用图元的紧凑词汇表 + 轻量世界空间实例（放置变换后的副本）替代独立高斯；通过离散与连续场景参数的联合优化拟合多视图捕获，结合图元与实例的两级致密化，以及维护共享图元细节的对抗损失。
AI.result: 在 1.2 MB 下仍保持高质量；率失真性能优于现有高斯压缩方法；支持无需重训练的实例级场景编辑与动画。
AI.conclusion: 神经场景表示无需将场景记忆为独立图元，而可以发现可复用部件，从而获得紧凑且可控的表示。

title: Learning Query Encoders Can Be Hard Even When Vector Retrieval Is Geometrically Easy
summary:
Efficient vector retrieval requires both a corpus geometry that supports retrieving the right documents through vector similarity, and a query encoder that can embed queries near their desired documents in the embedding space. Recent work has studied geometric capacity through the lens of the minimum embedding dimension needed to realize all top-$k$ answer sets of $n$ documents. We study a different notion of geometric capacity--the maximum recall achievable for a frozen document index--and explore whether learned query encoders can reach this ceiling. On several real-world retrieval benchmarks, we show that retrieval quality of single-vector query encoders often lies far below what the document indices can support.
  Motivated by this observation, we give theoretical evidence that learning query encoders can be computationally hard. In particular, we construct a retrieval task that (1) admits a query encoder with perfect recall which is representable by a small one-hidden-layer ReLU network, but (2) any statistical-query learner (a class capturing learners that access training data through aggregate statistics) provably requires exponentially many statistical queries to achieve non-trivial recall advantage over the random baseline $k/n$. Taken together, our results suggest substantial unrealized geometric capacity in retrieval benchmarks and establish query encoder learnability as a possible barrier in embedding-based retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索中的"几何容量"新概念——冻结文档索引下可达的最大召回率，并探究学习式查询编码器能否达到该上限。
AI.motivation: 高效向量检索需要文档语料几何支持相似检索，同时查询编码器能将查询嵌入到目标文档附近。已有工作从最小嵌入维度研究几何容量，本文关注冻结文档索引可达的最大召回率这一不同视角。
AI.method: 在多个真实检索基准上测量单向量查询编码器的召回率与文档索引可支持上限之间的差距；并通过构造检索任务进行理论分析，证明学习查询编码器在统计查询（SQ）框架下是计算困难的。
AI.result: 实验表明单向量查询编码器的检索质量常远低于文档索引能支持的水平；理论上构造出一个任务：存在完美召回的、可由小型单隐层ReLU网络表示的查询编码器，但任何统计查询学习器都需要指数级多的查询才能超过随机基线 k/n 获得非平凡召回优势。
AI.conclusion: 检索基准中存在大量未实现的几何容量，查询编码器的可学习性可能是基于嵌入检索的一个障碍。

title: Small universal multiset reaction systems
summary: This paper presents a construction of a small universal machine within the framework of Multi-set Reaction Systems. We encode the machine state using elements that represent registers and instruction labels, and we enforce sequential execution by ensuring that reaction chains for a given instruction can only activate after the corresponding label element appears. We implement a universal register machine with 8 registers and 23 instructions, showing that the priority-based model requires 87 distinct elements. The results demonstrate that multiset reaction systems are capable of simulating universal computation.

AI.tldr: 在Multi-set Reaction Systems框架下构造了一台小型通用机器，用87个元素实现含8寄存器和23条指令的通用寄存器机，证明其具备通用计算能力。
AI.motivation: 探索Multi-set Reaction Systems是否具备模拟通用计算的能力，并给出一个小型通用机器的构造。
AI.method: 用表示寄存器和指令标签的元素编码机器状态；通过使某条指令的反应链只有在其对应标签元素出现后才能激活，来强制顺序执行；采用基于优先级的模型构造通用寄存器机（8寄存器、23指令）。
AI.result: 基于优先级的模型需要87个不同元素，成功实现含8寄存器、23指令的通用寄存器机。
AI.conclusion: Multi-set Reaction Systems能够模拟通用计算。

title: An Extensive Empirical Study on Evaluation Metrics for Combinatorial Interaction Testing
summary: Combinatorial interaction testing (CIT) is a black-box testing method that has received extensive attention in both research and practice over recent years. Its primary objective is to construct an effective combinatorial test suite that detects software failures caused by parameter interactions. As a fundamental component of the CIT testing process, the evaluation metric plays a critical role in assessing and comparing combinatorial test suites, as well as in evaluating various test generation techniques. For CIT practitioners, selecting an appropriate evaluation metric is both important and challenging, given the wide variety of available options. Nevertheless, no prior work has systematically addressed this problem. To fill this gap, this paper first provides a comprehensive survey of black-box evaluation metrics for combinatorial test suites, offering rigorous definitions, clear classifications, illustrative examples, and complexity analyses. We then conduct an extensive empirical study involving eight open-source projects, encompassing 32 test scenarios and 295,624 combinatorial test suites. In this study, we examine the correlation between each static evaluation metric and fault-detection effectiveness using two correlation measures. Experimental results show that the Value Combination Coverage (VCC) metric serves as a valid predictor for test-suite evaluation. However, distribution-based metrics generally incur lower computational costs than interaction coverage-based ones. The choice of an appropriate metric should also account for the test suite's inherent properties, as these characteristics can substantially influence the effectiveness of the evaluation. Finally, we provide practical guidelines to assist CIT practitioners in selecting suitable evaluation metrics for assessing or comparing combinatorial test suites.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统综述了组合测试套件的黑盒评估指标，并通过大规模实证研究分析了各静态指标与故障检测效果的相关性，为CIT实践者选择合适指标提供指南。
AI.motivation: 组合交互测试(CIT)中，评估指标是评估和比较组合测试套件、评价测试生成技术的核心组成部分。但由于可用指标种类繁多，实践者难以选择合适的评估指标，而此前尚无工作系统性地解决这一问题。
AI.method: 首先对组合测试套件的黑盒评估指标进行全面综述，提供严格定义、清晰分类、示例说明和复杂度分析；随后基于8个开源项目、32个测试场景、295,624个组合测试套件开展大规模实证研究，使用两种相关性度量考察每个静态评估指标与故障检测效果之间的相关性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：值组合覆盖(VCC)指标可作为测试套件评估的有效预测因子；基于分布的指标通常比基于交互覆盖的指标计算成本更低；合适指标的选择还需考虑测试套件本身的固有属性，因为这些特性会显著影响评估的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了实用指南，帮助CIT实践者在评估或比较组合测试套件时选择合适的评估指标。

title: Single-Sample Prophet Inequalities: A Combinatorial to Single-Item Reduction
summary: We study single-sample prophet inequalities for online combinatorial allocation. Our main contribution is a general reduction from combinatorial to single-item prophet inequalities for valuation classes admitting suitable supporting prices. The reduction uses a free-disposal value to separate buyer-side combinatorial constraints from item-side supply constraints, yielding a modular framework that applies in the stronger Game of Googol model. This framework yields a $\frac{1}{6\sqrt{3}}\approx\frac{1}{10.4}$-competitive single-sample prophet inequality and a $(β_{k-1}/4)$-competitive $k$-sample prophet inequality for XOS valuations, where $β_k$ is the competitive ratio of a $k$-sample single-item prophet inequality, improving upon the work of [DKL+24]. Both results extend directly to divisible resources with capped-XOS valuations. Along the way, we obtain new results for online free disposal and an optimal single-sample prophet inequality for fractional knapsack in the Game of Googol model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将组合先知不等式归约到单品先知不等式的一般框架，在Googol博弈模型下为XOS估值给出新的竞争比结果。
AI.motivation: 研究在线组合分配中的单样本先知不等式，改进已有工作[DKL+24]的结果，并处理买家侧组合约束与物品侧供应约束。
AI.method: 利用自由处置价值将买家侧组合约束与物品侧供应约束分离，通过支持价格实现从组合到单品先知不等式的归约，构建模块化框架，适用于更强的Googol博弈模型。
AI.result: 对XOS估值得到1/(6√3)≈1/10.4竞争比的单样本先知不等式，以及(β_{k-1}/4)竞争比的k样本先知不等式，均改进[DKL+24]；结果可扩展到可分割资源与capped-XOS估值；另获在线自由处置的新结果及Googol模型下分数背包的最优单样本先知不等式。
AI.conclusion: 该归约框架统一并拓展了组合先知不等式的结果，在更强模型下取得改进的竞争比并推广到可分割资源场景。

title: State-Space Unlearning for Non-Stationary Bias in Land Surface Forecasting
summary: Operational land surface forecasting systems built on Mamba-family Structured State Space Models absorb non-stationary confounding events (unrecorded irrigation booms, dam-operation shifts, sensor recalibrations) into their state-transition matrices, silently biasing NDVI, LST, and crop phenology predictions long after the physical cause ends. This paper introduces SSU-LSF (State-Space Unlearning for Land Surface Forecasting), the first machine-unlearning framework purpose-built for geoscientific Mamba-based SSMs. We develop EKFac influence functions specialized to the Mamba state matrices via a closed-form matrix-exponential gradient, use spectral-radius-weighted elbow thresholding to localize a temporal confounding footprint $Φ$, and apply Hessian-free projected gradient ascent within a KL-divergence trust region augmented by spatial total-variation (TV) regularization. Proposition 1 establishes that residual confounding is bounded by $\mathcal{O}\big((1-ρ(\bar{A})^{T_c})/((1-ρ(\bar{A}))μ)\big)$, which grows with the window length $T_c$. Across three heterogeneous benchmarks and eleven baselines, SSU-LSF achieves confounding reduction rates of $0.773$ (CropHarvest), $0.821$ (NDVI-LST), and $0.859$ (ERA5), with worst-case clean-domain RMSE degradation of $4.2\%$ on ERA5, converging in 3--5 epochs at $8.4\times$ lower GPU-cost per unlearning request than full retraining. Code: https://github.com/Anidipta/SSU-LSF

AI.tldr: 提出SSU-LSF，首个面向地球科学Mamba状态空间模型的机器遗忘框架，消除非平稳混杂事件对地表预测的偏差。
AI.motivation: 地表预测系统（基于Mamba族SSM）会把未记录的灌溉、水库调度、传感器重校准等非平稳混杂事件吸收进状态转移矩阵，在物理原因结束后仍长期偏置NDVI、LST和作物物候预测，现有方法无法定向移除这类影响。
AI.method: 构建EKFac影响函数，通过闭式矩阵指数梯度适配Mamba状态矩阵；用谱半径加权肘部阈值定位时间混杂足迹Φ；在KL散度信赖域内做无Hessian投影梯度上升，并加入空间全变分(TV)正则。
AI.result: 三个异构基准、11个基线：混杂削减率0.773(CropHarvest)、0.821(NDVI-LST)、0.859(ERA5)；ERA5最坏干净域RMSE退化仅4.2%；3–5轮收敛，每次遗忘请求GPU成本比全量重训低8.4倍。命题1给出残差混杂上界随窗口长度T_c增长。
AI.conclusion: SSU-LSF首次将机器遗忘引入地球科学Mamba SSM，在高效移除混杂偏差的同时保持干净域精度，为业务化地表预测提供可行方案。

title: The AI Risk Observatory: What Can We Learn from AI Disclosures in Annual Reports About Societal Resilience?
comment: 22 pages (9 main text + appendices), 12 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/84rt/AI-Risk-Observatory (release dataset-v1.1)
summary: Societal resilience research relies on access to useful and actionable data, which motivates our main research question: Can annual reports, processed at scale with LLMs, provide a useful signal about how companies disclose their response to AI? We test this by applying a reproducible two-stage classification pipeline to 9,821 annual reports from 1,362 UK listed companies (2020-2025, with partial 2026 data). We first validate the method against 474 human-annotated passages, finding high recall and moderate label-level agreement. We then report three empirical patterns: (i) between 2020 and 2025, the share of reports mentioning AI risk rose from 2.8% to 41.2%, while AI adoption disclosure also rose, from 13.8% to 45.2%, and named vendor mentions cluster around a small set of major providers led by Microsoft; (ii) disclosure varies substantially by Critical National Infrastructure sector and market segment: AIM reports disclose AI risk at far lower rates than Main Market reports, and sectors such as Energy and Data Infrastructure lag behind the rest in AI risk disclosure; and (iii) harm disclosures are near-absent (seven reports across the entire corpus). We develop a substantiveness classification to assess the quality of the disclosure and find that most AI risk disclosure is not substantive: in 2025, 41.2% of all reports mention AI as a risk, but only 4.3% contain AI risk disclosure we classify as substantive.

AI.tldr: 本文用两阶段LLM分类流水线分析9,821份英国上市公司年报，检验其能否反映企业AI应对披露信号。发现AI风险提及率2020-2025年从2.8%升至41.2%，但仅4.3%为实质性披露，且各部门/市场板块差异明显。
AI.motivation: 社会韧性研究依赖有用且可操作的数据。核心问题是：能否用LLM大规模处理年报，获取企业如何披露其AI应对的有效信号。
AI.method: 采用可复现的两阶段分类流水线，处理1,362家英国上市公司2020-2025年（含部分2026年）的9,821份年报；用474条人工标注段落验证方法；构建"实质性"分类以评估披露质量。
AI.result: (i) AI风险提及率从2.8%升至41.2%，AI采用披露从13.8%升至45.2%，供应商提及集中于微软等少数厂商；(ii) 披露因关键国家基础设施部门和市场板块差异显著，AIM市场远低于主板，能源与数据基础设施落后；(iii) 危害披露几乎缺失（全库仅7份）；2025年41.2%提及AI风险但仅4.3%属实质性。
AI.conclusion: LLM流水线可在规模化处理年报中提取有用的AI披露信号，并揭示披露数量增长与实质性不足之间的落差，为AI治理与韧性研究提供数据基础。

title: From Retrieval to Typed Decisions: Calibrated System One Models from Biomedical Sentence Encoders
summary: Typed decision models answer schema-constrained questions about a text in one forward pass and return probabilities meant to be thresholded. We ask whether biomedical sentence encoders trained for retrieval are good starting points for such models. We present SBERT2S1, which converts Sentence-Transformers encoders into bi-encoder, cross-head (C) and prior-fused residual (PFR) decision models, together with BIODECIDE, a biomedical typed-decision suite, and MEDLINE-S1, 243k training decisions derived from NLM indexing. Across six parent-retriever pairs, retrieval training improves zero-shot matching of content-bearing options. After fine-tuning, its effect depends on the head: across five pairs and three training-set sizes, retrieval training significantly helps PFR, which keeps the retrieval prior, in 10 of 15 comparisons, but helps C in one and hurts it in five. A matched grid of two heads and five training objectives shows that C outperforms PFR under every objective, and that the released RLCD recipe of open System One models trails cross-entropy by 2.5-3.0 points. The deficit stems mainly from its reward normalisation, which inflates the noisy score-function term 3.6-15-fold; an unbiased leave-one-out estimator recovers most of the gap. After temperature scaling, no objective is clearly better calibrated than cross-entropy. We release the code, the MEDLINE-S1 labels and a model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SBERT2S1，将生物医学Sentence-Transformers转为句子级决策模型，并构建BIODECIDE评测套件与MEDLINE-S1训练集(243k决策)。研究发现检索训练对零样本选项匹配有益；微调后其效果依头结构而定，PFR普遍受益而C不稳定。交叉熵在所有目标中最优，RLCD配方因奖励归一化问题落后2.5-3.0分，用无偏留一估计可恢复大部分差距。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探究：为检索任务训练的生物医学句子编码器，是否适合作为类型化决策模型（需阈值化概率输出）的良好起点。这类模型需在一次前向传播中回答受schema约束的问题。
AI.method: 提出SBERT2S1，将Sentence-Transformers转换为双编码器模型，包含跨头(C)与先验融合残差头(PFR)。构建BIODECIDE生物医学类型化决策套件；从NLM索引构建MEDLINE-S1(243k训练决策)。在六对parent-retriever上测试，并对两头五种训练目标进行网格实验，分析RLCD奖励归一化问题并采用无偏留一估计。
AI.result: 检索训练提升零样本内容选项匹配。微调后效果依头而异：PFR在10/15比较中显著受益，C仅1次受益、5次受损。所有目标下C均优于PFR。RLCD配方比交叉熵低2.5-3.0分，主因奖励归一化使噪声得分函数项膨胀3.6-15倍；无偏留一估计恢复大部分差距。温度缩放后，各目标校准无明显优于交叉熵者。
AI.conclusion: 检索训练是类型化决策模型的有价值起点，但收益取决于头结构；交叉熵在性能与校准上均稳健最优。RLCD的落后可归因于归一化缺陷，留一估计能有效修复。论文开源代码、MEDLINE-S1标签与一个模型。

title: SCOPE-4D: Endoscopic 4D Geometry Foundation Models
summary: Geometric understanding supports endoscopic navigation and robotic assistance, but learning reliable endoscopic geometry faces two challenges: scarce geometric annotations and ambiguity between camera motion and tissue deformation. We present SCOPE-4D, an endoscopic 4D geometry foundation model that jointly predicts camera parameters, dense geometry, and 3D tissue trajectories from monocular RGB video in a single forward pass. Our curation and annotation pipeline constructs SCOPE-5K, a collection of approximately 5,000 clips spanning real and synthetic gastrointestinal endoscopy and laparoscopy. The collection provides rich geometric supervision and includes newly collected phantom and real-colonoscopy evaluation sets. Geometric supervised fine-tuning on SCOPE-5K learns endoscopic priors that improve camera and depth estimation. Common--Residual Motion (CRM) further constrains local deformation relative to common tissue movement. Together with geometric supervision, CRM and trajectory supervision further improve camera and depth estimation over geometric fine-tuning alone while enabling dense 3D tissue tracking. Evaluations on public and newly collected benchmarks demonstrate strong in-domain and out-of-domain geometry, superior 3D tracking, and more stable long-sequence colon reconstruction. A blinded user study further supports the perceived reconstruction quality on real clinical video. Together, these results demonstrate the value of large-scale endoscopic supervision and motion constraints for joint geometry estimation and tissue tracking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE-4D，一个内窥镜4D几何基础模型，能从单目RGB视频单次前向预测相机参数、稠密几何和3D组织轨迹，并构建了约5000段视频的SCOPE-5K数据集。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜几何理解有助于导航和机器人辅助，但面临两大挑战：几何标注稀缺，以及相机运动与组织形变之间的歧义。
AI.method: 构建SCOPE-5K数据集（约5000段真实与合成的胃肠内窥镜和腹腔镜视频，含新采集的体模与真实结肠镜评测集）；在SCOPE-5K上进行几何监督微调学习内窥镜先验；提出Common-Residual Motion (CRM)约束相对共同组织运动的局部形变；结合几何监督与轨迹监督。
AI.result: 在公开及新采集基准上展现强域内/域外几何性能、更优的3D跟踪，以及更稳定的长序列结肠重建；盲测用户研究支持真实临床视频上的重建质量感知。CRM与轨迹监督在几何微调基础上进一步提升相机和深度估计。
AI.conclusion: 大规模内窥镜监督与运动约束对联合几何估计和组织跟踪具有重要价值。

title: Benchmarking Literature Retrieval for a Model Organism: A Dictyostelium Case Study
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Submitted version (before peer review) of a paper accepted at Discovery Science 2026 (DS 2026); to appear in the Springer proceedings. Code and data: https://github.com/fulaibaowang/dictycite ; dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20308282
summary: Biological literature retrieval systems are often developed and evaluated using broad biomedical corpora and general-purpose search tasks. However, many curated knowledge bases operate in narrower model-organism domains, where the literature is sparse and terminology is organism-specific. We introduce a retrieval benchmark from dictyBase for Dictyostelium, a model organism in cell and developmental biology. The benchmark consists of curator-generated biological queries linked to PubMed-indexed articles, together with structured gene annotations. Using this benchmark, we study three factors in niche biological retrieval: cross-encoder reranking, gene-aware query expansion, and abstract-only versus full-text retrieval. We report that reranking and gene-aware query expansion improve retrieval selectively: reranking is most useful when the model is well suited to biological evidence matching, whereas curated annotations help clarify compact biological queries by reducing vocabulary mismatch. Full-text chunks substantially improve retrieval when abstracts omit supporting evidence, increasing both candidate recall and top-rank performance, although these cases are harder than queries supported by abstracts. Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/fulaibaowang/dictycite, and the benchmark dataset is additionally archived on Zenodo.

AI.tldr: 该论文为Dictyostelium模式生物领域构建了一个检索基准（来自dictyBase），研究重排序、基因感知查询扩展以及全文检索三因素对检索性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有生物文献检索系统多基于宽泛的生物医学语料和通用检索任务开发，但许多知识库聚焦于较窄的模式生物领域，文献稀疏且术语具有物种特异性，缺乏针对性基准。
AI.method: 基于dictyBase构建基准，包含策展人编写的生物查询、关联的PubMed文章及结构化基因注释；在此基准上研究跨编码器重排序、基因感知查询扩展、仅摘要与全文检索三个因素。
AI.result: 重排序和基因感知查询扩展能选择性提升检索：重排序在模型适合生物证据匹配时最有用，策展注释通过减少词汇不匹配帮助澄清简洁查询；全文分块在摘要缺失支持证据时显著提升检索，提高候选召回和顶级排名表现，但这类查询比摘要支持的查询更难。
AI.conclusion: 针对窄域模式生物的检索需结合重排序、注释驱动的查询扩展和全文检索；数据与代码已公开（GitHub及Zenodo）。

title: Learning While Inferring: Local and Parallel Learning for Edge SNNs across Sensing Modalities
summary: Edge intelligence requires models to sense continuously in real time and to keep adapting on-device, all under tight compute, energy, and memory budgets. Although spiking neural networks (SNNs) enable efficient event-driven inference, standard surrogate-gradient backpropagation (BP) serializes updates and blocks ongoing inference. We investigate Bidirectional Spike-Based Distillation (BSD) as an on-device learning principle that lets edge SNNs learn while inferring. BSD couples a stimulus-driven forward network with an independent target-driven reverse network and aligns their intermediate representations through local objectives. Because the two pathways have disjoint computation graphs until alignment, forward inference, reverse inference, and stage-wise updates can run concurrently. On 25 benchmarks spanning the five sensing modalities of SOUL, BSD stays within 3.8 percentage points of matched BP baselines on average, while only its forward branch is needed at deployment. The learned representations also transfer well to few-shot class-incremental learning without replaying past data. By removing the dense floating-point backward chain, BSD reduces the projected training latency to $0.72\times$ and the estimated training energy to $0.36\times$ that of BP.

AI.tldr: BSD 让边缘 SNN 在推理的同时进行学习，用前向与反向双网络通过局部对齐实现并发更新，在 25 个基准上接近 BP，并显著降低训练延迟与能耗。
AI.motivation: 边缘智能要求模型实时持续感知并在设备上不断适应，但受限于算力、能耗和内存。SNN 虽能高效事件驱动推理，但标准代理梯度 BP 会串行化更新并阻塞推理。
AI.method: 提出双向脉冲蒸馏（BSD）：一个刺激驱动的前向网络与一个独立的目标驱动反向网络，通过局部目标对齐中间表示。两条路径在对其前计算图相互独立，因此前向推理、反向推理和分阶段更新可并发进行。
AI.result: 在覆盖 SOUL 五种感知模态的 25 个基准上，BSD 平均仅落后匹配 BP 基线 3.8 个百分点，部署时只需前向分支；学到的表示还能在无需回放旧数据的情况下迁移到少样本类增量学习。去掉密集浮点反向链后，训练延迟降至 BP 的 0.72 倍，估计训练能耗降至 0.36 倍。
AI.conclusion: BSD 为边缘 SNN 提供了一种边推理边学习的原则，在保持接近 BP 性能的同时降低训练开销，并具备良好的增量学习迁移能力。

title: Improving the Energy-Efficiency of the Code Generated by LLMs through Effective Prompting
summary: As AI-assisted programming becomes increasingly mainstream, the environmental impact of AI-generated software has emerged as an important consideration. This motivates evaluating LLM-generated code beyond functional correctness by considering execution efficiency and energy consumption. However, despite substantial advances in code generation, frontier LLMs are rarely evaluated based on the energy efficiency of the code they produce. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 21 prompting strategies for energy-efficient code generation and identify 8 strategies for evaluation across 10 widely used open-weight and proprietary LLMs. We evaluate their effectiveness for both Python and C++ code generation relative to a baseline prompt. Across the evaluated models, the selected prompting strategies achieved energy reductions of up to 25% for Python and 17% for C++ code generation. At the model level, Python energy reductions reached up to 50% for Granite-4.0-H-Small, 39% for Claude 4.5 Haiku, and 28% for MiniMax M3, while C++ reductions reached up to 56% for Granite-4.0-H-Small and 7% for Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct. These results demonstrate that prompting strategies can substantially influence the energy consumption of LLM-generated code, although their effectiveness varies across models and programming languages. Our findings highlight the importance of incorporating energy efficiency into the evaluation and optimization of LLM-based code generation and provide practical insights into designing prompts for more sustainable AI-assisted programming.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了21种提示策略，筛选出8种用于10个LLM的Python/C++节能代码生成。选定策略可实现最高25%（Python）和17%（C++）的能耗降低，模型层面最高达50%-56%，但效果因模型和语言而异。
AI.motivation: AI辅助编程日益普及，AI生成软件的环境影响成为重要考量，需在功能正确性之外评估执行效率与能耗。然而，前沿LLM生成的代码很少按其能耗效率进行评测，缺乏对提示策略节能效果的系统性研究。
AI.method: 对21种提示策略进行综合评估，筛选出8种，在10个主流开放权重与专有LLM上、针对Python和C++代码生成，以基线提示为参照进行对比评测。
AI.result: 选定策略实现能耗降低：Python最高25%，C++最高17%；模型层面Python降低最高达50%（Granite-4.0-H-Small）、39%（Claude 4.5 Haiku）、28%（MiniMax M3）；C++最高达56%（Granite-4.0-H-Small）、7%（Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct）。
AI.conclusion: 提示策略能显著影响LLM生成代码的能耗，但效果因模型与编程语言而异。应将能耗效率纳入LLM代码生成的评估与优化，并为可持续的AI辅助编程提供实用提示设计洞见。

title: How to Have a Sensitive Debate: An Instance-Optimal Protocol for AI Debate
summary: As powerful AI systems reach and sometimes surpass the abilities of human experts across a range of cognitively demanding tasks, the problem of accurate oversight and supervision of these systems has become increasingly urgent. One promising approach is AI debate, which seeks to leverage a debate between two powerful AIs to break complex questions down into simpler claims that can be easily judged directly. Theoretical work on debate has formalized this intuition in the language of computational complexity theory, where the goal is to design protocols (i.e., rules of the debate game) that provide rigorous guarantees on correctness for judging solutions to complex problems with limited supervision. Specifically, the current best protocol has been shown to work for all problems that have sufficiently stable decompositions into subproblems. In this paper, we design a new protocol for this same class of problems that improves on the prior work in several ways. First, correctness holds in a worst-case rather than an average-case sense. Second, being honest and correct is a dominant-strategy equilibrium for both debaters, rather than a Stackelberg equilibrium. Finally, we prove black-box lower bounds, showing that our new protocol is instance-wise optimal. That is, no protocol for this class of problems can outperform ours while making only black-box queries to human judgments. We obtain these results by relating the notion of stable problem decompositions to the concept of fractional block sensitivity from query complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种改进的AI辩论协议，用于在有限人类监督下判定复杂问题，具备最坏情况正确性、占优策略均衡，并证明其黑盒最优。
AI.motivation: 强大AI系统在认知任务上超越人类专家，如何对其进行准确监督变得迫切。AI辩论通过两个AI辩论将复杂问题分解为可简单判断的子命题，但现有协议仅有平均情况保证、依赖Stackelberg均衡，缺乏最优性。
AI.method: 针对具有稳定分解的问题类，设计新辩论协议，将稳定问题分解与查询复杂度中的分数块敏感度（fractional block sensitivity）相关联，并证明黑盒下界。
AI.result: 协议在最坏情况下保证正确；诚实且正确是两个辩论者的占优策略均衡；证明其逐实例（instance-wise）最优，即任何仅做黑盒人类判断查询的协议都无法超越该协议。
AI.conclusion: 新协议在正确性保证、均衡概念和最优性上全面优于先前工作，为AI辩论提供了更强的理论基础。

title: Nearest-neighbour baselines for fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra under different assumptions
summary: It has recently been shown that nearest-neighbour retrieval provides a strong baseline for molecular fingerprint prediction from MS/MS spectra, with several variants matching or outperforming current deep learning models (Khoo and Barzilay, 2026; Liu et al., 2026; Gupta et al., 2026). Importantly, "nearest neighbour" encompasses a family of retrieval methods that differ in the information assumed to be available at inference. In this report, we systematically compare several nearest-neighbour variants and show how these differing assumptions affect performance. Our goal is to establish stricter baselines that enable more rigorous benchmarking and better measure progress in this area.

AI.tldr: 该报告系统比较多种最近邻检索变体，分析其不同推理假设对MS/MS谱分子指纹预测性能的影响，旨在建立更严格的基线。
AI.motivation: 最近邻检索已被证明是MS/MS谱分子指纹预测的强基线，但"最近邻"包含假设不同信息的多种检索方法，需厘清其对性能的影响以进行更严格的基准测试。
AI.method: 系统比较多种最近邻检索变体，区分训练/推理阶段所假定的可用信息。
AI.result: 不同最近邻变体的推理假设差异会显著影响预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 建立更严格的基线，以实现更严谨的基准测试并更准确衡量该领域进展。

title: Keep It CALM: Analyzing the Limits of Global Unsafety in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Training-free safeguards for text-to-image generation often rely on a reusable safety signal, such as an unsafe direction or global toxic subspace, applied broadly across prompts. We provide a controlled geometric analysis of this global-unsafety assumption and reveal a consistent coverage-selectivity trade-off: compact unsafe subspaces fail to cover heterogeneous unsafe semantics, whereas broader aggregation increasingly distorts safety-adjacent benign prompts. Motivated by this finding, we propose CALM (Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation), a training-free safeguard that replaces uniform global removal with prompt-local counterfactual correction. Using matched unsafe-benign anchors, CALM routes each prompt to active unsafe categories, minimally edits only violating token representations toward the safe side, and suppresses positively aligned unsafe residual components. Across broad evaluation, CALM significantly improves unsafe content suppression while preserving benign utility, demonstrating that local counterfactual correction provides a more selective alternative to global unsafe signal removal.

AI.tldr: 本文指出全局“不安全信号”防护存在覆盖-选择性权衡，提出无需训练的CALM方法，通过提示级反事实局部校正来更精准地抑制不安全内容并保留良性效用。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成的无训练安全防护通常依赖可复用的全局安全信号（如不安全方向或全局有害子空间），并广泛作用于所有提示。作者受此启发，对“全局不安全”假设进行受控几何分析，发现存在覆盖-选择性权衡：紧凑的不安全子空间难以覆盖多样化的不安全语义，而更广泛的聚合会逐渐扭曲与安全相邻的良性提示。
AI.method: 提出CALM（Counterfactual Adaptive Local Modulation），一种无训练防护方法。它用匹配的不安全-良性锚点，将每个提示路由到活跃的不安全类别，仅对违规的token表示进行最小编辑，使其转向安全侧，并抑制正对齐的不安全残差分量，从而替代统一的全局信号移除。
AI.result: 在广泛评估中，CALM显著提升了不安全内容抑制效果，同时保留了良性提示的可用性。
AI.conclusion: 局部反事实校正比全局不安全信号移除更具选择性，是更优的无训练安全防护方案。

title: A generative-informed neuro-symbolic framework for syntactic ambiguity resolution: Evidence from Arabic DPs
summary: Syntactic ambiguity poses a persistent challenge for Arabic NLP, particularly in morphologically rich nominal constructions where multiple structu6ral interpretations may be compatible with the same surface sequence. This study proposes a generatively informed neuro-symbolic framework for resolving structural ambiguity in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) DPs. The framework integrates generative syntactic notions with AraBERT by representing ambiguity as a candidate-based decision task in which linguistically motivated alternatives are explicitly constructed and evaluated through candidate-conditioned input representations. Findings indicate that the model achieved 96.88% accuracy, 95.92% macro-F1, 96.83% weighted F1, and 93.94% binary F1 on the unseen evaluation set. Class-level analysis revealed asymmetric performance, with recall of 99.71% for High/VP Attachment (N1) and 89.26% for Low/NP/Embedded Attachment (N2), indicating greater difficulty in recovering the embedded interpretation. The study concludes that formal syntactic representations can be operationalized within Transformer-based NLP as an explicit interface between linguistic structure and contextual neural modeling, providing a controlled and interpretable approach to Arabic syntactic ambiguity resolution and beyond.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号框架，将生成句法理论与AraBERT结合，通过候选条件表示解决现代标准阿拉伯语DP结构歧义，评测准确率96.88%。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语形态丰富，NP/DP结构常出现多个句法解读共存，歧义消解困难，且现有神经方法缺乏语言学结构约束与可解释性。
AI.method: 将歧义建模为候选句法方案的判定任务：先依据生成句法构造语言上合理的备选结构，再以候选条件化输入表示接入AraBERT进行判别评估。
AI.result: 未见评测集上准确率96.88%、宏F1 95.92%、加权F1 96.83%、二分类F1 93.94%；类别表现不对称，N1（High/VP附着）召回99.71%，N2（Low/NP嵌入式附着）仅89.26%。
AI.conclusion: 形式句法表征可在Transformer框架内作为语言结构与上下文神经建模的显式接口，实现可控、可解释的阿拉伯语结构歧义消解，并具推广潜力。

title: Confidence-Controlled XAI Auditing for Pedestrian Detection under Domain Shift
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Vehicular Electronics and Safety (ICVES 2026). 6 pages, 4 figures
summary: Explainability is increasingly required for perception models in intelligent vehicles, yet whether explanations remain faithful under driving domain shift is still poorly understood. This work audits post-hoc explanations of a fixed YOLOv8s pedestrian detector across PIE and JAAD using ROI-based D-Deletion, frozen confidence terciles, rank-based tests, bootstrap intervals, and Holm correction. The audit shows that deletion-based faithfulness is strongly coupled to detection strength at explanation time, with Spearman correlations between 0.70 and 0.82 for D-RISE, making naive confidence-stratified comparisons unreliable. After controlling for detection strength within fixed f0 bins, D-RISE faithfulness remains domain-dependent in the central f0 range, with PIE showing higher D-Deletion than JAAD and Holm-adjusted significance. A non-perturbative EigenCAM baseline is less faithful than D-RISE but also exhibits score coupling, suggesting that the effect is not specific to D-RISE and is related to the deletion-based evaluation setup. These results motivate confidence-controlled XAI audits for safety-critical perception under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本工作审计YOLOv8s行人检测器在PIE与JAAD跨域下的后验解释忠实度，发现基于删除的忠实度与检测强度强耦合，控制强度后D-RISE忠实度仍存在域依赖。
AI.motivation: 智能车感知模型日益需要可解释性，但解释在驾驶域偏移下是否仍保持忠实尚不清楚，亟需审计。
AI.method: 固定YOLOv8s行人检测器，在PIE和JAAD上用ROI-based D-Deletion、冻结置信度三分位、秩检验、bootstrap置信区间与Holm校正审计后验解释；并以EigenCAM作非扰动基线比较。
AI.result: D-Deletion忠实度与解释时检测强度强耦合，D-RISE的Spearman相关为0.70-0.82，朴素置信度分层比较不可靠；在固定f0分箱内，D-RISE忠实度在中心f0区间仍域依赖，PIE高于JAAD且Holm校正后显著；EigenCAM忠实度低于D-RISE但也呈分数耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该效应并非D-RISE特有，而与基于删除的评估设置相关；结果支持在域偏移下对安全关键感知进行置信度受控的XAI审计。

title: A Manifold-Aware Topic Modeling Approach via Rank-Based Prototypes
comment: Accepted at the Main Conference of 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Recent topic models leverage pretrained embeddings, but neural architectures produce latent representations without grounding in specific texts, and clustering-based pipelines assign representative documents only post hoc, relying on absolute distances distorted by hubness and anisotropy in high-dimensional spaces. We introduce MARETopic, a training-free framework that casts topic discovery as rank-based prototype selection. After projecting embeddings onto a low-dimensional manifold, MARETopic builds ranked lists encoding ordinal neighborhood structure. A greedy algorithm selects exactly K exemplar documents, real corpus texts, whose neighborhoods cover the corpus. Two variants share this criterion. MARETopic$_\text{Corr}$ scores candidates with a query performance predictor and a rank correlation measure, leading Purity and NMI on the two benchmarks with the most categories, ahead of both neural and clustering-based topic models. MARETopic$_\text{Diff}$ scores them with a rank-based diffusion matrix, needs neither measure, and runs 1.7 to 1.9 times faster. Without a single gradient update, MARETopic leads topic coherence on two of three datasets. A novel inter-topic Maximal Marginal Relevance step raises vocabulary diversity at little cost in coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/thcastilho/maretopic.

AI.tldr: MARETopic提出一种免训练框架，将主题发现转化为基于排序的原型选择，直接从语料选取K个真实文档作为主题代表。
AI.motivation: 现有主题模型依赖预训练嵌入，但神经架构生成的潜在表示缺乏具体文本支撑，而聚类式流程只在事后分配代表文档，绝对距离受高维空间中的hubness和anisotropy影响而失真。
AI.method: 将嵌入投影到低维流形后构建编码序数邻域结构的排序列表，用贪心算法选出恰好K个真实语料文档作样本，使邻域覆盖整个语料。提供两个变体：MARETopic_Corr用查询性能预测器和排序相关性度量打分；MARETopic_Diff用基于排序的扩散矩阵打分，无需上述度量。另有基于Maximal Marginal Relevance的跨主题步骤提升词汇多样性。
AI.result: MARETopic_Corr在类别最多的两个基准上取得Purity和NMI领先，超越神经与聚类主题模型；MARETopic_Diff运行速度快1.7至1.9倍。无需任何梯度更新，在三数据集中的两个上主题一致性领先。MMR步骤以很小的一致性代价提升词汇多样性。
AI.conclusion: MARETopic以免训练、基于排序的方式实现主题发现，兼顾效果与效率，并提供开源代码。

title: Aggregate accuracy conceals concentrated temporal vulnerability in a spiking speech classifier
comment: 4 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to Neural Networks. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23089436
summary: Aggregate accuracy cannot reveal which utterances are locally vulnerable or how internal activity changes when labels remain stable. We retain every prediction for 725,070 adjacent-bin, one-count changes around 100 validation utterances of a frozen SpikeSCR-based classifier.
