The canonical native-horizon GPU singleton path reaches 86.0836% validation accuracy. Equal-source expected accuracy under a uniformly chosen neighbor rises from 84.00% to 84.54%, although 13 of 84 initially correct sources admit adverse neighbors. Five sources carry 93.21% of adverse moves. Margin-guided and surrogate-gradient searches miss sparse cases at fixed query budgets; a post hoc gradient prefix finds all 13 at 73.45% of the census of initially correct sources. Source-matched traces and clean-state interventions distinguish internal change from harmful direction and recoverability. Two count-readout replicas have similar validation accuracies but a 5.21-fold class-change gap concentrated in four sources. Controlled query/key source isolation eliminates 531 batch-order label changes and restores bitwise order invariance across all 9,981 validation score vectors. Isolated batch predictions reproduce padding-matched singleton labels on 9,980 of 9,981 inputs. Paired CPU/GPU replay of all 25,820 class-changing neighbors gives 99.8993% label agreement and preserves all 13 vulnerable sources and their fixed witnesses. Complete source-conditioned maps distinguish vulnerability incidence, concentration, internal change, and execution dependence that aggregate accuracy leaves unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文对冻结的SpikeSCR分类器在100条验证话语周围725,070个相邻一位变化上进行完整预测普查，揭示聚合准确率无法反映的话语级脆弱性、内部变化与执行依赖性。
AI.motivation: 聚合准确率无法揭示哪些话语局部脆弱，也无法说明标签稳定时内部活动如何变化，因此需要更细粒度的预测普查来区分脆弱性发生、集中度、内部变化与执行依赖。
AI.method: 保留SpikeSCR分类器在725,070个相邻bin、单计数变化上的全部预测；比较均匀邻居下的期望准确率；用margin-guided和代理梯度搜索寻找脆弱源；使用源匹配轨迹、清洁状态干预、count-readout副本、受控query/key源隔离以及CPU/GPU配对重放进行分析。
AI.result: 原生GPU单例路径验证准确率86.0836%；均匀邻居期望准确率从84.00%升至84.54%；13/84初始正确源存在不利邻居，5个源占93.21%不利移动；事后梯度前缀以73.45%普查找到全部13个；两个count-readout副本准确率相近但类别变化差5.21倍；源隔离消除531个批顺序标签变化并恢复位序不变性；CPU/GPU重放标签一致率99.8993%且保留全部13个脆弱源。
AI.conclusion: 完整的源条件图谱能区分聚合准确率无法解决的脆弱性发生率、集中度、内部变化和执行依赖，说明仅看聚合准确率会掩盖关键的话语级与执行级风险。

title: WebUIProof: Benchmarking WebUI Code Generators with UI-Agent Execution Harness
summary: Evaluating WebUI code generation at scale is difficult: outputs may compile and look plausible yet fail under user interaction, and prior benchmarks largely rely on free-form prompts with static checks (build success, screenshots) that miss functional correctness. We introduce WebUIProof, an execution-oriented benchmark that provides structured specifications and dense, executable interaction tests for WebUI generation across two task families: general WebUIs (e.g., dashboards, game, interactive tools) and 3D interactive simulation (e.g., particle/galaxy systems, physics dynamics). WebUIProof includes a UI-agent harness that runs executable interaction tests in a headless browser using an iterative plan--act--observe loop: it locates DOM elements, performs actions, observes resulting UI/DOM changes, and checks the specified assertions. We evaluate across eight commercial LLMs and observe frequent failures on interaction-based requirements even when pages render successfully, especially on 3D simulation interfaces. Finally, we show the UI-agent harness can provide outcome-level training signals. Training compact models (e.g., Qwen2.5 14B and MIMO 7B) with RL rewards derived from executable interaction tests improves functional completion while reducing build failures.

AI.tldr: 提出WebUIProof，一个面向执行的WebUI代码生成基准，含结构化规范与可执行交互测试，覆盖通用WebUI与3D交互仿真，并用UI-agent在无头浏览器中执行测试；8个商用LLM在交互需求上频繁失败，测试信号还可用于RL训练小模型。
AI.motivation: WebUI代码生成评测难以规模化：现有基准多用自由提示+静态检查（编译、截图），无法发现"能渲染但交互失败"的问题，缺乏功能正确性验证。
AI.method: WebUIProof提供结构化规格说明与密集可执行交互测试，覆盖两类任务：通用WebUI（仪表盘、游戏、交互工具）与3D交互仿真（粒子/星系、物理动力学）。配套UI-agent测试框架在无头浏览器中以plan–act–observe迭代循环执行测试：定位DOM元素、执行动作、观察UI/DOM变化并校验断言。
AI.result: 在8个商用LLM上评测，即使页面成功渲染，交互类需求也频繁失败，3D仿真界面尤为严重。用可执行交互测试衍生的RL奖励训练紧凑模型（Qwen2.5 14B、MIMO 7B）可提升功能完成度并减少构建失败。
AI.conclusion: 以执行为中心的基准与UI-agent框架能揭示静态检查遗漏的功能缺陷，同时提供结果级训练信号，改善小模型WebUI生成质量。

title: Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling for Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion generation by verifying inexpensive draft states in parallel while preserving the target law. Recent tree-based methods allocate the parallel compute budget more effectively than single-chain drafts, as demonstrated by Diffusion Greedy Rejection Sampling (D-GRS). D-GRS generates $K$ conditionally independent candidates per node, and sequentially tests them in their generation order. Yet the sampled candidates admit an informative ranking without additional target-model evaluations. To exploit this, we introduce Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS), a verification rule for speculative draft trees based on rank-aware list coupling. RASS orders draft candidates along the proposal-target mean displacement and samples a rank with weights optimized to minimize total variation between the selected-proposal and target laws. Finally, the selected candidate is maximally coupled with the target, with residual correction ensuring exact sampling for any choice of rank weights. We evaluate RASS on a Gaussian-mixture target, unconditional pixel-space generation on FFHQ, conditional generation on CIFAR-10, and latent diffusion with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using COCO2014 prompts. Measured by the ratio of standard to speculative sampling's target-model evaluation counts, RASS improves on D-GRS across the evaluated settings, with gains reaching approximately 20% on CIFAR-10 at matched compute budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RASS，一种基于rank-aware列表耦合的扩散模型投机采样验证规则，利用候选排名信息减少目标模型评估次数，在多个任务上较D-GRS提升，CIFAR-10上增益约20%。
AI.motivation: 现有树式投机采样方法（如D-GRS）按生成顺序依次验证候选，未利用候选之间隐含的有信息量排名；本文希望挖掘这一排名信息以更高效地利用并行计算预算。
AI.method: RASS基于rank-aware list coupling：沿proposal-target均值位移对候选排序，采样一个秩权重（经优化以最小化所选proposal与目标分布的总变差），并将所选候选与目标最大耦合，配合残差校正保证任意秩权重下精确采样。
AI.result: 在高斯混合目标、FFHQ无条件像素生成、CIFAR-10条件生成及Stable Diffusion 3.5（COCO2014提示）潜在扩散上评估；以标准与投机采样的目标模型评估次数之比衡量，RASS在匹配计算预算下均优于D-GRS，CIFAR-10增益约20%。
AI.conclusion: RASS通过rank-aware列表耦合有效利用候选排名信息，提升扩散投机采样效率，并在多种设置下一致优于D-GRS。

title: Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. In this paper, we argue that effective tool-use agents should estimate the long-horizon value of a possible next tool invocation before executing it. This objective requires comparative supervision over alternative invocations under the same context, while logged trajectories only contain the invocation that was actually taken. Therefore, we propose Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA). CITA trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) from paired signals that combine observed tool behavior, scalable supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and semantic judgments from LLM-based comparison. The resulting CIM learns to estimate how likely a possible next tool invocation is to support final task success under the current context. Across three tool-use benchmarks and multiple backbone LLMs, CITA consistently improves Tool F1 and task success. Additional analysis shows that CIM learns accurate step-level value estimates for comparative tool choices.

AI.tldr: 提出CITA方法，通过比较推断模型（CIM）估计下一步工具调用的长期价值，提升长时程工具使用智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 长时程工具调用中，最终结果奖励对长交互轨迹的信用分配较弱；步级奖励需人工/LLM判断或额外rollout来估计中间决策的下游影响，代价高。因此需要智能体在执行前估计下一步工具调用的长期价值，但日志轨迹仅含实际执行的动作，缺乏替代动作的比较监督。
AI.method: CITA训练一个比较推断模型（CIM），其数据来自配对信号：观察到的工具行为、基于贝叶斯工具图模拟器的可扩展监督，以及LLM比较的语义判断。CIM学习估计在当前上下文下某个候选下一步工具调用支持最终任务成功的概率。
AI.result: 在三个工具使用基准和多个骨干LLM上，CITA一致提升工具F1和任务成功率；分析表明CIM能学习到准确的步级价值估计。
AI.conclusion: 在比较性监督下估计下一工具调用的长期价值，可有效改善长时程工具使用智能体的决策质量。

title: Evaluating Multi-Dimensional Generalization of Large Language Models in Temporal Extraction Tasks
summary: Time and event expression extraction are fundamental temporal reasoning tasks, but the problem remains difficult due to annotation ambiguity, domain sensitivity, and unstable model behavior. Existing evaluations focus on in-domain performance, offering limited insight into reliability under distribution shifts. We evaluate multiple model configurations across families, architectures, and reasoning strategies over four dimensions of generalization, examining transfer from base performance, cross-dimensional correlations, and the effects of scale, architecture, and prompting. This provides a systematic study of how prompted LLMs generalize in time and event expression extraction tasks. We find that strong base-task performance generally predicts better generalization. However, this relationship weakens under substantial distribution shifts. Inductive prompting performs most consistently across domain shift, adversarial perturbations, compositionality, and length increase, while gains from scale, architecture, and deductive and abductive prompting strategies are uneven and dimension-specific. We conclude that LLM generalization in temporal extraction tasks cannot be predicted from any single dimension alone and cannot be reliably inferred from in-domain or single-dimension evaluations, highlighting the need for reasoning strategies that generalize across dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了提示式LLM在时间和事件表达式抽取任务上的泛化能力，发现强基任务性能通常预测更好的泛化，但在显著分布偏移下该关系减弱；归纳式提示在多维度上表现最稳定。
AI.motivation: 时间和事件表达式抽取因标注歧义、领域敏感性和模型行为不稳定而困难。现有评测多关注域内性能，难以揭示分布偏移下的可靠性，因此需要对其泛化性进行系统研究。
AI.method: 跨模型家族、架构和推理策略评估多种模型配置，围绕四个泛化维度，考察基于基任务性能的迁移、跨维度相关性，以及规模、架构和提示策略的影响。
AI.result: 强基任务性能通常预测更好的泛化，但在显著分布偏移下关系减弱。归纳式提示在领域偏移、对抗扰动、组合性和长度增加上最一致；规模、架构以及演绎和溯因提示策略带来的增益不均衡且维度特定。
AI.conclusion: LLM在时间抽取任务上的泛化无法由单一维度预测，也无法从域内或单维度评估可靠推断，凸显需要能跨维度泛化的推理策略。

title: EviDent-CBCT: Evidence-Bottlenecked Report Generation from Dental CBCT under Non-Exhaustive Report Supervision
summary: Dento-maxillofacial cone-beam CT (CBCT) reports may contain dozens of tooth-specific, anatomical, and spatial findings from a single 3D scan. Learning to generate such reports from limited clinical data is challenging because routine reports may not exhaustively document image findings, and a non-mention may reflect either absence or non-reporting. We present EviDent-CBCT, an evidence-bottlenecked framework designed for this incomplete supervision. An anatomy-aware network maps each CBCT scan to a discrete record of tooth-level, global, and tooth-IAC evidence. A dental-logic consistency projection reconciles incompatible evidence before a deterministic renderer and an image-blind local language model generate the report using only this record. For tooth-level evidence, reliability-aware training uses eligible non-mentions as reduced-weight negatives, while unreported global and tooth-IAC labels remain unknown. A metal-sensitive input channel preserves intensity cues from dental materials. Across three validation runs, EviDent-CBCT achieves $0.666\pm0.006$ merged evidence set-F1 and $0.402\pm0.003$ RadFact-Lite-Dental logical-F1, versus $0.371\pm0.018$ for the strongest controlled direct baseline. In the ODIN 2026 challenge, it ranked second in automated evaluation and third in blinded clinical Arena comparison on the hidden test set. These results support the discrete evidence record as an effective and auditable interface for CBCT report generation.

AI.tldr: 提出EviDent-CBCT框架，通过"证据瓶颈"处理不完整监督，先抽取离散证据记录再生成CBCT报告。
AI.motivation: 牙颌面CBCT报告含大量发现，但常规报告并不详尽，"未提及"可能代表缺失也可能只是未报告，导致监督不完整、直接生成报告困难。
AI.method: 解剖感知网络将扫描映射为牙级、全局、牙-IAC的离散证据记录；牙科逻辑一致性投影调和冲突证据；确定性渲染器+图像盲的语言模型仅基于该记录生成报告。牙级证据用可靠性感知训练将合格未提及作为降权负样本；全局和牙-IAC未报告标签保持未知；引入金属敏感输入通道保留材料强度线索。
AI.result: 三次验证：合并证据集-F1 0.666±0.006，RadFact-Lite-Dental逻辑-F1 0.402±0.003，显著优于最强受控直接基线0.371±0.018。ODIN 2026挑战赛自动评估第2、盲临床Arena第3。
AI.conclusion: 离散证据记录是一种有效且可审计的CBCT报告生成接口。

title: On-Premises Multi-Course RAG Tutoring for Business Education: Hardware-Software Trade-offs in a Campus AI Tutor
summary: Campus AI tutors based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must ground answers in assigned course materials while keeping textbooks and student dialogue on institutional infrastructure. We present CourseChat, an on-premises, multi-course RAG tutor for undergraduate business education, deployed behind a campus web gateway and intended for use embedded in Moodle. Six isolated course offerings, each keyed by its own course reference number (CRN), share twin-edge AI hosts running a FastAPI service, a local vector database, and a local large language model (LLM) served by Ollama. We report two generation-model bake-off rounds, a separate fixed-evidence source-fidelity comparison, and conversation and quiz audits. Several larger models failed the classroom speed gate, but a 12B model and a 7B alternative passed. A separate mixture-of-experts candidate improved some corrections while introducing new factual and continuity errors. We therefore retain the 8B production model pending a demonstrated overall improvement, rather than claiming that 8B is universally optimal. Software changes improved follow-up topic resolution while preserving course scope; 435 prebuilt questions across 65 modules decouple practice from live generation. The results support treating model choice, evidence selection, serving compatibility, and product design as a joint engineering decision. They do not establish learning gains: faculty ratings, peak-load capacity, and complete public-gateway acceptance remain separate evaluation needs.

AI.tldr: CourseChat是一个校内私有部署的多课程RAG辅导系统，通过双边缘AI主机、本地向量库与Ollama本地LLM服务支撑本科商科教学，重点在于模型选型、证据保真与服务兼容的联合工程决策。
AI.motivation: 校园AI辅导需将答案锚定于指定课程材料，同时把教材与师生对话保留在机构自有基础设施上，避免数据外流；系统还需嵌入Moodle并满足课堂速度与课程范围约束。
AI.method: 构建on-premises多课程RAG辅导系统：六个以CRN隔离的课程共享双边缘AI主机，运行FastAPI服务、本地向量数据库及Ollama本地LLM。开展两轮生成模型bake-off、独立的固定证据源保真度对比，以及对话与测验审计；并做软件改进以提升追问主题解析并保持课程范围，另预制435道题、覆盖65个模块。
AI.result: 多个较大模型未通过课堂速度门槛，12B与7B模型通过；独立混合专家候选改善了部分纠正但引入新的事实与连续性错误。因此暂保留8B生产模型，仅等待整体改进的证据，而非宣称8B普遍最优。软件改动改善了追问主题解析且未突破课程范围；预置题库将练习与实时生成解耦。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将模型选择、证据选择、服务兼容性与产品设计视为联合工程决策；但未证明学习收益，教师评分、峰值负载容量与完整公共网关验收仍需单独评估。

title: Evolving Hybrid Quantum-Classical Architectures for Image Classification
comment: Under Review at The Fifteenth International Conference on Learning Representations 2027
summary: Hybrid quantum classical neural networks integrate parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) with established deep learning architectures, but their performance depends strongly on the choice of quantum circuit architecture, a choice that remains largely manual. Most existing approaches rely on hand-designed or fixed circuit ansätze, requiring circuit structure, gate composition, and qubit connectivity to be specified in advance with no guarantee that they suit the task. This limitation is especially acute in image classification, where quantum circuits must transform features extracted by classical networks while remaining compact enough for practical training, requirements that generic, task-agnostic ansätze are unlikely to satisfy simultaneously. We extend EXAQC, an evolutionary framework for automated quantum circuit discovery, to image classification. EXAQC evolves PQCs as intermediate processing modules while retaining classical feature-extraction and prediction layers. On MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, EXAQC achieves 98.42%, 90.62%, and 85.47% accuracy, respectively, while using comparable gate counts to other quantum architecture-search methods. Against classical networks, evolved hybrid models maintain comparable accuracy with substantially fewer trainable parameters, reaching 85.68% on CIFAR-10 with over 25$\times$ fewer parameters than a 10-layer CNN. Encoding choice also matters: rotation-based encodings (RX, RY, U3) outperform amplitude encoding by 22-25 points on CIFAR-10. These results demonstrate that automated circuit discovery yields compact quantum modules that can replace larger classical components in vision architectures while retaining competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 将进化式量子电路自动搜索框架EXAQC扩展到图像分类，自动演化PQC作为中间模块，在MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR-10上取得98.42%/90.62%/85.47%准确率，且参数远少于经典网络。
AI.motivation: 混合量子-经典神经网络性能高度依赖量子电路架构，但现有多数方法依赖手工设计或固定ansatz，需预先指定结构、门组合和量子位连接，无法保证适配任务。图像分类中尤为突出：电路需转换经典网络提取的特征，又须足够紧凑，通用任务无关的ansatz难以同时满足。
AI.method: 扩展EXAQC（自动化量子电路发现的进化框架）到图像分类。EXAQC将PQC演化为中间处理模块，保留经典的特征提取与预测层，从而自动搜索电路结构与门组成。实验在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上进行，并比较不同编码方式（旋转编码RX/RY/U3与振幅编码）。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10上分别达到98.42%、90.62%、85.47%准确率，门数与其它量子架构搜索方法相当。相比经典网络，演化出的混合模型以显著更少可训练参数保持相当精度：CIFAR-10上85.68%且参数比10层CNN少25倍以上。编码选择影响显著：旋转编码（RX、RY、U3）在CIFAR-10上比振幅编码高22-25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自动化电路发现能产生紧凑的量子模块，可在视觉架构中替换更大的经典组件，同时保持有竞争力的准确率，说明任务自适应的量子电路搜索对混合量子-经典图像分类具有实用价值。

title: Self-Supervised Scaling of Terminal Environments for Scientific Domains
summary: Terminal agents are increasingly deployed beyond software engineering in science and other specialized domains. Constructing training environments requires executable reference behavior and a domain-specific verifier that distinguishes semantic correctness from superficially plausible artifacts. Authoring these components for each task requires repeated engineering and limits reuse. We introduce software-in-the-loop reconstruction, a self-supervised framework that obtains reference outputs and verification targets from existing software workflows, executable programs mapping structured inputs to outputs. For each workflow, we execute multiple input configurations and partition cases into public observations and hidden evaluations. Given the instruction, input schema, and public input--output observations, an agent constructs an editable program without access to the source workflow. The candidate is evaluated on hidden configurations against workflow outputs. A hierarchical verifier combines domain-specific semantic comparison, structural validity, and anti-shortcut checks, while public feedback supports iterative revision. The construction admits additional workflows and configurations without authoring a reference solution for each task. We instantiate SWR with 500 workflows and 46 software families across six domains. Across three attempts per task, Qwen3.8-Max solves 838 tasks and produces 1,422 verified trajectories, which we oversample to 3,000 reconstruction-only training examples. Supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.8-27B improves mean Terminal-Bench 2 performance from 47.94% to 53.56% across three seeds and achieves the highest mean among four matched-token corpus controls on all four reported evaluations. These results indicate that existing scientific software can provide scalable, behaviorally verified supervision for terminal agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 software-in-the-loop reconstruction (SWR) 自监督框架，从现有软件工作流自动获取参考输出与验证目标，为终端智能体生成可扩展、行为可验证的训练监督。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体正扩展到科学等专业领域，但为每个任务构建训练环境需要可执行参考行为和领域专属验证器，反复工程化成本高且难以复用。
AI.method: 执行同一工作流的多种输入配置，将其划分为公开观测与隐藏评估；智能体仅凭指令、输入模式和公开输入-输出，在无源工作流访问下构建可编辑程序；对隐藏配置进行评测，采用分层验证器（领域语义比对、结构有效性、反捷径检查），公开反馈支持迭代修订。
AI.result: 构建含 500 个工作流、46 个软件族、六大领域的实例。Qwen3.8-Max 三次尝试解决 838 个任务、生成 1,422 条验证轨迹，过采样为 3,000 条训练样本；对 Qwen3.8-27B 微调后 Terminal-Bench 2 平均性能由 47.94% 升至 53.56%，在四项评测中均优于四个匹配 token 语料对照。
AI.conclusion: 现有科学软件可为终端智能体提供可扩展、行为可验证的监督信号。

title: Counterfactual Predictions in Scientific Emulators Without Controlled Experiments
summary: Many scientific questions require reasoning about what was never observed: What if the conditions, interventions, or history had been different? Models can predict accurately on observed data yet fail on such what-if queries when correlated inputs are varied independently. A common remedy is to add controlled simulation data in which these factors are explicitly disentangled, but this requires access to a simulator, can be computationally expensive, and inherits the simulator's modeling assumptions. We introduce ReRoute, a framework for targeted scientific what-if prediction that combines factual data with partial mechanistic knowledge, without requiring controlled intervention data for adaptation. ReRoute fixes the queried input of a pretrained backbone to a reference value, reintroduces its variation through a known mechanistic pathway, and fine-tunes on the original factual data, while leaving downstream effects to the learned dynamics. We provide a causal identification result for this construction under explicit structural assumptions, with the core argument machine-checked in Lean. After showing that ReRoute achieves highly accurate counterfactual predictions in a controlled advection-diffusion system where exact responses are available, we turn to state-of-the-art climate emulation. On held-out coupled-climate interventions, ReRoute reduces aggregate climate error by 18.2-31.8% under severe CO$_2$ distribution shifts while preserving skill under standard conditions, at a small fraction of the cost of retraining on additional controlled simulations, without even accounting for the substantial expense of generating such data. Finally, on an emulator trained from historical ERA5 reanalysis, where no counterfactual reference exists, ReRoute preserves substantially more of the surface warming implied by the observed boundary conditions under a fixed-CO$_2$ counterfactual.

AI.tldr: 提出ReRoute框架，无需受控干预数据即可实现科学反事实预测，在气候模拟中将误差降低18.2-31.8%。
AI.motivation: 科学问题常需推理未观测的反事实情形，但模型在相关输入被独立变动时容易失败。常用补救是加入受控仿真数据，但这依赖模拟器、计算昂贵且继承其建模假设。
AI.method: ReRoute结合事实数据与部分机制知识：将预训练骨干的查询输入固定为参考值，通过已知机制通路重新引入其变化，并在原始事实数据上微调，下游效应留给学习到的动态。提供因果可识别性结果，核心论证在Lean中机器验证。
AI.result: 在平流-扩散系统中实现高精度反事实预测；在气候模拟中，严重CO2分布偏移下聚合气候误差降低18.2-31.8%，标准条件下保持性能，成本远低于受控仿真重训练；在ERA5训练模拟器上保留更多由边界条件隐含的地表升温。
AI.conclusion: ReRoute为科学反事实预测提供了经济有效的方法，无需受控干预数据即可适配，具有良好的理论保证与实证效果。

title: World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth
summary: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks. Frontier coding agents already exhibit substantial world-editing capability: the strongest configuration solves 78.2% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion, while criterion-level performance reaches 94.8%. Reliability generally decreases with intervention depth, and this pattern persists even among tasks with similar numbers of evaluation criteria. Most failed edits still build and load successfully, suggesting that the main difficulty is making the edited world behave as requested. Visual consistency remains a separate weakness, with all evaluated configurations below 50% joint visual pass rate. These results show that world editing is a distinct capability from world generation and interaction, and that executable games provide a practical testbed for studying it.

AI.tldr: 本文将"世界编辑"形式化为在保留不变属性的前提下对已有可执行世界进行干预，提出"干预深度"概念，并通过游戏模组化构建IGMWorld与IGMBench（Minecraft/Terraria共110任务、1.1K+可执行标准）。前沿编程智能体表现强劲（任务级78.2%、标准级94.8%），但可靠性随干预深度下降，视觉一致性普遍低于50%。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型已能生成环境并在其中行动，但对"刻意编辑现有可执行世界"这一能力研究不足。本文旨在将世界编辑确立为独立能力，并指出可执行游戏是研究它的实用试验台。
AI.method: 将世界编辑定义为在保留应不变属性的同时干预已有世界，提出"干预深度"作为刻画编辑对实体、动态与系统耦合强度的维度。通过工业级游戏模组化实例化该能力，构建IGMWorld与IGMBench：跨Minecraft和Terraria的110个任务、逾1.1K可执行状态与行为标准，覆盖属性、实体、动态、系统四类干预，采用确定性可执行性、行为、保持性与视觉检查进行评估。
AI.result: 最强配置在严格任务级标准下解决78.2%任务，标准级达94.8%。可靠性随干预深度增加而下降，且该趋势在评估标准数量相近的任务中依然存在。多数失败编辑仍能成功构建与加载，说明主要难点在于让编辑后的世界按请求运行。视觉一致性是独立短板，所有配置的联合视觉通过率均低于50%。
AI.conclusion: 世界编辑是与世界生成和交互不同的独立能力，可执行游戏为其研究提供了实用试验台。

title: Learning When to Commit from Partial Speech for End-to-End Simultaneous Speech Translation
summary: Simultaneous speech translation must emit useful target text before the source is complete while preserving every committed token. We adapt a full-utterance speech language model using prefix supervision derived from its own complete- and partial-waveform translations, requiring neither transcripts nor human translations. We compare single-turn forced-prefix and multi-turn append-only decoding, use a confidence threshold to control the inference-time quality--latency trade-off, and vary the density of training prefixes with a separate synthesis margin. On FLEURS and CoVoST2 in three language directions, prefix training improves quality--latency frontiers over the unadapted model, and confidence provides the broadest consistently competitive operating range. Multi-turn decoding is generally stronger at low latency; under multi-turn training, commit-calibration error falls by 63--68% overall and 68--80% at early prefixes, whereas single-turn training provides only modest overall calibration gains and no early-prefix improvement. A small synthesis margin sometimes extends the frontier to lower latency, particularly on shorter utterances, while a larger margin degrades translation quality and calibration. Prefix adaptation therefore improves simultaneous speech translation, especially under multi-turn append-only decoding, while synthesis density introduces a non-monotonic quality--latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过前缀监督适配全句语音语言模型实现同声传译，无需转写或人工翻译，并比较单轮强制前缀与多轮追加式解码，利用置信度阈值控制质量-延迟权衡。
AI.motivation: 同声传译需在源语未完成时输出有用目标文本，同时保证已提交词元不可更改，且传统方法依赖转写或人工翻译标注。
AI.method: 用模型自身完整与部分波形翻译生成前缀监督，适配全句语音语言模型；比较单轮强制前缀与多轮追加式解码；用置信度阈值控制推理时质量-延迟权衡；以独立合成边际改变训练前缀密度。
AI.result: 在FLEURS和CoVoST2三个语言方向上，前缀训练改善质量-延迟前沿。多轮解码低延迟更强；多轮训练使commit-calibration误差整体下降63-68%，早期前缀下降68-80%，单轮训练仅有有限整体校准增益且无早期前缀改善。小合成边际有时将前沿延伸至更低延迟，尤其短句，大边际则降低翻译质量与校准。
AI.conclusion: 前缀适配可改善同声传译，尤其在多轮追加式解码下；合成密度引入非单调的质量-延迟权衡。

title: FactorSplat: Appearance-Controllable Gaussian Proxies for Medical Volume Rendering
summary: Transfer functions (TFs) control color and visibility in medical volume rendering, but image-trained Gaussian proxies typically bake one transfer function into their appearance. We present FactorSplat, a per-scene N-dimensional Gaussian splatting (N-DGS) proxy that accepts region-specific intensity-to-RGBA curves at inference. A local lookup applies the authored color and opacity change, while a shared functional encoder and low-rank per-Gaussian factors learn the residual appearance response. Geometry and directional appearance remain shared across presets, with visibility control and TF-aware pruning preserving the ability to hide and reveal structures. On seven CT and MR scans, FactorSplat improves mean PSNR and changed-region error over region-aware VEG across validation, interpolation, unseen composition, and out-of-distribution (OOD) edits. Across these four splits, seven-scan mean PSNR gains over VEG range from 1.10 to 1.52 dB. One checkpoint per scan supports unseen edits without retraining. At $1600^2$, the cached fast renderer averages 524 FPS with 1.17 ms TF switches. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/FactorSplat/.

AI.tldr: FactorSplat 提出一种每场景的 N 维高斯泼溅代理，支持推理时按区域指定强度到 RGBA 的传输函数曲线，无需重新训练即可编辑颜色与可见性。
AI.motivation: 医学体渲染中传输函数（TF）控制颜色和可见性，但现有基于图像训练的高斯代理通常把单一 TF 固化进外观，无法在推理时灵活更换，且几何与方向外观被绑定，缺乏编辑能力。
AI.method: 采用每场景 N 维高斯泼溅（N-DGS）代理；通过局部查找应用作者设定的颜色与不透明度变化，同时用共享功能编码器和低秩每高斯因子学习残差外观响应；几何与方向外观在各预设间共享，并加入可见性控制与 TF 感知剪枝以保持隐藏/显示结构的能力。
AI.result: 在七个 CT 和 MR 扫描上，相比区域感知 VEG，在验证、插值、未见组合和 OOD 编辑四种划分上均提升平均 PSNR 与变化区域误差，PSNR 增益为 1.10 到 1.52 dB；每扫描仅需一个检查点即可支持未见编辑；$1600^2$ 分辨率下缓存快速渲染器平均 524 FPS，TF 切换耗时 1.17 ms。
AI.conclusion: FactorSplat 实现了推理时可编辑传输函数的医学体渲染代理，在多种泛化设定下优于 VEG，兼顾实时渲染与快速 TF 切换，每扫描单检查点即可支持未见编辑。

title: Query-aware routing for Cross-lingual performance gains in Encoders
summary: Multilingual encoders can exhibit reduced retrieval effectiveness when queries and relevant documents differ in language, despite strong same-language performance. We investigate whether Finnish and Swedish cross-lingual retrieval can improve while preserving an encoder's existing same-language performance and document index. We combine a query-only low-rank adapter, trained against frozen document embeddings, with deterministic routing based on query and index languages. Cross-language queries use the adapter, while same-language queries use the original encoder. SampoTron, our fine-tuned low-rank (LoRA) adapter alongwith the Nemotron-3-Embed-1B model, improves average retrieval quality across six English, Finnish, and Swedish directions from 0.241 to 0.291 in normalized discounted cumulative gain (nDCG) at rank ten, a 20.9% relative gain on a sampled financial benchmark. All six cross-lingual directions improve, and routing preserves the original same-language performance, including two full-corpus Finnish evaluations. The approach enables selective cross-language specialization with reusable document embedding vectors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SampoTron：一个仅查询端的LoRA适配器，结合基于查询与索引语言的确定性路由，在保留单语检索性能与文档索引的同时显著提升芬兰语-瑞典语跨语言检索效果。
AI.motivation: 多语言编码器在跨语言检索（查询与文档语言不同）时效果明显下降，而现有方法（如重编码文档或全量微调）会破坏已有单语性能与可复用的文档索引。
AI.method: 以冻结的文档嵌入训练仅作用于查询端的低秩（LoRA）适配器，并设计确定性路由：跨语言查询走适配器，同语言查询走原始编码器。基于Nemotron-3-Embed-1B构建SampoTron。
AI.result: 在英/芬/瑞六种方向采样的金融基准上，平均nDCG@10从0.241提升至0.291（相对提升20.9%）；六个跨语言方向全部改善，路由机制使原始单语性能保持不变（含两次全语料芬兰语评测）。
AI.conclusion: 该方案实现了选择性的跨语言特化，不牺牲单语性能且可复用文档向量，为多语言检索提供了低成本、可扩展的改进路径。

title: Self-Repairing Recurrent Ensembles for Real-Time Recovery from Distribution Shift
summary: Deploying a pretrained controller exposes it to conditions that are absent from its training data. Sensor drift, outright sensor failure and accumulating measurement noise all induce a distribution shift that can collapse an otherwise competent policy; typically at a point in time where no expert is available to supply corrective labels. We present a method that lets a policy recover from such shifts online and without supervision. Our controller is an ensemble of recurrent networks, each of which observes a randomly masked subset of the observation vector, and whose Gaussian outputs are combined through sequential Kalman fusion so that confident members dominate the consensus action. At deployment, we treat this consensus as a self-supervised label and fine-tune each member towards it, scaling each member's contribution proportional to the complement of its squared Kalman gain. Gradients are computed using RFLO, an efficient and biologically plausible approximation of Real-Time Recurrent Learning, so that a parameter update follows every environment step and the policy reacts to a shift as it unfolds. On a range of simulated continuous control tasks, our approach recovers close to the original performance after a sensor shift, while ensembles that see the full observation are unable to recover. The same framework subsumes fully online interactive imitation learning: when an expert is present, the consensus label is replaced by the expert action and the identical update rule refines the policy during teleoperation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无监督在线恢复策略：用随机掩码观测的循环网络集成+卡尔曼融合生成共识动作作为自监督标签，结合RFLO即时微调，使控制器在传感器漂移/失效/噪声下恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练控制器部署时面临传感器漂移、失效、噪声等分布偏移，且偏移发生时通常无专家提供纠正标签，可能导致策略崩溃。
AI.method: 控制器为循环网络集成，每成员观测随机掩码的观测子集；其高斯输出经序贯卡尔曼融合，置信成员主导共识动作。部署时将共识作为自监督标签微调各成员，权重按(1-卡尔曼增益平方)缩放；用RFLO（Real-Time Recurrent Learning的高效、生物可行近似）计算梯度，每步环境更新一次参数。
AI.result: 在多种模拟连续控制任务上，方法在传感器偏移后恢复到接近原始性能，而观察完整观测的集成无法恢复。同一框架也涵盖全在线交互式模仿学习：有专家时用专家动作替换共识标签，相同更新规则在遥操作中精炼策略。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了无监督、在线的策略恢复，可统一处理传感器分布偏移与交互式模仿学习。

title: VeriPy Source-Preserving Verification and Compatibility Checking for Python Components
summary: Keeping a Python program and its formal guarantees aligned is a continuing maintenance problem. Specifications must describe the implementation that actually runs, and updates must preserve the behavior on which existing callers depend. VeriPy brings these obligations into a common workflow for annotated Python components. Developers and agents express contracts, invariants, and proof hooks as Python comments, then refine checked auxiliary lemmas using source-located diagnostics. Direct encoders produce Dafny or Lean artifacts while retaining admitted executable bodies and explicit models of their dependencies. A relational product checks whether an updated component still admits old inputs and preserves returned values and modeled exceptions. The resulting workflow connects source-level proof development with functional verification and backward compatibility, recording the assumptions under which each guarantee applies. The code is available at https://github.com/astrio-labs/veripy.

AI.tldr: VeriPy 提出一个统一工作流，将 Python 程序的契约、不变式和证明钩子以注释形式表达，并通过直接编码生成 Dafny 或 Lean 工件，支持源码级证明开发、功能验证与向后兼容性检查。
AI.motivation: 维护 Python 程序与其形式化保证的一致性是持续的维护难题：规范需描述实际运行的实现，且更新必须保持既有调用者所依赖的行为。
AI.method: 开发者与智能体以 Python 注释表达契约、不变式与证明钩子，并利用源定位诊断精化辅助引理；直接编码器生成 Dafny 或 Lean 工件，保留可执行体与依赖模型；通过关系积检查更新组件是否仍接受旧输入并保持返回值与建模异常，记录各保证所依赖的假设。
AI.result: 该工作流连接了源码级证明开发、功能验证与向后兼容性，代码已开源于 https://github.com/astrio-labs/veripy。
AI.conclusion: VeriPy 为标注化 Python 组件提供了统一的形式化保证维护工作流，兼顾证明开发与向后兼容验证。

title: Approximation Property of Dropout Neural Networks: Sobolev Rates and Confidence Bounds
summary: The universal approximation property of dropout neural networks does not by itself describe the network size required for an accurate random realization. In this work, we study approximation of the unit ball of $W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$ by ReLU networks whose edges are retained independently with probability $p$. The approximation error is measured uniformly over the input domain, and the guarantee holds with probability at least $1-δ$ for a single sampled network. We construct networks of constant depth and size $\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}} \log(1/δ))$. The construction combines bounded local subnetworks, localization on a successful approximation event, and a multiscale Taylor decomposition. Conversely, Sobolev capacity imposes a lower bound on the number of surviving edges, while approximation of a fixed affine function requires an output-layer cost of order $((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ)$ at sufficiently high confidence. For fixed $p\in(0,1)$ and $δ<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$, the upper and lower bounds match in the accuracy exponent under a fixed or logarithmic depth budget. When $d\leq2n$, they also match in confidence up to logarithms of accuracy. We extend the lower bounds to $W^{n,r}$ targets with $L^s$ error, and distinguish this extension from the upper bound for $W^{n,\infty}$. The optimal retention dependence and logarithmic factors remain open.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究带随机边保留（dropout）的ReLU网络对Sobolev球$W^{n,\infty}([0,1]^d)$的统一逼近，给出高概率下常数深度网络的规模上界，并建立匹配的下界（在精度指数意义下）。
AI.motivation: 通用逼近性质无法刻画随机实现达到给定精度所需的网络规模；因此需要在单个采样网络、高概率保证的意义下，研究dropout网络的逼近误差与规模、保留概率$p$、置信度$\delta$之间的关系。
AI.method: 对边独立以概率$p$保留的ReLU网络，构造常数深度、规模为$\widetilde O_{n,d}(p^{-9}\varepsilon^{-\max\{d/n,2\}}\log(1/\delta))$的网络；技术包括有界局部子网络、在成功逼近事件上的局部化，以及多尺度Taylor分解。下界方面使用Sobolev容量约束存活边数，并分析固定仿射函数逼近所需的输出层代价。
AI.result: 构造的网络以至少$1-\delta$概率实现统一逼近；Sobolev容量给出存活边数下界，仿射函数逼近需输出层代价$\Theta(((1-p)/p)\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/\delta))$。对固定$p\in(0,1)$、$\delta<\min\{1/2,1-p\}$，在固定或对数深度预算下上下界精度指数匹配；当$d\le 2n$时置信度依赖也在精度对数范围内匹配。下界还推广到$W^{n,r}$目标与$L^s$误差。
AI.conclusion: dropout网络的随机实现规模由上界与下界共同刻画，在给定条件下达到精度指数最优；最优的保留概率依赖与对数因子仍为开放问题，且$W^{n,r}$/$L^s$下界扩展与$W^{n,\infty}$上界存在区别。

title: A Multi Method Importance and Performance Efficiency Analysis of Topological Metrics for Natural Visibility Graph Based Cyber Attack Detection
summary: Natural Visibility Graph (NVG) based analysis characterizes network traffic through topological descriptors reflecting different structural properties. However, not all descriptors contribute equally to cyber-attack classification, and extracting a large metric set can increase computational cost. This study evaluates 21 NVG derived topological metrics and investigates whether a compact subset can preserve classification capability while improving computational efficiency. Four importance analysis methods SHAP, grouped Permutation Importance, Boruta, and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) are integrated through a Consensus Ranking strategy. Based on this ranking, Full21, Top15, Top10, Top7, Top5, and Top3 configurations are evaluated using the CICIDS2018 dataset, a CNN classifier, and stratified 5 fold cross validation. The three highest ranked metrics are avg_clustering_coeff_median, avg_clustering_coeff_std, and avg_clustering_coeff_mean. Top3 achieved the highest observed mean performance, with 97.148% accuracy, 97.055% weighted F1 score, and an MCC of 0.9675, compared with 95.999%, 95.521%, and 0.9549 for Full21, respectively. It also reduced total runtime from 14,961.39 s to 589.22 s (96.06%). These results indicate that importance guided metric reduction can provide a compact NVG representation with higher observed mean predictive performance and substantially lower computational cost under the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 本文评估21个NVG网络拓扑指标，采用SHAP、分组排列重要性、Boruta、RFE四种方法并通过共识排序筛选特征，发现Top3指标在CICIDS2018上用CNN分类可达到比全部21指标更高的性能，并将运行时间降低96%。
AI.motivation: NVG分析会产生大量拓扑指标，但并非所有指标对网络攻击分类都有同等贡献，提取过多指标会增加计算成本。因此需要研究能否用精简的指标子集在保持甚至提升分类能力的同时降低计算开销。
AI.method: 评估21个NVG拓扑指标，集成SHAP、分组排列重要性、Boruta和递归特征消除(RFE)四种重要性分析方法，通过共识排序(Consensus Ranking)生成指标排名。基于该排名构建Full21、Top15、Top10、Top7、Top5、Top3六种配置，在CICIDS2018数据集上使用CNN分类器和分层5折交叉验证进行评测。
AI.result: 排名最高的三个指标为avg_clustering_coeff_median、avg_clustering_coeff_std和avg_clustering_coeff_mean。Top3配置取得最高平均性能：准确率97.148%、加权F1为97.055%、MCC为0.9675，而Full21分别为95.999%、95.521%和0.9549。同时总运行时间从14,961.39秒降至589.22秒，减少96.06%。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的设置下，基于重要性引导的指标精简能够提供紧凑的NVG表示，并获得更高的平均预测性能和显著更低的计算成本。

title: Large Language Continuous Diffusion Models
summary: Despite the success of discrete diffusion language models (dLMs) for fast parallel decoding, their non-smooth, high-dimensional space hinders trajectory steering for reasoning and inference acceleration. To overcome this, we present Sigma, the first large-scale (3B/8B) continuous dLM built on steerable, low-dimensional ODE/SDE latent trajectories. Trained blockwise via likelihood optimization, Sigma jointly denoises Gaussian-corrupted token embeddings while learning an optimal embedding geometry. To accelerate training, Sigma leverages pre-trained weights from autoregressive (AR) models for warm-starting. During inference, we identify classifier-free guidance and score temperature as essential for high-fidelity reasoning and coding. Across comprehensive math reasoning and coding evaluations against state-of-the-art discrete counterparts (masked dLMs and AR baselines), Sigma achieves competitive performance with discrete models on standard benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, Minerva, HumanEval, MBPP) after pre-training and on challenging reasoning tasks (e.g., MATH-500, AIME) after supervised fine-tuning. Beyond performance parity, we uncover key structural properties unique to continuous dLMs: (i) embedding-space steering effectively governs the quality-diversity trade-off, yielding strong pass@k performance and (ii) continuous trajectories enable graceful degradation for low NFEs and efficient distillation. These establish continuous dLMs as a promising paradigm for efficient language generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sigma，首个大规模（3B/8B）连续扩散语言模型，基于可操控的低维ODE/SDE潜轨迹，在数学推理和代码任务上达到与离散模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型虽支持快速并行解码，但其非光滑、高维空间阻碍了轨迹操控，影响推理和推理加速。
AI.method: Sigma建立于可操控的低维ODE/SDE潜轨迹上，按块进行似然优化训练，联合去噪高斯扰动的token嵌入并学习最优嵌入几何；利用自回归模型预训练权重热启动加速训练；推理时采用无分类器引导和分数温度。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、Minerva、HumanEval、MBPP等标准基准上与最先进离散模型（掩码dLM和AR基线）竞争，在MATH-500、AIME等困难推理任务上表现优异；嵌入空间操控可调控质量-多样性权衡，带来强pass@k表现，并支持低NFE下的优雅退化和高效蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 连续扩散语言模型在性能持平的基础上展现出独特结构优势，是高效语言生成的有前景范式。

title: Octrees as an Explicit 3D Language
summary: Existing 3D large language models (LLMs) compromise on two fronts: they compress shapes into latent codebook indices or coordinate text, which removes spatial structure from what the model observes, and they acquire the 3D modality by fine-tuning the backbone, which overwrites its general language ability. We present OctLLM, which addresses both limitations. Geometry enters as an explicit 3D sequence of octree occupancy tokens. However, full octree sequences grow rapidly with depth; OctLLM therefore randomly empties penultimate-level nodes and omits descendants while preserving shape, yielding a shorter coordinate- and depth-anchored Sparse Octree (S-Octree) for position-aware mask-modeling generation and 3D understanding. On the other front, existing methods introduce a new modality with full fine-tuning or LoRA, but full fine-tuning is costly, LoRA limits 3D capacity, and both modify the language pathway. OctLLM instead adds 3D capacity in parameters separate from the pretrained ones: mesh tokens are routed through independent trainable branches in a subset of blocks while text and image tokens retain the frozen vision-language pathway, and the two streams interact through shared self-attention. It trains far fewer parameters than full fine-tuning, yet sets a new state of the art among unified multimodal LLMs, lowering image-to-3D FID by $17.4\%$ and raising render-grounded captioning by $28.7$ points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone on general language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: OctLLM提出用显式稀疏八叉树占用token序列表示3D几何，并通过独立可训练分支注入3D能力，在冻结视觉-语言通路的同时实现SOTA统一多模态性能。
AI.motivation: 现有3D大语言模型存在两大缺陷：将形状压缩为潜码本索引或坐标文本，丢失空间结构；且通过微调骨干网络获取3D模态，破坏其通用语言能力。
AI.method: 1) 几何以八叉树占用token的显式3D序列输入；2) 通过随机清空倒数第二层节点并省略后代，生成坐标与深度锚定的稀疏八叉树S-Octree，用于位置感知掩码建模生成与3D理解；3) 参数上分离3D容量：mesh token经由部分block中独立可训练分支，文本与图像token保留冻结的视觉-语言通路，两流经共享自注意力交互。
AI.result: 训练参数远少于全量微调，却在统一多模态LLM中取得新SOTA：相比ShapeLLM-Omni，image-to-3D FID降低17.4%，渲染基础captioning提升28.7分，同时在通用语言基准上与骨干持平。
AI.conclusion: OctLLM通过显式稀疏八叉树序列表示与参数隔离的3D分支设计，同时解决空间结构丢失和语言能力退化问题，实现高效且性能领先的3D多模态LLM。

title: MRVQ: One Resident Index for Dimension- and Rate-Elastic Vector Search
summary: Dense-retrieval services must switch among embedding-prefix dimensions and index bit rates as latency, quality, and memory budgets change. Tuning a quantizer separately for each rate gives the best quality, but the retrieval tier then holds several code streams and quantizer states at once. We introduce Matryoshka Residual Vector Quantization (MRVQ), a post-hoc residual quantizer for frozen embeddings. Its maximum-rate code can be truncated two ways: dropping residual stages lowers the rate, and dropping embedding coordinates lowers the dimension. One resident artifact therefore serves every (dimension, rate) pair we evaluate. Across FiQA and NFCorpus, four embedding families, and {4, 8, 16}-byte codes, MRVQ is the lowest-RAM design we evaluate. It uses 17.8-22.0x less memory than three separately trained QINCo2 indices, and 1.89-2.02x less than a lean shared-model steelman. The saving is not free: per-rate QINCo2 is 0.026-0.107 nDCG@10 better on FiQA. But MRVQ beats PQ, OPQ, and AdANNS-OPQ at matched code size. We also evaluate a low-build-cost PCA-scalar design that attains quality comparable to RaBitQ and its extension while fitting 420x faster at the median. Finally, we report two negative results: QINCo2 collapses when trained at high rates, and a ranking-bound hypothesis misses its pre-specified acceptance criteria. MRVQ is therefore a low-memory operating point for elastic retrieval, not a universal quality winner.

AI.tldr: 提出MRVQ（套娃残差向量量化），一种面向冻结嵌入的post-hoc残差量化器，其最高码率码可通过丢弃残差阶段降码率、丢弃嵌入坐标降维度，单一常驻产物服务所有(维度,码率)组合。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索服务需随延迟、质量、内存预算变化切换嵌入前缀维度与索引比特率。逐码率单独调优量化器质量最佳，但检索层需同时保存多个码流与量化器状态，内存开销大。目标是找到低内存的弹性检索工作点。
AI.method: MRVQ为post-hoc残差量化：对冻结嵌入训练，最大码率码可两向截断（丢残差阶段降码率、丢坐标降维度），故一份常驻产物覆盖所有(维度,码率)对。基线包括逐码率QINCo2、共享模型steelman、PQ/OPQ/AdANNS-OPQ，以及低构建成本PCA-scalar设计；在FiQA、NFCorpus、4个嵌入家族、{4,8,16}字节码上评测。
AI.result: MRVQ为所评RAM最低设计：比三个单独训练的QINCo2索引省17.8-22.0x内存，比精简共享模型steelman省1.89-2.02x。但逐码率QINCo2在FiQA上nDCG@10高0.026-0.107。匹配码长下MRVQ优于PQ、OPQ、AdANNS-OPQ。PCA-scalar质量可比RaBitQ及其扩展，中位构建快420x。两个负面结果：QINCo2高码率训练崩溃；排序界假设未达预设接受标准。
AI.conclusion: MRVQ是弹性检索的低内存工作点，而非通用质量赢家。省内存有代价（质量略逊逐码率QINCo2），但匹配码长下优于常见量化基线。

title: The Investment Acceleration Principle Revisited by means of a Neural Network
summary: The investment acceleration principle is a heuristic for modelling investment time series out of consumption time series. The model presented herein develops a disaggregated accelerator equation whose coefficients are the weights of a Kohonen neural net that represents firms' decision-making. According to this model, investments take place when managers recognise emerging technological patterns. Furthermore, a technique borrowed from the theory of self-organising systems is used in order to disentangle innovation-driven investments from plant-replication investments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Kohonen神经网络的分解式加速投资模型，用自组织系统方法区分创新驱动型投资与工厂复制型投资。
AI.motivation: 投资加速原理常被用于从消费时间序列建模投资时间序列，但传统模型较为宏观和加总，无法反映企业决策机制及不同投资动机的差异。
AI.method: 将加速方程分解，其系数设为代表企业决策的Kohonen神经网络权重；当管理者识别出新兴技术模式时即触发投资；并借用自组织系统理论的方法区分创新驱动投资与工厂复制投资。
AI.result: 模型提供了一个把投资行为与管理者对技术模式的识别相联系的机制，并能将两类投资进行分解。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将神经网络决策与投资加速原理结合，为投资时间序列建模及创新投资识别提供了新思路。

title: Discriminating Fixture Coverage in Agent-Infrastructure Verification Suites
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: Invariant suites and runtime monitors increasingly gate agent deployment decisions, and the evidence offered for any particular suite is almost always a single observation: it passes an implementation believed correct and fails one believed broken. We measure what that observation is worth. Applying mutation analysis to an invariant suite for a multi-session agent state-projection layer, we first find that this standard validation certifies a suite in which a first-order mutant removing event-identity deduplication survives every check. We then freeze the repaired twelve-check suite, record its hash, and run it once against ten mutants specified by an adversarial reader who designed none of its fixtures: it kills five. Instrumenting the five survivors against the reference shows they fail in two distinct ways, not one. Three are never activated, because no fixture supplies an input on which the mutated code behaves differently at all. The other two corrupt internal state that no oracle in the suite can observe. The two modes need different repairs, and neither is visible from a pass/fail report. Treating the missing inputs as a coverage question, we enumerate seven discriminating dimensions of the input space, register in advance which are uncovered and which survivors they should explain, and add one fixture per uncovered dimension while reusing the existing oracles verbatim. All five survivors then die, each to the check written for its predicted dimension. We report this as a repair result on the same challenge set rather than a second held-out estimate, and give the artifact, including the frozen hash, the registered predictions, all mutants and the run logs, so the distinction is checkable.

AI.tldr: 论文通过变异分析评估"不变式套件通过正确实现、失败错误实现"这一单次观察的证明价值，发现标准验证会认证有缺陷的套件；经修复、冻结并针对十个对抗性变异体运行，仅杀死五个，且存活者因未激活或状态不可观测两种不同原因存活；通过七维输入覆盖枚举并各加一个夹具，全部五个存活者被杀死。
AI.motivation: 不变式套件与运行时监控日益决定智能体部署，但对套件的证据几乎总是单次观察（通过一个被认为正确的实现、失败一个被认为错误的实现）。论文要衡量这种"单次观察"到底有多少价值，并检验标准验证是否会认证实际上脆弱的套件。
AI.method: 对多会话智能体状态投影层的不变式套件应用变异分析；发现一阶变异体（移除事件身份去重）能存活所有检查。修复后冻结十二项检查套件并记录哈希，对由未参与设计夹具的对抗性读者指定的十个变异体运行一次。对五个存活者做参照插桩，区分失败模式。将缺失输入视为覆盖问题，枚举七个判别性输入维度，预先登记未覆盖维度及应对应解释的存活者，每个未覆盖维度加一个夹具，复用原有预言（oracle）不变。
AI.result: 标准验证认证的套件中，移除事件身份去重的一阶变异体能存活所有检查。冻结的十二项套件对十个变异体仅杀死五个。五个存活者以两种不同方式失败：三个从未被激活（无夹具提供使变异代码行为不同的输入），两个破坏内部状态而无预言可观测。按预测添加夹具后，五个存活者全部死亡，且各死于为其预测维度编写的检查。
AI.conclusion: 论文将结果报告为"同一挑战集上的修复结果"而非第二次留出估计，并提供包含冻结哈希、登记预测、所有变异体和运行日志的工件，使这一区分可核查。强调单次通过/失败观察不足以证明套件质量，覆盖维度枚举是定位并修复套件盲点的有效途径。

title: Overcoming Challenges of Interpretive Structural Modeling with Large Language Models
comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections
summary: Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) is a well-known process for multi-criteria decision making. The success of ISM over other methodologies is its ability to model causal relationships, the binary scale of factors, and resulting hierarchical representation. Traditionally, the modeling process is performed by repeated interactions with subject matter experts until consensus is reached. This process is tedious, labor-intense, and most importantly limits the ability of ISM to scale to studies with hundreds of variables. Drawing on existing work of causal graph discovery with large language models (LLM) as imperfect experts, this work explores an integrated LLM-ISM approach for ISM. Pairwise, k-wise, rowwise, and full graph discovery methodologies are compared and evaluated. It is shown that causal graph discovery methods for ISM perform best using rowwise (SHD=160, F1-score=0.77) and full graph methods (SHD=135, F1-score=0.73).

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-ISM集成方法，用大语言模型替代专家进行ISM因果图发现，比较四种方法，rowwise与full graph效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 传统ISM需与专家反复交互直到共识，过程繁琐、耗费人力，且难以扩展到含数百变量的研究。
AI.method: 借鉴LLM作为非完美专家进行因果图发现的已有工作，探索LLM-ISM集成方法，对比pairwise、k-wise、rowwise和full graph四种发现方法并评估。
AI.result: rowwise方法表现最佳（SHD=160，F1=0.77），full graph方法次之（SHD=135，F1=0.73）。
AI.conclusion: LLM可有效辅助ISM因果图构建，rowwise和full graph方法最具潜力，有望提升ISM的可扩展性。

title: DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents
summary:
ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. We introduce DeReAct, a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies: a Critic that validates proposed actions before execution, and a Context Manager that reconstructs an environment-supported \textsc{State} and certifies task completion.
  Across GAIA and SWE-bench Verified, DeReAct improves Pass@1 most for weaker Brain models, with gains of 6.5--7.0 points for Qwen3-Coder-480B and 4.2--5.2 points for Claude Sonnet~4.5; gains diminish as Brain capability increases. Trajectory and ablation analyses show that external gating is effective when targeted failures are sufficiently prevalent and the gating policy is itself sufficient. With Claude Opus~4.5, Pass@1 remains comparable to ReAct, while DeReAct produces more evidence-complete and constraint-satisfying trajectories, indicating that completion control can trade earlier termination for stronger grounding. Overall, DeReAct improves weaker agents while retaining grounding benefits as models strengthen.

AI.tldr: DeReAct是一种模块化Agent架构，通过外置Critic（校验动作）和Context Manager（认证完成）两个门控策略，解耦动作授权与完成控制，提升弱模型Pass@1并增强轨迹证据完整性。
AI.motivation: ReAct式Agent依赖单一LLM策略同时负责提出动作、与环境交互和判定任务完成，这种耦合使动作授权与完成控制难以独立执行，导致错误传播以及无依据的完成声明终止执行。
AI.method: 提出DeReAct模块化架构，外置两个门控策略：Critic在执行前验证提议的动作；Context Manager重建环境支持的State并认证任务是否完成。
AI.result: 在GAIA与SWE-bench Verified上，DeReAct对较弱Brain模型提升最大：Qwen3-Coder-480B提升6.5–7.0点，Claude Sonnet 4.5提升4.2–5.2点；随Brain能力增强收益递减。Claude Opus 4.5上Pass@1与ReAct相当，但轨迹更具证据完整性和约束满足性。
AI.conclusion: 外部门控在目标失败足够普遍且门控策略自身充分时有效；DeReAct能提升较弱Agent，并在模型增强时保留grounding收益，说明完成控制可以以更早终止换取更强依据。

title: Silent Dissent: LLM Agents That Yield to the Majority Still Represent Their Original Premise
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary material in ancillary files
summary: Multi-agent debate is increasingly used to reach consensus among LLM agents, yet agents often yield to a unanimous majority. When an agent changes its answer, has it changed its mind or only its statement? We study this with two-hop factual questions whose intermediate entity (the bridge, e.g. the country in "the capital of the country where the Sagrada Familia is located") is never stated by anyone. Scripted peers, in the role of Asch's confederates, unanimously assert a wrong answer taken from another fact with a different bridge. At the moment the agent answers, we read the bridge from its residual stream with the Jacobian lens (J-lens) and, for comparison, the logit lens. In pre-registered tests on held-out facts with four open-weight models, agents of Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-E4B-it that gave in still represented their original bridge in the pre-registered layers below the output (hit@100 above a control entity: 0.85, 0.22 and 0.24), where the logit lens rarely ranked it among the top 100 tokens (0.00-0.06). These agents also represented the bridge behind the peers' answer, beyond a mention baseline. A pre-registered addendum hid the agent's earlier answer or removed it: agents that gave in still represented their original bridge in all four models (0.43, 0.29, 0.37 and 0.25 with the answer hidden), including Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, which barely did so with its answer in view (0.03). The premise can thus be computed from the question alone while the agent states the majority's answer. Hiding the earlier answer also changed conformity: Qwen3.5-4B gave in on 89% of questions instead of 8%. In exploratory interventions, injecting the bridge's J-lens direction brought agents back to their original answer only in the two Qwen models. Stated consensus in multi-agent debate can thus overstate agreement. We also report the negative results of our pre-registered program.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体在多智能体辩论中顺从多数时会口是心非：其内部仍保留原有答案（桥梁实体），即便明确表达了错误立场。用J-lens探测残差流可读到真实信念，logit lens几乎无效。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论被广泛用于让LLM智能体达成共识，但智能体常屈服于一致多数。当智能体改变答案时，它是真的改变了想法，还是只是改变了陈述？本文旨在区分"改变主意"与"改变说法"。
AI.method: 使用两跳事实问题（中间实体"bridge"从未被任何一方提及）。脚本化的同伴充当Asch式从众实验中的同谋，一致断言取自另一事实（不同bridge）的错误答案。在智能体作答时，用Jacobian lens（J-lens）从其残差流中读取bridge，并与logit lens对比。在留出事实上对四个开放权重模型进行预注册测试；另有预注册附录隐藏或移除智能体此前的回答；并做探索性干预（注入bridge的J-lens方向）。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B和Gemma-4-E4B-it中顺从的智能体仍在输出层以下预注册层中表征原有bridge（hit@100高于对照实体：0.85、0.22、0.24），而logit lens很少将其排进前100（0.00–0.06）。这些智能体还表征了同伴答案背后的bridge（超出提及基线）。隐藏先前回答后，四个模型仍表征原有bridge（0.43、0.29、0.37、0.25），包括Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（其答案可见时仅0.03）。隐藏先前回答还改变从众率：Qwen3.5-4B从8%升至89%。探索性干预中，注入bridge的J-lens方向仅使两个Qwen模型回到原答案。
AI.conclusion: 前提可从问题本身计算，而智能体却陈述多数答案；多智能体辩论中的表面共识可能高估了真实一致。文中还报告了预注册程序的负面结果。

title: An AI-Based Multi-Stage Approach for Androgenetic Alopecia Assessment from Low-Magnification Scalp Images
summary: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is characterized by patterned follicular miniaturization, increased single-hair follicular units, and altered hair-shaft diameter. We present an automated quantitative scalp-analysis and clinical decision-support framework combining FU localization, ordinal visible-shaft counting, calibrated shaft-width estimation, regional aggregation, and an interpretable rule layer. The clinical cohort comprised 243 patients (127 AGA, 116 non-AGA), while the computer-vision experiments used 160 expert-annotated patients, 2,400 trichoscopic images, and approximately 158,000 FU annotations. Under patientdisjoint evaluation, YOLOv8m achieved test mAP@0.5=0.920 and recall=0.860; EfficientNet-B5 with a support-map channel achieved 87.0% expert-box count accuracy (macro F1=0.85). A separate 500-image set was processed end-to-end with detector-generated boxes, yielding MAE of 6.56 for follicle detection and 16.59 for follicle classification relative to human-expert annotations. The system is intended to assist, rather than replace, dermatologist interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出一套自动化头皮分析与临床决策支持框架，结合毛囊单位定位、可见毛干计数、校准毛干宽度估计、区域聚合和可解释规则层，用于雄激素性脱发（AGA）的定量评估。
AI.motivation: AGA表现为模式化毛囊微小化、单毛囊单位增多及毛干直径改变，需要客观、自动化的定量分析手段来辅助诊断。
AI.method: 整合毛囊单位（FU）定位、序数可见毛干计数、校准毛干宽度估计、区域聚合及可解释规则层；采用YOLOv8m检测与EfficientNet-B5（带support-map通道）分类。临床队列243例（127 AGA，116非AGA）；视觉实验用160例专家标注、2400张毛镜图像、约158000个FU标注。
AI.result: 患者不重叠评估下，YOLOv8m测试mAP@0.5=0.920、recall=0.860；EfficientNet-B5专家框计数准确率87.0%（宏F1=0.85）。另用500张图像端到端处理，毛囊检测MAE=6.56，毛囊分类MAE=16.59。
AI.conclusion: 该系统定位为辅助而非替代皮肤科医生的判读，可实现AGA的自动化定量头皮分析与临床决策支持。

title: Parallel Time-Aligned Spiking Self-Attention for Consistent Integer-Valued Training and Spike-Driven Inference
summary: Integer-valued leaky integrate-and-fire (I-LIF) neurons and spike firing approximation (SFA) reduce temporal training cost by representing spike trains as firing counts and normalized firing rates, respectively. However, applying spiking self-attention (SSA) directly to these compressed query, key, and value representations introduces cross-time interactions that are absent during spike-driven inference. We term this operator-level discrepancy Temporal Interaction Mismatch (TIM). We propose Parallel Time-Aligned Spiking Self-Attention (PT-SSA), which reconstructs consecutive virtual spike slices from either I-LIF counts or SFA firing rates, computes attention only between time-aligned slices in parallel, and sums the per-step outputs. To accommodate the reduced attention output scale under SFA, we further introduce Adaptive PT-SSA, which learns a positive per-block rescaling before the output SFA neuron to improve firing-level utilization. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-1K show that the proposed methods substantially reduce train--inference mismatch. On CIFAR-100 with I-LIF, PT-SSA reduces the mean Top-1 gap from 1.85 to 0.29 percentage points. On ImageNet-1K, Adaptive PT-SSA reduces the Top-1 gap from 27.78 to 0.06 percentage points and achieves 74.53\% spike-driven Top-1 accuracy. A Triton-fused PT-SSA training kernel retains a $2.91\times$ throughput advantage over recurrent LIF SSA.

AI.tldr: 提出PT-SSA与Adaptive PT-SSA，解决时序交互不匹配(TIM)问题，显著降低SNN训练-推理精度差距。
AI.motivation: I-LIF与SFA通过将脉冲序列压缩为发放计数/归一化发放率来降低时序训练成本，但将SSA直接作用于压缩后的QKV会引入推理时不存在的跨时间交互，即TIM问题。
AI.method: PT-SSA从I-LIF计数或SFA发放率重建连续虚拟脉冲切片，仅对时间对齐切片并行计算注意力并对各步输出求和；Adaptive PT-SSA进一步学习正的分块重缩放以利用SFA下缩小的注意力输出尺度。
AI.result: CIFAR-100+I-LIF上PT-SSA将平均Top-1差距从1.85降至0.29个百分点；ImageNet-1K上Adaptive PT-SSA将Top-1差距从27.78降至0.06个百分点，达到74.53%脉冲驱动Top-1精度；Triton融合训练核保持2.91倍吞吐优势。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效缓解训练-推理不匹配，在多个数据集上大幅缩小精度差距，同时保持高效训练。

title: GTDD: Generative Test-Driven Development for AI Coding Agents with Adversarial Testing
summary: Test-driven development gives AI coding agents executable requirements for implementing software. Because these agents can adapt their implementations to the examples they observe, passing a predetermined collection of tests can leave substantial parts of the intended behavior unimplemented. We propose Generative Test-Driven Development (GTDD), a formulation of test-driven development in which a separate testing agent generates new inputs after each candidate implementation is fixed, using a human-specified behavioral contract and the feedback from earlier rounds. A trusted evaluator checks these inputs, returns reduced counterexamples to the coding agent, and saves them for regression testing, so development continually confronts failures beyond the initial examples. We characterize the evidence that this process provides through a finite-population analysis of false acceptance under adaptive candidate selection. The resulting bounds quantify how test visibility and repeated feedback affect acceptance, and show that fresh random audits after candidate commitment control false acceptance across development rounds. In a paired experiment on a stateful key-value store, both policies that regenerated tests during development ended with lower mean failure rates than the policy whose tests were generated once by the same language model, and giving the tester the candidate's source produced no detectable additional improvement. Further conditions requesting equal numbers of tests did not isolate any single feature of the policies as the source of this difference. GTDD combines this adaptive development feedback with established regression tests and an independent acceptance rule.

AI.tldr: 论文提出生成式测试驱动开发（GTDD）：由独立测试智能体在每轮实现固定后生成新测试输入，并用可信评估器筛选反例进行回归测试，从而在适应性实现下控制误接受。
AI.motivation: AI 编码代理会根据观察到的测试样例调整实现，因此仅通过一组预先给定的测试，可能仍有大量预期行为未被实现。需要一种机制持续暴露初始样例之外的新失败。
AI.method: GTDD 中，测试代理依据人类指定的行为契约和早期轮次反馈，为每个候选实现生成新输入；可信评估器检查这些输入，将缩减后的反例返回给编码代理并保存用于回归测试。作者用有限总体分析刻画自适应候选选择下的误接受证据，量化测试可见性与重复反馈的影响，并论证候选提交后的新鲜随机审计可控制跨轮误接受。在有状态键值存储上进行配对实验，比较一次性生成测试与开发过程中重新生成测试的策略，并测试向测试者提供候选源代码、等量测试等条件。
AI.result: 在有状态键值存储实验中，两种在开发过程中重新生成测试的策略，其平均失败率均低于由同一语言模型一次性生成测试的策略；向测试者提供候选源代码未带来可检测的额外改进；在要求测试数量相等的条件下，未能将差异归因于任一单一策略特征。
AI.conclusion: GTDD 将自适应开发反馈、既有回归测试和独立验收规则结合，通过持续生成并缩减反例、辅以候选提交后的随机审计，可在适应性候选选择下限制误接受，提升对预期行为的覆盖。

title: MACTS-EM: Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory
summary: Time series forecasting remains a critical challenge across numerous domains. Despite significant advancements, existing approaches struggle with complex phenomena such as regime shifts, cross-domain knowledge transfer, and multimodal data integration. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Collaborative Time Series Forecasting with Emergent Memory (MACTS-EM), a novel framework where specialised agents collaborate to achieve superior forecasting performance. The MACTS-EM architecture integrates: (1) domain-specialised forecasting agents for pattern recognition, anomaly detection, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification; (2) a meta-cognitive layer for dynamic agent allocation; (3) an emergent memory mechanism enabling cross-domain pattern transfer; (4) multimodal contextual integration; and (5) adversarial robustness components. Evaluation across financial markets, climate patterns, energy consumption, and pandemic propagation demonstrates that MACTS-EM outperforms existing approaches in most scenarios, with 8-12% improvement in forecasting accuracy, 22-27% better zero-shot transfer capability, 16-21% enhanced resilience during regime shifts, and 15-18% faster recovery after distribution shifts. Our findings suggest that collaborative, agentic approaches to time series forecasting represent a promising direction beyond traditional architectures, particularly for complex real-world scenarios requiring multi-resolution temporal understanding and contextual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出MACTS-EM多智能体协作时间序列预测框架，通过专门化智能体、元认知层、涌现记忆、多模态集成与对抗鲁棒性提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法难以应对regime shifts、跨域知识迁移和多模态数据集成等复杂现象。
AI.method: MACTS-EM架构包含五个组件：(1)领域专门化预测智能体（模式识别、异常检测、因果推断、不确定性量化）；(2)元认知层进行动态智能体分配；(3)涌现记忆机制实现跨域模式迁移；(4)多模态上下文集成；(5)对抗鲁棒性组件。
AI.result: 在金融市场、气候模式、能源消耗和疫情传播等场景评估，多数情形优于现有方法：预测精度提升8-12%，零样本迁移能力提升22-27%，regime shifts下韧性提升16-21%，分布偏移后恢复速度提升15-18%。
AI.conclusion: 协作式智能体方法为时间序列预测提供了超越传统架构的有前景方向，尤其适用于需要多分辨率时间理解与上下文适应的复杂现实场景。

title: Traversing the Satisfaction-Diversity Frontier in Text-to-Image Diffusion
summary: Text-to-image generation enables users to explore several images generated from the same prompt. For these generated images to be useful, each one must reflect the user's preferences, measured by a learned reward, and differ visually from the others to maintain diversity. Existing methods are limited: they either address reward and diversity separately or combine them in one aggregate score, enabling high diversity to offset low rewards. In this paper, we address these limitations by formulating generation as satisficing: every image (candidate) must satisfy a reward floor and the batch of images must satisfy a diversity cutoff. The reward floor controls the balance between worst-candidate reward and batch diversity; we show that varying this floor defines a Pareto frontier. To traverse this frontier, we introduce SatisDive, a training-free inference-time method. SatisDive uses a batch-relative reward cutoff to distinguish lower- from higher-reward candidates, emphasizing reward improvement for candidates below the cutoff and diversity among candidates above it. On Pick-a-Pic, at matched DreamSim, SatisDive improves worst-candidate reward over FK steering by up to 0.43 with FLUX.1-dev as the base model and HPSv3 as the reward, and by up to 0.70 with SANA-1.6B as the base model and ImageReward as the reward. More broadly, across their overlapping DreamSim ranges, SatisDive's satisfaction-diversity curve Pareto-dominates FK steering's curve in each setting.

AI.tldr: 提出将文生图生成建模为"满足式"问题：每张图须满足奖励下限，整批图须满足多样性阈值；提出无需训练的推理时方法 SatisDive，在 Pick-a-Pic 上按 DreamSim 匹配后 Pareto 优于 FK steering。
AI.motivation: 同一提示生成的多张图既需符合用户偏好（奖励），又需彼此视觉上不同（多样性）。现有方法要么分开处理二者，要么用单一聚合分数合并，导致高多样性可抵消低奖励。
AI.method: 将生成表述为 satisficing：每个候选须满足奖励下限，整批须满足多样性下限；奖励下限控制最差候选奖励与批次多样性的权衡，变化该下限形成 Pareto 前沿。提出 SatisDive，一种免训练推理时方法，用批次相对的奖励阈值区分高低奖励候选，对阈值以下者侧重提升奖励，对阈值以上者侧重多样性。
AI.result: 在 Pick-a-Pic 上，DreamSim 匹配时，FLUX.1-dev + HPSv3 下最差候选奖励较 FK steering 提升最多 0.43；SANA-1.6B + ImageReward 下提升最多 0.70。在重叠的 DreamSim 区间内，SatisDive 的满意度-多样性曲线在各设置下均 Pareto 支配 FK steering。
AI.conclusion: 将奖励与多样性作为可满足约束而非聚合目标，可在不训练的情况下实现奖励与多样性的更优权衡。

title: WakeKV: Reactive, Reversible KV Residency for Heads That Change Their Minds
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on ML for Systems. 2 figures, 4 tables, appendix
summary: Most KV-cache compression methods classify attention heads once, either offline or during prefill, and keep this classification fixed throughout generation. Across three models (1.5B-8B) and three regimes (needle retrieval, long chain-of-thought, and multi-turn recall), we measure head behavior on four model-regime combinations and find that most heads change their reading behavior at least once during generation. We introduce WakeKV, a reactive residency policy that moves cooling heads to a recoverable CPU reservoir rather than freezing or permanently evicting their state. At matched memory or budget, WakeKV consistently improves miss rate over frozen classification and destructive eviction, evaluated across five model-regime combinations and over three cited baselines (SnapKV, uniform R-KV, and ReasonAlloc) across four eligible combinations. A FlexiCache/vLLM implementation on Mistral-7B confirms the benefit on real hardware, improving throughput while retaining LongBench quality.

AI.tldr: 现有KV-cache压缩方法在生成过程中固定注意力头的分类，而作者发现大多数头在生成时会改变读取行为。为此提出WakeKV，一种反应式驻留策略，将"冷却"的头移至可恢复的CPU储备区，而非冻结或永久驱逐。在多个模型与任务组合上，WakeKV降低了miss rate，并在真实硬件上兼顾吞吐与质量。
AI.motivation: 多数KV-cache压缩方法在离线或prefill阶段一次性分类注意力头，并在整个生成过程中保持分类不变。作者通过测量发现，在三个模型和三种任务场景下，大多数头在生成过程中至少改变一次读取行为，说明静态分类假设不成立。
AI.method: 提出WakeKV，一种反应式驻留策略：将读取行为"冷却"的头移动到可恢复的CPU储备区，而不是冻结其状态或永久驱逐。基于FlexiCache/vLLM在Mistral-7B上实现。
AI.result: 在匹配内存或预算下，WakeKV在miss rate上持续优于冻结分类和破坏性驱逐；评估覆盖五个model-regime组合，并与SnapKV、uniform R-KV、ReasonAlloc三个基线在四个可用组合上比较。在真实硬件上提升吞吐量同时保持LongBench质量。
AI.conclusion: 头读取行为在生成过程中是动态变化的，静态分类策略存在局限；WakeKV通过可恢复的CPU储备机制实现动态驻留管理，在效率和效果上均优于现有方法，并在真实部署中验证了实用性。

title: A Simulation-Grounded Agentic VLM Framework for Wildfire Monitoring and Reporting
summary: Effective wildfire monitoring requires relating visual evidence to physical fire dynamics, yet real videos with synchronized physical annotations are scarce and high-fidelity 3D simulation is costly. We present a simulation-grounded vision-language model (VLM) framework that automatically converts 2D wildfire simulations into labeled video episodes. A fixed Blender mapping produces low-detail 3D proxies aligned with simulator terrain, fuel layout, fire activity, and wind cues; controllable video generation supplies richer appearance. The proxies are intermediate representations rather than finely rendered final scenes. Generated videos and simulator labels form reusable multimodal memory for a training-free multi-agent VLM system that retrieves reference episodes, reconciles visual and memory-based predictions, and produces structured wildfire reports. On held-out generated episodes, video memory achieves 51.5% exact four-tag accuracy, compared with 22.6% for direct VLM querying and 16-17% for text-only memory; the complete system achieves 77.3% accuracy on six simulator-derived report fields. Component ablations, cross-generator tests, and three real-UAV evaluations assess retrieval, reporting, generator changes, and observable monitoring tasks. The framework connects automatic simulation-to-proxy conversion with memory-based VLM reasoning under scarce real-world physical annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个"仿真接地"的视觉语言模型框架：将2D野火仿真自动转为带标签视频片段，用低细节3D代理对齐仿真物理信息，再结合可控视频生成，构成免训练多智能体VLM系统的多模态记忆，用于野火监测与结构化报告生成。
AI.motivation: 野火监测需将视觉证据与物理火情动态关联，但同步物理标注的真实视频稀缺，高保真3D仿真代价高昂，导致缺乏可复用的训练/推理数据。
AI.method: 用固定Blender映射生成与仿真地形、燃料分布、火活动及风场对齐的低细节3D代理（仅作中间表示而非最终渲染），配合可控视频生成提升外观真实度；生成视频与仿真标签构成可复用多模态记忆，驱动免训练多智能体VLM系统：检索参考片段、融合视觉与记忆预测，输出结构化野火报告。
AI.result: 在留出生成片段上，视频记忆四标签精确匹配准确率51.5%，直接VLM查询22.6%，纯文本记忆仅16-17%；完整系统在6个仿真派生报告字段上达77.3%。并做了组件消融、跨生成器测试及3次真实无人机评估。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在缺乏真实物理标注的条件下，将仿真到代理的自动转换与基于记忆的VLM推理相连接，为野火监测提供可行方案，但对真实场景的泛化仍需进一步验证。

title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
summary: LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve, have emerged as powerful approaches for challenging computational optimization problems, such as circle packing. However, prior work typically optimizes performance gain over a fixed number of iterations. We argue that practical optimization should maximize gain per unit cost. To this end, we propose FrugalEvo, a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores solution strategies, and a cheaper LLM implements them and iteratively refines the resulting code. We also design a cache-efficient evolution process, where our harness and prompts maximize the sharing of prefixes across different evolution steps, to improve cache reuse. To measure solution quality throughout a fixed cost budget, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC), defined as the area under the best-so-far evaluation score curve over cumulative LLM cost, up to the budget. Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, including OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, AdaEvolve, and EvoX, in final solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks. It also achieves higher average performance than these baselines on 10 algorithmic optimization tasks from ALE-Bench-Lite. Notably, on circle packing, FrugalEvo achieves new state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna for only 1.68 USD and with GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant for only 0.55 USD, matching or surpassing all baselines, including multi-agent methods such as CORAL and SwarmResearch, which cost approximately 50 USD on average.

AI.tldr: FrugalEvo是一个成本感知的LLM进化优化框架，用强LLM探索策略、弱LLM实现与迭代精化，并优化缓存前缀复用，以固定成本预算下的收益最大化为目标，在多个优化任务上超越现有方法且大幅降低开销。
AI.motivation: 已有LLM引导的进化方法（如AlphaEvolve）通常在固定迭代次数下优化性能，忽略了实际优化中应以单位成本收益最大化为目标的问题。作者主张应关注成本效率。
AI.method: 提出FrugalEvo：强且高成本的LLM负责探索解策略，便宜LLM负责实现并迭代精化代码；设计缓存高效的进化流程，通过harness与提示最大化跨进化步骤的前缀共享以提高缓存复用；并引入Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve（BA-AUC）指标，衡量固定成本预算下best-so-far评分曲线随累计LLM成本的面积。
AI.result: 在10个数学与系统优化任务上，FrugalEvo在最终解质量上匹配或超越OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、AdaEvolve、EvoX等SOTA基线，并在9个任务上取得更高BA-AUC；在ALE-Bench-Lite的10个算法优化任务上平均性能更优。在圆堆积任务上，用GPT-5.6 Terra与Luna仅花1.68美元、用GLM-5.3及其Flash变体仅花0.55美元即达到新SOTA，匹配或超过平均花费约50美元的多智能体方法（如CORAL、SwarmResearch）。
AI.conclusion: 成本感知的LLM进化框架可在极低预算下取得或超越高成本SOTA方法，说明按单位成本优化与缓存复用设计对实际优化具有重要价值。

title: BISCEPTER: Probability-Driven Bisection for Large-Scale System Software
summary:
Identifying the bug-inducing commit (BIC) is a fundamental step in regression debugging and a key input to emerging BIC-aware fault-localization pipelines. In practice, BICs are commonly obtained with bisection. Standard bisection selects the median commit of the remaining good-bad interval, thereby balancing commit count. This strategy is optimal under the assumption that each commit is equally likely to be the BIC.
  This paper shows that this assumption does not match real-world BIC histories. We construct a dataset of 8,172 bug reports from GCC, the Linux kernel, and MariaDB. We find a strong temporal skew: across the studied systems, 50% of BICs lie within the most recent 0.69% of the report-time commit history. Motivated by this observation, we introduce BISCEPTER, a probability-driven bisection approach that uses historical BIC latency as a lightweight prior. Instead of selecting pivots that split the number of remaining commits, BISCEPTER selects weighted-median pivots that split estimated BIC probability mass, while preserving the same good-bad oracle and interface as standard bisection. We evaluate BISCEPTER on three large-scale systems. The evaluation results show that BISCEPTER reduces bisection iterations by 25.75% on average (up to 55.55%) compared with standard median bisection, while improving over the baseline in 91.26% of test cases. Robustness experiments further demonstrate that the benefit remains stable under noisy historical data. We expect that our research can effectively save effort in debugging software in practice and, more broadly, benefit future software engineering research by bringing insights about BIC distribution.

AI.tldr: 论文发现真实BIC历史存在强时间偏斜，提出概率驱动的二分法BISCEPTER，用历史BIC延迟作先验，减少二分迭代次数。
AI.motivation: 标准二分法假设每个提交等概率为BIC，选取中位提交以平衡提交数量；但该假设与真实世界BIC历史不符，导致调试效率非最优。
AI.method: 构建GCC、Linux内核、MariaDB共8,172个bug报告数据集，观察到50%的BIC集中在报告时间前最近的0.69%提交历史中；据此提出BISCEPTER，用历史BIC延迟作为轻量先验，选取加权中位pivot以切分BIC概率质量，同时保持与标准二分法相同的good-bad oracle和接口。
AI.result: 在三个大规模系统上，相比标准中位二分法，BISCEPTER平均减少25.75%迭代次数（最高55.55%），91.26%测试用例优于基线；鲁棒性实验表明在噪声历史数据下收益稳定。
AI.conclusion: BISCEPTER能有效节省实际软件调试成本，并通过对BIC分布的洞察为未来软件工程研究提供价值。

title: TRACE: A Reproducible Benchmark for Electricity Price Forecasting with Official Operational Text
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Time Series (FMTS)
summary: Electricity price forecasting (EPF) supports scheduling, bidding, and risk management in electricity markets, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on numerical inputs, leaving the forecasting value of forecast-time textual context insufficiently evaluated. We introduce TRACE, a reproducible benchmark of 7,300 zone--day instances pairing prices from five zones in a major U.S. market with official operational text available at the forecast cutoff. TRACE reconstructs official operational text at each cutoff, preventing post-cutoff information leakage. We evaluate TRACE for semantic alignment and forecasting value. Semantic assessments align with central movement and both tail risks in ground-truth prices, most consistently for upper-tail price risk. Forecasting value is reflected in a median 7.4\% reduction in upper-tail pinball loss across time-series foundation models. A controlled cross-day text-mismatch ablation reverses the gains, falling below the no-text baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE基准，用预测时点可得官方运营文本评估电价预测，避免信息泄漏，验证了文本对电价（尤其上尾风险）的预测价值。
AI.motivation: 现有电价预测基准主要使用数值输入，对预测时点可得的文本上下文价值评估不足。
AI.method: 构建TRACE可复现基准，含7300个zone-day实例，将美国某主要市场五个区的价格与预测截止时可得官方运营文本配对，并重建各截止时点的文本以防泄漏；用于语义对齐与预测价值评估，并做跨日文本错配消融。
AI.result: 语义评估与真实价格的中央走势及两侧尾部风险对齐，上尾风险最一致；时间序列基础模型上上尾pinball损失中位数降低7.4%；跨日文本错配消融使增益逆转，低于无文本基线。
AI.conclusion: 预测时点文本对电价预测具有实际价值，尤其上尾风险，且需防止信息泄漏；错配文本会损害性能。

title: THPL: A Vision-to-Language Decision Support Framework for Rainbow Trout Feeding Management in RAS
comment: Meng Liang and Guanbo Feng contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Zhihong Ma and Ying Liu. 50 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/Tg2Qk7m46-A
summary: In Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), precision feeding is critical for minimizing costs and improving fish welfare. However, existing methods lack cognitive alignment between fish behaviors and management knowledge, impeding translation into executable, interpretable feeding decisions. To address this, we propose THPL, a generative feeding decision framework tailored for rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) in RAS. First, Fishsort extracts trajectories to establish an Activity Coefficient (AC) quantifying feeding intensity. Second, a Hierarchical Behavior Encoder (HBE) models individual temporal progression and collective dynamics using Temporal and Set Transformers, transforming trajectory tensors into dual-evidence representations of explicit physical and implicit soft tokens. Finally, these tokens are integrated with environmental parameters, metadata, and expert rules to fine-tune an LLM via LoRA, followed by counterfactual multimodal Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) to reinforce causal reasoning. Results show that AC exhibits a statistically significant monotonic positive correlation with expert-annotated feeding intensity (Spearman $ρ= 0.925$, $p < 0.001$). Ablations indicate that decision accuracy improves from 33.33% (text-only baseline) to 93.33% with dual-evidence tokens, confirming that continuous spatiotemporal tokens provide necessary physical grounding for LLMs. Compared with standard LoRA, counterfactual mDPO elevates decision accuracy from 93.33% to 96.67%, advances METEOR from 58.10% to 85.30%, reduces Self-BLEU-2 from 58.79% to 52.88%, and increases Distinct-3 from 6.68% to 7.81%, suppressing templating and actuation biases while reinforcing causal consistency and operational safety. Overall, by integrating continuous kinematics with LLM reasoning, this study provides a novel decision support paradigm for precision aquaculture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出THPL生成式投喂决策框架，用于RAS循环水养殖中的虹鳟精准投喂，通过轨迹提取、层次行为编码与大模型推理结合，显著提升决策准确率与因果一致性。
AI.motivation: RAS中精准投喂对降低成本、改善鱼类福利至关重要，但现有方法缺乏鱼类行为与管理知识之间的认知对齐，难以生成可执行、可解释的投喂决策。
AI.method: 框架分三步：Fishsort提取轨迹并构建活动系数（AC）量化摄食强度；层次行为编码器（HBE）用Temporal与Set Transformer建模个体时序与群体动态，将轨迹张量转为显式物理与隐式软令牌的双证据表示；再将令牌与环境参数、元数据、专家规则结合，通过LoRA微调LLM，并用反事实多模态DPO（mDPO）强化因果推理。
AI.result: AC与专家标注摄食强度呈显著单调正相关（ρ=0.925, p<0.001）。消融显示决策准确率从纯文本基线33.33%提升至双证据令牌的93.33%；相比标准LoRA，反事实mDPO将准确率从93.33%提至96.67%，METEOR从58.10%提至85.30%，Self-BLEU-2从58.79%降至52.88%，Distinct-3从6.68%升至7.81%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将连续运动学与LLM推理结合，抑制模板化与执行偏差，增强因果一致性与操作安全性，为精准水产养殖提供了新的决策支持范式。

title: TPBench: A Turning-Point Benchmark for Dialogue Compression
summary:
A compressor can keep the facts of a dialogue and still drop the turn that changed them. A user corrects a price, reverses a choice, or adds a constraint. We call this failure turning-point eviction. One overall retention score hides it, because that score mixes what the user first wanted with what the user wants now.
  We introduce TPBench, which evaluates three complementary information targets at shared nominal retention budgets. P1 asks for the user's initial goal. P2 asks for the current value of a slot the user revised. P3 asks for both, in dialogues with a late annotated slot update. The current-value answers come from the human dialogue-state annotations of MultiWOZ and SGD. The initial-goal answer is the first sentence of the first user turn. Neither requires new crowdsourcing.
  The probe-specific evaluations rank compression methods differently. On the joint probe at a retained fraction of 0.30, every tested compressed method remains below full context with the main Llama reader. Deleting the turn that carries the update sharply lowers current-value accuracy, while deleting one matched irrelevant turn leaves it unchanged. A Mistral reader repeats the P2/P3 rankings and the joint-probe gap. Current-value recovery is tested on an additional corpus, LongMemEval-KU, and on Chinese RiSAWOZ: full context has the highest accuracy, and recency has the highest compressed-method mean in both evaluations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并研究"转折点驱逐"失败:压缩器保留事实却丢弃改变事实的对话轮次,并推出TPBench以三个探测目标评估压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对话压缩评估用单一整体保留分数,混合了用户最初需求与当前需求,掩盖了压缩器丢弃关键更新轮次(如改价、改选择、加约束)的失败。
AI.method: 提出TPBench,在相同名义保留预算下评估三个互补目标:P1初始目标(首用户轮首句)、P2被修改槽位的当前值(来自MultiWOZ与SGD人工对话状态标注)、P3两者联合(含晚期标注槽更新),无需新众包。另在LongMemEval-KU和中文RiSAWOZ上测试。
AI.result: 不同探测评估对压缩方法排名不同;在0.30保留率联合探测下,所有压缩方法均低于全上下文(Llama主reader);删除携带更新的轮次显著降低当前值准确率,而删除匹配的无关轮次无影响;Mistral重复P2/P3排名与联合探测差距;LongMemEval-KU与RiSAWOZ上全上下文准确率最高,recency在压缩方法中均值最高。
AI.conclusion: 总体保留分数不足以评估压缩质量,需按探测目标分别评估;当前值恢复是压缩的关键弱点,全上下文仍具优势。
