We introduce OEB (Open-Endedness Bench), a benchmark-agnostic methodology that reads only the agent's execution record and never a reference answer or an outcome score. OEB compiles the record into a unified epistemic event graph whose edges connect the propositions the agent states to the executed actions that test them; each node carries an exact excerpt that code verifies against the record. One principle governs scoring: prose can state a proposition, but only evidence returned by an executed action can support or refute it, so OEB checks what the agent writes against what it actually ran. From the graph, OEB scores four competence axes (evidence, experiment, revision, and no reward hacking), mostly as the share of opportunities for sound research that the agent took, and profiles six subjective persona traits that describe the agent's research habits. We score 119 existing runs over 12 tasks from three benchmarks: LLM post-training, chip design, and a training-speed record. Against logged results, only 16-29% of the improvements agents claim are real. On 9 of 10 tasks, the best run tries more new ideas in its second half than the worst run. The persona readings follow the model: for every trait, the model that ran explains more of its variance across runs than the task (a median of 43% against 7%).

AI.tldr: 提出OEB(Open-Endedness Bench)基准无关方法论，仅读取智能体执行记录而非参考答案或结果分数，通过构建认知事件图评估其假设形成、检验与修正过程，量化四种能力轴与六种人格特质，揭示多数声称的改进并非真实。
AI.motivation: 开放式研究任务中，智能体执行日志记录每一步，但当前仅靠结果分数评判，无法确认其结论是否真正由已执行的实验支撑，且可能缺乏参考答案，因此需要评估智能体的认知过程本身。
AI.method: OEB仅读取执行记录，将其编译为统一的认知事件图：边连接智能体陈述的命题与检验该命题的已执行动作，节点携带经代码核验的记录原文。核心原则是"文本可陈述命题，但仅已执行动作返回的证据能支持或反驳它"。基于该图，OEB评估四个能力轴（证据、实验、修正、无奖励黑客），多以智能体把握正当研究机会的比例计分，并刻画六种主观研究习惯人格特质。
AI.result: 在3个基准（LLM后训练、芯片设计、训练速度记录）的12个任务共119次运行中评分。与日志结果对比，智能体声称的改进仅16-29%为真；10个任务中9个，最佳运行在第二半程尝试的新想法多于最差运行；人格读数主要跟随模型：每种特质上，运行模型解释的跨运行方差（中位数43%）远高于任务（7%）。
AI.conclusion: OEB提供了一种不依赖参考答案和结果分数的基准无关方法，通过认知事件图评估智能体的研究过程质量，能揭示结果分数掩盖的问题，并显示研究习惯主要由模型而非任务决定。

title: OLMo-Detect: A Multi-Stage, Confounder-Controlled Benchmark for Membership Inference on Large Language Models
summary: Membership inference on large language models (LLMs) aims to determine whether a given text sample was included in an LLM's training data, without access to its training corpus. Despite recent progress, existing benchmarks suffer from three limitations: limited coverage of training stages, insufficient distributional alignment between members and non-members, and lack of rigorous filtering of non-members against the training corpus. To address these limitations, we propose OLMo-Detect, a multi-stage, confounder-controlled benchmark built upon the fully open OLMo 2 pipeline. OLMo-Detect spans pre-training, mid-training, and post-training, explicitly aligns members and non-members on three key axes, and rigorously filters non-members via infini-gram. To assess robustness to distribution shifts, we further introduce OLMo-Detect (Shifted), a variant where members are misaligned with non-members. We evaluate 15 unsupervised and 3 supervised membership inference attacks (MIAs) across the OLMo 2 family, finding that: (i) overall performance is limited: the best unsupervised and supervised MIAs both reach an AUC of only 0.68, and supervised MIAs degrade under cross-domain evaluation; (ii) MIA performance peaks at mid-training and is lower at pre-training and post-training, a pattern driven by data type rather than a stage effect: curated math data is far more detectable than other types; (iii) overall scores improve from 1B to 13B but plateau at 32B; and (iv) no unsupervised MIA is robust to distribution shifts, with AUCs shifting by up to 0.42. Finally, we find that our findings on OLMo 2 generalize to OLMo 3 and non-OLMo models.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段、混杂因素受控的成员推断基准OLMo-Detect，覆盖预训练/中训练/后训练，并对齐与过滤成员/非成员；评测18种MIA，发现性能普遍有限、中训练最强、随规模提升但32B平台化、无监督方法对分布偏移不稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM成员推断基准存在三方面不足：训练阶段覆盖有限、成员与非成员分布对齐不足、未严格过滤非成员是否在训练语料中。
AI.method: 基于完全开放的OLMo 2流程构建OLMo-Detect，覆盖预训练、中训练、后训练；在三个关键轴上显式对齐成员与非成员；用infini-gram严格过滤非成员；并构建OLMo-Detect (Shifted)引入成员与非成员错位以评估分布偏移鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在OLMo 2系列上评测15种无监督和3种有监督MIA：最佳AUC仅0.68，有监督跨域下降；中训练表现最高，实由数据类型驱动，数学数据更易检测；1B到13B提升，32B平台化；无监督MIA对分布偏移不稳健，AUC变化可达0.42；结论可推广到OLMo 3及非OLMo模型。
AI.conclusion: MIA在LLM上仍具挑战，阶段差异主要由数据类型而非训练阶段导致，规模收益有限，无监督方法缺乏对分布偏移的鲁棒性。

title: Seeing, Saying, but Not Using: From Reportable Spatial Facts to Usable States in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: A multimodal large language model that correctly reports a spatial fact does not necessarily use that fact in subsequent reasoning. To study this distinction, we introduce \textsc{SpaceConflict}, a benchmark of 23{,}196 inputs for the construction and use of spatial state. Under a unified Supported/Contradictory/Unknown judgment interface, it covers local fact binding (L1), relational composition (L2), cross-observation consistency (L3), and state judgment under transformation (L4). Posing a direct-state query, a full-transformation query, and an explicit-initial-state query on the same world reveals an availability--utilization gap: models recover the initial state from visual evidence yet fail when that state must drive a transformation. For Qwen3.5-9B, 50 of 100 sequences with a correctly recovered initial state fail the full transformation, and supplying the state explicitly repairs all 50; the gap narrows with scale but does not close. We therefore propose Operational State Supervision (OSS), which supervises task-relevant spatial states and their transformation trajectories and aligns shared facts across contexts. OSS improves paired accuracy on matched judgments most on L3 and L4, the levels that depend on organizing and using state. Evaluating multimodal spatial reasoning thus requires asking not only whether a model can see and state a spatial fact, but whether that fact becomes a usable state in subsequent computation.

AI.tldr: 本文引入SpaceConflict基准，揭示多模态大模型存在"可用性-利用性"缺口：模型能正确报告空间事实，却未必在后续推理中使用该事实。提出Operational State Supervision (OSS)进行监督。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型正确报告空间事实并不代表在后续推理中真正使用该事实，需区分"陈述空间事实"与"将该事实作为可用状态参与计算"这两者。
AI.method: 构建SpaceConflict基准（23,196个输入），覆盖四个层级：L1局部事实绑定、L2关系组合、L3跨观测一致性、L4变换下的状态判断，采用统一的Supported/Contradictory/Unknown判断接口。通过直接状态查询、全变换查询、显式初始状态查询三种提问揭示缺口。提出Operational State Supervision (OSS)，监督任务相关的空间状态及其变换轨迹，并对齐跨上下文的共享事实。
AI.result: 发现可用性-利用性缺口：Qwen3.5-9B在100个正确恢复初始状态的序列中有50个在全变换任务上失败，显式提供状态可修复全部50个；缺口随规模缩小但未消失。OSS在匹配判断上的配对准确率提升最大，尤以L3和L4为主。
AI.conclusion: 评估多模态空间推理不仅要问模型能否看见并陈述空间事实，还要问该事实能否成为后续计算中可用的状态。

title: Hesitation Has a Geometry: Entropy-Trained Hyperbolic Probes for Sparse Activation Steering
summary: When a large language model solves a mathematical problem, its reasoning is largely hierarchical, and the solution often branches at a few tokens where the next-token entropy is high. Such tree-like structure embeds in hyperbolic space with far lower distortion than in Euclidean space. Activation steering, however, usually edits the hidden states of a pretrained model by adding one fixed Euclidean vector at every token, even though most tokens of a solution are already determined by the context. We propose Hyperbolic Entropy Steering (HEST), which embeds the hidden states in the Poincaré ball with a lightweight probe whose only label is the model's own next-token entropy. Where this entropy exceeds a threshold, HEST moves the embedded state along the geodesic of steepest descent of a readout of the probe and maps the change back to the hidden state. For the Busemann readout of a learned ideal point, we prove that a step of fixed length lowers it by the same amount at every state. On three instruction-tuned models from the Qwen2.5-Math and Llama-3.1 families, HEST with the Busemann readout improves greedy accuracy on MATH-500 and GSM8K in five of six settings, by up to 1.8 points, whereas a contrastive steering vector added at every token lowers accuracy. With a Euclidean probe trained in the same way, this gain disappears on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct. The gains are largest on problems where the model hesitates often, and accuracy on the remaining problems is almost unchanged.

AI.tldr: HEST在庞加莱球中对隐藏状态做熵触发的测地线激活引导，仅在高熵分支token处修正，提升数学推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 大模型解数学题具层次树状结构，高熵分支token决定走向；庞加莱空间嵌入此类树状结构失真更低，但现有激活引导在每个token加同一固定欧氏向量，忽略了多数token已由上下文确定。
AI.method: 用轻量探测器将隐藏状态嵌入庞加莱球，标签仅为模型自身下一token熵；当熵超阈值时，沿探测器读出函数最速下降测地线移动嵌入状态并映射回隐藏状态。对学习理想点的Busemann读出，证明固定步长在各状态下降量相同。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math与Llama-3.1三个指令微调模型上，Busemann读出在MATH-500和GSM8K的六种设置中五种贪心准确率提升，最多+1.8分；每token加对比引导向量则降低准确率；欧氏探测器在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct上增益消失。增益集中在模型频繁犹豫的问题，其余问题准确率基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 利用双曲几何与熵触发的稀疏激活引导，可有效提升数学推理，且优于全token统一干预的欧氏方法。

title: TasteBench: Multimodal Benchmark for Sensory Prediction, from Molecules to Sustainable Foods
comment: First two authors contributed equally. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets track. Code available at https://github.com/Food-Intelligence-Lab/tastebench
summary: Sustainable protein discovery lacks the fast computational proxies, analogous to molecular docking or density functional theory, that accelerate drug and materials discovery. Evaluating whether a novel food tastes like its animal-based target requires expensive human sensory panels, bottlenecking the design-build-test loop. We introduce TasteBench, a multimodal benchmark and privacy-preserving competition for sensory prediction, spanning two tasks: a food-level ranking task built on 21K+ human evaluations across 215 plant-based foods in 24 product categories, yielding 935 within-category ranking pairs, and a supporting molecular-level taste classification task over 15K flavor molecules. To enable rigorous interpretation of model performance, we characterize the ground truth: inter-rater agreement among panelists is low (Krippendorff's $α= .077$), and the split-half reliability ceiling of panel-aggregated rankings is .825, establishing the range within which ML systems on this benchmark should be assessed. We evaluate baselines across four input modalities; on the same pairs panelists rated, the best model achieves .661 pairwise accuracy, competitive with the median individual panelist (.650), and .683 across all within-category pairs. TasteBench provides the evaluation infrastructure and baselines for measuring progress on computational screening for sustainable protein discovery.

AI.tldr: TasteBench是一个用于可持续蛋白感官预测的多模态基准与隐私保护竞赛，包含食品级排序任务和分子级味觉分类任务，并给出了基线与人类评估者一致性的上限参考。
AI.motivation: 可持续蛋白发现缺乏类似分子对接或DFT的快速计算代理，评估新食品是否具有动物基目标的风味需依赖昂贵的人类感官评测，形成设计-构建-测试循环瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建TasteBench多模态基准与隐私保护竞赛：食品级排序任务基于215种植物基食品、24个产品类别、21K+人类评测，生成935个类别内排序对；分子级味觉分类任务覆盖15K风味分子。评估四种输入模态的基线，并分析人类评测者间一致性与分半信度上限。
AI.result: 评测者间一致性低（Krippendorff's α=.077），面板聚合排序的分半信度上限为.825。最佳模型在同评测者评过的配对上达到.661成对准确率，与个体评测者中位数(.650)相当，在所有类别内配对上达.683。
AI.conclusion: TasteBench为可持续蛋白发现的计算筛选提供了评估基础设施与基线，用于衡量相关模型进展。

title: OmniConfess: Eliciting Token Confessions to Mitigate Omni-Modal Hallucination
summary: Omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs) unify text, images, audio, and video, yet hallucinate when generation relies on the wrong evidence. Existing inference-time methods can reduce hallucinations, but rarely reveal which evidence sustains a generated commitment. We introduce OmniConfess, a training-free method for mitigating omni-modal hallucinations. It fixes a candidate response and re-scores it at token resolution under controlled channel-wise evidence interventions, producing a structured token-by-channel confession that reveals the response's evidential dependence. OmniConfess uses this confession to preserve grounded content and correct commitments driven by irrelevant or contradictory evidence. To evaluate OmniConfess, we construct OmniHalluBench, a 3,540-example benchmark built from six datasets spanning text, image, audio, and video settings and both judgment and free-form generation. Experiments show that OmniConfess mitigates hallucinations across heterogeneous modality and task settings. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/RongHuiQiang/OmniConfess.

AI.tldr: OmniConfess：一种免训练的推理时方法，通过按token和模态的证据干预重打分数，生成"token-by-channel confessions"以缓解全模态LLM幻觉，并构建了OmniHalluBench基准。
AI.motivation: 全模态大模型（OmniLLM）统一文本、图像、音频和视频，但当生成依赖错误证据时会产生幻觉；现有推理时方法虽能减少幻觉，却很少揭示哪些证据支撑了生成的承诺。
AI.method: 固定候选回答，在受控的通道级（channel-wise）证据干预下以token粒度重新打分，产生结构化的token-by-channel confession，揭示回答的证据依赖性；利用该confession保留有依据内容并纠正由无关或矛盾证据驱动的承诺。方法免训练。
AI.result: 构建了OmniHalluBench，含3,540个样本，来自6个数据集，覆盖文本、图像、音频、视频及判断型与自由生成任务；实验显示OmniConfess在异构模态和任务设置下均能缓解幻觉。
AI.conclusion: OmniConfess作为一种免训练方法，能跨异构模态与任务有效缓解全模态幻觉，并公开了代码与基准。

title: Found but Not Read: When Extracted Text Closes the Retrieval-Reading Gap in Document Vision-Language Models
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Retrieval-augmented document question answering assumes that once the right page is found, a vision-language model (VLM) can read it. We show that this assumption often fails, leaving a retrieval-reading gap: evidence found but not used. A paired protocol isolates this gap by comparing answers from the retrieved page images alone with answers from the same images plus their extracted text. On FoveDoc-Bench, our benchmark with traceable evidence, retrieval finds nearly every evidence page, yet adding CPU-OCR text raises strict accuracy by 13 to 16 points. An exact text layer roughly doubles the gain, which appears across six VLMs from three families and, within one family, narrows with scale without closing. The reader can read this evidence but cannot find it: crops of it recover most of the text gain, boxes around it on the page none. The same protocol identifies two boundaries. Extracted text helps on textual evidence but is neutral or harmful on charts and figures. Its advantage shrinks as retrieval degrades, and unrelated text of the same form adds nothing detectable. Extracted text is an amplifier of retrieval that works, not a substitute for retrieval that does not. Our code is available at https://github.com/atoz03/fovedoc-sup.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示检索增强文档问答存在"检索-阅读鸿沟"——证据页面被检索到，但VLM无法有效利用。通过配对协议对比纯图像与图像加OCR文本，发现提取文本能显著提升严格准确率（13-16点），本质是检索的放大器而非替代品。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强文档问答假设"找到正确页面后VLM就能读懂"，但作者发现该假设常失效，出现"证据已找到却未被使用"的检索-阅读鸿沟，需要量化并定位这一问题。
AI.method: 提出配对协议：对比仅用检索页面图像与同一图像加提取文本的答案。构建FoveDoc-Bench基准（含可追溯证据），测试6个VLM（3个家族），并通过裁剪证据区域、页面画框、替换同形式无关文本等控制实验定位鸿沟来源。
AI.result: 检索几乎总能找到证据页，但加入CPU-OCR文本使严格准确率提升13-16点，精确文本层增益约翻倍。证据区域裁剪可恢复大部分文本增益，而页面画框无帮助。提取文本对文本类证据有益，对图表中性或有害；检索退化时其优势缩小；同形式无关文本无增益。
AI.conclusion: 提取文本是有效检索的放大器，而非无效检索的替代品；VLM能"读"到证据却"找不到"它，说明阅读器存在定位瓶颈而非识别瓶颈。

title: Inherit-MAS: Test-Time Evolution of Multi-Agent Systems through Workflow and Execution Inheritance
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built from large language models coordinate specialized agents to tackle complex tasks, but effective workflows are difficult to design in advance. Test-time evolution refines workflows using execution feedback, yet broad revisions can disturb useful components, while re-executing unchanged requests can incur redundant computation. Inspired by the interplay of inheritance and selection in biological evolution, we introduce Inherit-MAS, which makes inheritance explicit at the workflow and execution levels. A meta-model first synthesizes a workflow of worker agents with declared roles, communication inputs, and tool permissions, and a separately prompted judge scores each executed candidate and diagnoses its deficiencies. In ordinary refinement rounds, \emph{workflow inheritance} starts from the latest completed candidate, may discard removable nodes judged unhelpful, and applies a validated edit to address the diagnosed deficiency. When the new candidate executes, \emph{execution inheritance} inherits eligible stored results only if the complete resolved request and execution context match, avoiding redundant model and tool calls. With GPT-4o-mini workers, Inherit-MAS achieves 55.4\% completion on WorkBench and 49.7\% joint F1 on HotpotQA FullWiki, outperforming EvoAgent, EvoMAS, and TacoMAS. With Qwen3-32B workers, it also exceeds these evolving-MAS baselines on both benchmarks. Compared with rerunning the same controller with execution inheritance disabled, execution inheritance reduces worker-token usage by 29.1\% on WorkBench and 34.6\% on HotpotQA, and total token usage by 5.3\% and 18.1\%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Inherit-MAS，通过工作流继承与执行继承改进多智能体工作流的测试时演化，减少冗余计算并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统工作流难以事先设计，测试时演化虽可用执行反馈优化，但大范围修改会破坏有效组件，且重执行未变请求产生冗余计算。
AI.method: 借鉴生物演化中遗传与选择的互动，显式引入继承机制：元模型合成含角色、通信输入与工具权限的智能体工作流，评判器对候选打分并诊断缺陷；细化轮次中的工作流继承从最新候选出发、可丢弃无用节点并施加经校验的编辑；执行继承仅在完整解析请求与执行上下文匹配时复用已存结果。
AI.result: GPT-4o-mini 下 WorkBench 完成率 55.4%、HotpotQA FullWiki 联合 F1 49.7%，优于 EvoAgent、EvoMAS 和 TacoMAS；Qwen3-32B 下同样超越这些演化式 MAS 基线。执行继承使 worker token 用量分别降低 29.1%（WorkBench）与 34.6%（HotpotQA），总 token 用量降低 5.3% 与 18.1%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的继承机制可有效提升演化式多智能体工作流的性能并显著减少冗余计算。

title: Time Series Forecasting Benchmarks Need Scenario-Grounded Stress Testing
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) increasingly drives decisions in transportation, energy, finance, healthcare, and infrastructure, yet current evaluation remains overly narrow: standard benchmarks reward low held-out error, while robustness studies typically reduce failure to Gaussian noise, random masking, or bounded adversarial perturbations. This obscures the real failure modes of deployed forecasting systems. Input-side anomalies are not merely noisier inputs: they often reflect structured events that alter temporal dynamics, break cross-variable dependencies, induce regime shifts, or propagate from faulty sensors to downstream decisions. These semantic, causal, and system-level failures cannot be faithfully captured by i.i.d. perturbations alone. The rise of TSF foundation models makes this evaluation gap more urgent, as unauditable pretraining corpora make held-out generalization increasingly unreliable. We therefore advocate scenario-grounded stress testing. Each test instance should include historical inputs and future targets, together with a semantic scenario, an explicit failure operator, and a measurable difficulty level. This shift makes evaluation interpretable, attributable, and deployment-relevant and friendly, enabling the community to ask not only which model is accurate, but under what conditions it fails and why.

AI.tldr: 当前时间序列预测评测过于狭窄，仅关注低误差和简单扰动，掩盖了真实部署中的语义、因果及系统级失效模式。作者倡导"场景驱动的压力测试"，让评测更可解释、可归因且贴近部署需求。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测在交通、能源、金融、医疗等领域日益重要，但现有评测奖励低留出误差，鲁棒性研究多局限于高斯噪声、随机掩码或有界对抗扰动，无法反映真实失效模式。输入异常往往是结构化事件，会改变时间动态、破坏跨变量依赖、引发机制转换或从故障传感器传播到下游。随着TSF基础模型兴起，不可审计的预训练语料使留出泛化更不可靠，评测缺口更加紧迫。
AI.method: 提出"场景驱动的压力测试"（scenario-grounded stress testing）。每个测试实例应包含历史输入与未来目标，同时附带语义场景、明确的失效算子和可度量的难度等级。
AI.result: （观点/立场论文，无实验或量化结果）主张该评测范式使评估具备可解释性、可归因性和部署相关性。
AI.conclusion: 推动评测范式转变，使社区不仅追问哪个模型准确，更追问模型在何种条件下失效及原因。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) understand and generate both text and images, which lets a model produce its own training data. Existing self-improvement in UMMs keeps supervision on the visual side, where image understanding judges image generation. We propose recursive cross-capability self-improvement (RSI), a training loop in which the text and visual abilities of a UMM supply training data for one another. In each round, the model generates images and reads them to find where it falls short. It then writes programs aimed at these shortcomings, and execution verifies every result against its specification. Verified renders train image generation, while labeled renders and the model's own correct programs train visual understanding and program writing. Program execution thus acts as a source of truth outside the model, so errors do not accumulate across rounds. We study RSI on charts and build BasicChartBench to evaluate open models early in training. On requests worded differently from training, four rounds of RSI raise the score from 45.7% to 60.2%, while continued training stays at 46.3%. Verified construction carries most of the gain, and targeting the model's failures adds 3.5%. Along the way, the share of verified programs rises from 48.9% to 95.2%, and the reader's accuracy on edited renders rises from 55.6% to 87.4%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出递归跨能力自我改进(RSI),让UMM的文本与视觉能力互相提供训练数据,通过程序执行作为外部真值来源,避免误差累积。在图表任务上,四轮RSI将得分从45.7%提升到60.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有UMM自我改进仅在视觉侧保持监督(图像理解评判图像生成),未能利用文本与视觉能力的互补性。作者希望让两种能力互相供给训练数据,并以程序执行作为模型外部的真值来源,防止多轮误差累积。
AI.method: 提出RSI训练循环:每轮模型生成图像并读取以找出短板,据此编写程序,执行时按规格验证结果。验证通过的渲染用于训练图像生成,带标签渲染与模型自身的正确程序用于训练视觉理解和程序编写。
AI.result: 在图表任务上构建BasicChartBench。面对与训练措辞不同的请求,四轮RSI将得分从45.7%升至60.2%,而持续训练仅46.3%。验证构建贡献主要增益,针对模型失败再加3.5%。验证程序占比从48.9%升至95.2%,阅读器在编辑渲染上的准确率从55.6%升至87.4%。
AI.conclusion: RSI通过跨能力互供数据与程序执行验证,可有效提升UMM的图像生成与视觉理解能力,并抑制多轮误差累积,优于持续训练。

title: Revealing Epistemic Uncertainty in MLLMs via Causal-Invariant Masking
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from hallucinations, creating a critical need for Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) to ensure reliable deployment. However, existing approaches struggle to detect uncertainty caused by superficial associations, especially when the query-relevant signal is weak. We mainly attribute this issue to their bias toward aleatoric uncertainty arising from data ambiguity, overlooking epistemic uncertainty stemming from model limitations. To further decompose uncertainty types for a comprehensive UQ, we propose Causal-Invariant Masking (CIM), which measures the semantic shift between the original predictions and those conditioned on a causally-focused view. Based on this framework, we introduce Semantic Divergence as our core metric for UQ and provide theoretical evidence that it converges to the variance of model's sensitivity to non-causal correlations, establishing its ability to capture MLLM's limitation. To accelerate UQ in MLLMs, we further propose Expected Embedding Drift (EED), a fast geometric proxy metric that estimates semantic shift directly within the hyperspherical embedding space. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks, while the proposed EED accelerates by nearly 50% with comparable performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果不变掩码（CIM）框架及语义散度指标，并引入快速几何代理指标EED，用于检测MLLM因浅层关联导致的幻觉不确定性，实现SOTA并加速近50%。
AI.motivation: MLLM存在幻觉，需不确定性量化（UQ）保障可靠部署。现有方法偏向数据模糊引发的偶然不确定性（aleatoric），忽视模型局限导致的认知不确定性（epistemic），难以检测由浅层关联（尤其查询相关信号弱时）引发的不确定性。
AI.method: 提出Causal-Invariant Masking（CIM），度量原预测与基于因果聚焦视图条件预测之间的语义偏移；以Semantic Divergence为核心UQ指标，理论证明其收敛于模型对非因果相关敏感度的方差；并提出Expected Embedding Drift（EED），在超球嵌入空间中直接估计语义偏移的快速几何代理指标。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得SOTA性能；EED在性能相当的情况下加速近50%。
AI.conclusion: CIM与Semantic Divergence能捕捉MLLM因模型局限导致的不确定性，EED提供高效近似的UQ方案，兼顾精度与速度。

title: Validated Data Onboarding for AI Demand Forecasting on U.S. Building Meter Data: Design, Controlled Evaluation, and a Corrected Negative Result
comment: Technical report; 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Code, data manifests, and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/LIANGYIXUAN3335/energy-data-onboarding-forecasting . Preprint; not peer reviewed
summary: Electric utilities and grid operators increasingly rely on machine-learning models to forecast next-day demand, and those models learn from meter data that is routinely defective: readings go missing, sensors freeze, buildings read zero for hours, and units change by a factor of 100. This report presents a data-onboarding pipeline that detects and repairs such defects before a model is trained, using only information available at forecast time, and a controlled experiment that measures whether the pipeline protects a 24-hour-ahead forecast. On hourly electricity data for twelve U.S. buildings from the public Building Data Genome 2 dataset (210,528 rows, 2016-2017), seeded, hash-logged defects touching 0.10% of the training period raised the error of a gradient-boosting forecaster by 86%; after detection and past-only repair the error returned to the clean-data level (mean absolute scaled error 0.760 clean, 1.415 corrupted, 0.729 repaired) while 93% of training targets were retained. At a defect prevalence calibrated to published field studies (1.6% of training rows) the unprotected forecaster's error reached 4.4 times that of a seasonal-naive rule, and the repaired forecaster again matched the clean baseline. The same pattern held for ridge regression and a random forest and across horizons of 1 to 24 hours. A first version of the pipeline over-cleaned natural data and made forecasts 25% worse; that result is retained, its cause is traced in the published artifacts, and the per-building calibration that corrects it is documented as a dated amendment. Every number is reproducible from pinned public inputs with SHA-256 verification, 84 automated tests and continuous integration.

AI.tldr: 该报告提出一个数据上线（data-onboarding）流水线，可在模型训练前检测并修复电表数据缺陷（缺失、冻结、归零、单位错误），仅使用预测时刻可得的信息，并通过受控实验验证其对24小时前瞻预测的保护作用。
AI.motivation: 电力公司和电网运营商依赖机器学习模型预测次日需求，但模型所学的电表数据常有缺陷（读数缺失、传感器冻结、楼宇数小时读零、单位变化100倍），这会显著损害预测精度。
AI.method: 在公开Building Data Genome 2数据集（12栋美国楼宇，210,528行，2016-2017）上，以带种子、哈希记录的缺陷注入进行受控实验，缺陷覆盖0.10%训练期；使用仅基于过去信息的检测与修复，评估梯度提升、岭回归和随机森林在1至24小时各前瞻期的表现，并将缺陷流行率校准至已发表野外研究的1.6%。
AI.result: 0.10%缺陷使梯度提升误差上升86%，修复后回到干净数据水平（MASE：干净0.760、损坏1.415、修复0.729），保留93%训练目标；1.6%流行率下未保护模型误差达季节朴素规则的4.4倍，修复后再次匹配干净基线；结论在多种模型和1-24小时前瞻中一致。管线初版过度清洗自然数据导致预测变差25%，该结果被保留、追溯原因并以带日期的修正记录说明校准方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提数据上线流水线能有效保护短期电力负荷预测免受数据缺陷影响，且所有结果均可由固定公开输入经SHA-256校验、84项自动化测试和持续集成复现。

title: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
summary: Harness evolution improves an LLM agent's prompts, tools, and workflow, while the optimizer's own tools and procedures often remain fixed. We study whether an optimizer can improve another agent more effectively by also improving how it diagnoses failures, develops edits, and tests their effects. Two observations guide our design. In a controlled study, optimizer self-evolution fails to improve performance without execution-based verification, but achieves the best result of that study when verification is available. Across five executors, self-evolving optimizers build their own tools for failure analysis, verification, training audits, and workflow control. Motivated by these findings, we introduce VERSE, a Verified Self-Evolving optimizer for agent harnesses. VERSE lets the optimizer test draft edits, replay failures, and perturb suspected steps before submission, while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds. Using this feedback, the optimizer revises both the executor harness and its own prompts, skills, tools, hooks, and notes, while the weights of the optimizer and executor models stay fixed. Under a shared protocol with disjoint training, validation, and test tasks, VERSE improves all four evaluated harness optimizers on held-out SWE-rebench tasks and newer out-of-distribution tasks in five languages. Its best validation-selected harness reaches 42.3% and 37.7% accuracy, respectively, against 39.2% and 29.3% for the strongest baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/wzekai/VERSE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VERSE，一种经过验证的自进化优化器，可同时改进被优化agent的harness和优化器自身的prompt、工具与流程，在SWE-rebench和分布外任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM agent优化器能改进executor的prompt、工具和工作流，但优化器自身的工具和流程固定不变。作者探究优化器是否能通过改进自身诊断失败、开发编辑和测试效果的方式来更有效地优化其他agent。
AI.method: 基于两个观察设计：(1)对照研究中，缺乏基于执行的验证时优化器自进化无提升，但验证可用时效果最佳；(2)在五个executor上，自进化优化器会自建失败分析、验证、训练审计和工作流控制工具。据此提出VERSE，允许优化器在提交前测试草稿编辑、重放失败、扰动可疑步骤，并跨轮追踪修复与回归，进而修改executor harness及优化器自身的prompt、技能、工具、hooks和notes，模型权重保持固定。
AI.result: 在训练、验证、测试任务不相交的共享协议下，VERSE在四个评测harness优化器上均提升，在held-out SWE-rebench及五种语言的新分布外任务上表现更优。验证集选出的最佳harness准确率分别达42.3%和37.7%，而最强基线为39.2%和29.3%。
AI.conclusion: 优化器自进化需依赖基于执行的验证才能生效；VERSE通过联合进化executor与优化器自身组件，显著提升agent harness优化效果，并具备良好的泛化能力。

title: HyperThink: Text-to-Parameter Hypernetworks for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Long-form thinking traces can substantially improve the multi-step reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), but they introduce high inference-time overhead, with latency dominated by sequential decoding. We propose HyperThink, a text-to-parameter approach that amortizes this reasoning computation into a single query-conditioned parameter update: a lightweight hypernetwork reads the question and predicts updates to a small subset of the base LLM's parameters, while a vector-quantized decoder constrains them to a finite set of reusable patterns to improve robustness and transfer. Trained end-to-end on outputs from the base model itself, HyperThink eliminates long thinking traces at test time: after one hypernetwork forward pass, the adapted model generates a concise step-by-step solution and final answer without an intermediate trace, using far fewer tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Empirically, HyperThink improves the low-latency region of the accuracy-latency trade-off on mathematical and general reasoning tasks, with its strongest gains in the near-non-thinking regime.

AI.tldr: HyperThink通过text-to-parameter方法将长思维链的推理计算摊销为一次查询条件的参数更新，用轻量超网络预测LLM部分参数更新，无需长思维链即可生成简洁解答，显著降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 长思维链虽能提升LLM多步推理性能，但推理开销高，延迟主要来自顺序解码。作者希望在不牺牲推理能力的前提下消除测试时的长思维链开销。
AI.method: 提出HyperThink：轻量超网络读取问题并预测基座LLM一小部分参数的更新；用向量量化解码器将更新约束到有限可复用模式以提升鲁棒性与迁移性；基于基座模型自身输出端到端训练。
AI.result: 在数学与通用推理任务上改进了准确率-延迟权衡的低延迟区域，在接近非思考（non-thinking）的场景中增益最明显，用更少token保持较强推理性能。
AI.conclusion: HyperThink能将推理计算摊销到单次参数更新中，测试时无需中间思维链，一次超网络前向即可生成简洁分步解答，在低延迟区间优于长思维链方法。

title: ViTok: Improving Dense Semantics in AM-RADIO-Style Multi-Teacher Distillation with PHI-S and Masked Image Modelling
summary: We study how to consolidate the current VITOK progress into a single multi-teacher distillation recipe that jointly preserves global recognition and dense semantics. Our starting point is an AM-RADIO-style student distilled from SigLIP2 and DINOv3-L, where SigLIP2 supplies strong global semantics and DINOv3-L supplies stronger dense features. The central empirical issue is that the same recipe does not optimize all objectives equally well: changes that improve ImageNet-1K kNN accuracy can still degrade ADE20K segmentation. We summarize a progression of modifications that make this trade-off more explicit and more manageable: split adaptor heads for CLS and patch tokens, asymmetric cosine/MSE losses, initialization from a DINOv3-L checkpoint, teacher reweighting, masked image modeling (MIM), and PHI-S feature balancing. The resulting model reaches 83.2 patch kNN and 85.2 CLS kNN, slightly surpassing the DINOv3-L teacher on ImageNet-1K kNN classification, while PHI-S restores ADE20K performance from 46.5/58.1 to 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc, matching the teacher on this dense benchmark. We also summarize negative results: scaling distillation from ImageNet-1K to ImageNet22K does not consistently help, and naively adding extra teachers such as SAM3 or HOG features introduces interference. Rather than claiming a final recipe, this paper distills the current project state into a compact empirical story and a concrete set of lessons for future iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文总结将 VITOK 进展整合为单一多教师蒸馏配方的研究：通过一系列改进（分离适配头、非对称损失、DINOv3-L 初始化、教师重加权、MIM、PHI-S 特征平衡），在保留全局识别能力的同时恢复密集语义，最终超过 DINOv3-L 教师的 ImageNet-1K kNN 表现并在 ADE20K 上追平教师。
AI.motivation: 多教师蒸馏中同一配方难以同时优化全局识别与密集语义：提升 ImageNet-1K kNN 准确率的改动可能反而降低 ADE20K 分割性能，作者希望显式化并管理这一权衡。
AI.method: 以 AM-RADIO 风格学生为基础，从 SigLIP2（全局语义）与 DINOv3-L（密集特征）蒸馏；逐步引入分离的 CLS/patch 适配头、非对称 cosine/MSE 损失、DINOv3-L 检查点初始化、教师重加权、掩码图像建模（MIM）和 PHI-S 特征平衡。
AI.result: 模型达到 83.2 patch kNN 与 85.2 CLS kNN，略超 DINOv3-L 教师的 ImageNet-1K kNN；PHI-S 将 ADE20K 从 46.5/58.1 提升到 48.5/61.0 mIoU/mAcc，追平教师。负结果：从 ImageNet-1K 扩展到 ImageNet22K 不持续有效，天真加入 SAM3 或 HOG 等额外教师会引入干扰。
AI.conclusion: 本文不宣称最终配方，而是将当前项目状态提炼为紧凑的经验总结，为后续迭代提供具体教训。

title: VisAudit: Evaluating Multimodal Agents for Visual Diagnosis and Repair
summary: Multimodal agents are increasingly used for data visualization tasks but remain limited in autonomous review. Unlike humans, they may fail to recognize when a visualization is incorrect, determine what to change, repair it without disrupting correct content, and verify whether the intervention succeeded. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate predefined individual capabilities such as chart generation, instruction-guided editing, or defect detection, and therefore do not capture this gap in autonomous review. We introduce VisAudit, a benchmark for evaluating visualization diagnosis, repair, and verification. Given a rendered chart and configurable auxiliary evidence, including its source data table, intended text summary, and visualization code, an agent iteratively diagnoses potential defects, modifies and executes visualization code, inspects execution and visual feedback, and determines when no further intervention is needed. VisAudit defines three tracks spanning diagnosed repair, autonomous repair, and open-world verification, and contains 1,900 flawed instances across 21 chart types and 10 flaw categories, together with 300 initially correct charts. We construct the benchmark through controlled perturbations of validated source visualizations, with systematic verification and human-aligned quality control to ensure that injected defects are well-defined and recoverable from the available evidence. Experiments with leading multimodal models reveal a substantial gap from reliable autonomous review: the strongest evaluated model fully recovers only $47.4\%$ of flawed charts in the autonomous-repair setting.

AI.tldr: 介绍VisAudit基准，用于评估多模态智能体对可视化的自治诊断、修复与验证能力，填补现有基准只评测单一能力的空白。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体在可视化任务中无法像人类一样自主评审：难以识别错误、决定修改内容、在不破坏正确内容的前提下修复并验证效果。现有基准只评测图表生成、指令引导编辑或缺陷检测等单一能力，无法反映自治评审的缺口。
AI.method: 提出VisAudit基准：给定渲染图表及可配置辅助证据（源数据表、预期文本摘要、可视化代码），智能体迭代诊断缺陷、修改并执行代码、检查执行与视觉反馈，直至判断无需干预。包含诊断修复、自治修复、开放世界验证三条赛道，通过受控扰动已校验可视化并经过系统验证与人工对齐质控构建。
AI.result: 基准含1,900个缺陷实例，覆盖21种图表类型和10类缺陷，另有300个初始正确图表。主流多模态模型实验显示，自治评审能力与可靠水平存在显著差距：最强模型在自治修复设置下仅能完全恢复47.4%的缺陷图表。
AI.conclusion: 多模态智能体距可靠的自治可视化评审仍有较大差距，VisAudit为系统评估该能力提供了基准。

title: CuBEs: Culturally-Situated Behavioral Evaluations and the Limitations of Culture-Blind LLM Judges
summary: Evaluating the occurrence and triggers of large language model (LLM) behaviors - such as sycophancy, self-preference, or over-confidence - is critical for predicting real-world model deployment risks. However, existing situated behavioral evaluations typically ignore cultural context, limiting their generalizability across an increasingly global user base. To address this gap, we propose CuBEs - Culturally-situated Behavior Evaluations that probe for response patterns across diverse user cultures. We first extend an automated testing pipeline to inject cultural context into behavioral test scenarios and subsequent evaluation. We assess the cultural adaptability of this pipeline by building a human-labeled dataset that captures nuanced dimensions of behavior understanding across 12 distinct cultures. Our dataset reveals significant cross-cultural variations that one-size-fits all judgments fail to capture. Through evaluating 13 open- and closed-source LLMs, we find that introducing cultural situatedness in the evaluation scenario creates significant variation in the presence of a behavior. For example, while our baseline experiments testing for political bias capture localized Western political dimensions like the American conservative-progressive divide, non-Western culturally situated evaluations surface entirely different axes of bias such as religious and colonial political issues. Our findings demonstrate that standard, culturally-agnostic evaluations fail to capture these shifts, highlighting the necessity of culturally situated behavioral testing for global deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CuBEs框架，将文化情境注入LLM行为评估，揭示跨文化差异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM行为评估（如谄媚、自我偏好、过度自信）忽视文化背景，难以泛化到全球用户群体。
AI.method: 扩展自动化测试流程，注入文化情境；构建覆盖12种文化的人工标注数据集；评估13个开源与闭源LLM。
AI.result: 数据集中存在显著的跨文化差异；文化情境显著改变行为出现情况。例如政治偏见基线只捕捉西方保守-进步维度，非西方评估则浮现宗教与殖民等不同轴。
AI.conclusion: 标准、去文化评估无法捕捉这些变化，全球部署必须采用文化情境化的行为测试。

title: The Geometry of Knowledge Accessibility in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) contain broad knowledge, but they cannot access all of it reliably. We study this problem through knowledge accessibility, which describes whether the knowledge needed for a query can be recalled from the model. We find that knowledge accessibility has a simple geometric structure in the model's representation of the query alone, before any generation. More accessible queries are closer to a center in the representation space, while less accessible queries are farther away. This geometry reveals a knowledge boundary that separates more accessible queries from less accessible ones. Accessibility consistently decreases with distance from the center, and this distance-based ordering transfers across datasets even when the centers differ. Controlled experiments further show that the centered geometry is more closely related to knowledge accessibility than to reasoning difficulty. The geometry also reveals when different interventions are useful. Query rewriting helps more for accessible queries, chain-of-thought reasoning helps more near the boundary, and retrieval gives larger gains beyond the boundary. These findings not only provide a new geometric view of how knowledge is organized in language models, but also suggest a useful pre-generation signal for adaptive inference.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大模型的知识可及性（knowledge accessibility），发现查询表示空间中存在简单的几何结构：可及性高的查询更靠近中心，低的更远，从而揭示可分离可及性的"知识边界"，并可用于自适应推理。
AI.motivation: LLM包含广泛知识但无法可靠访问所有知识。作者希望通过研究知识可及性（查询所需知识能否被模型回忆）来理解这一问题，并寻找生成前的可及性信号。
AI.method: 分析模型对查询的表示（生成前），发现以中心为参照的几何结构：可及性随与中心距离增大而下降；该距离排序可跨数据集迁移；并做控制实验区分可及性与推理难度；考察不同干预（查询改写、CoT、检索）在不同区域的效果。
AI.result: 可及性随离中心距离单调下降，距离排序可跨数据集迁移；中心化几何与知识可及性关系比推理难度更密切；查询改写对高可及性查询更有效，CoT在边界附近更有效，检索在边界外收益更大。
AI.conclusion: 该几何视角揭示了LLM中知识的组织方式，并提供了一个有用的生成前信号，可用于自适应推理（选择合适干预）。

title: Custom Forcing: Training-Free Subject Customization for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video models can generate minute-long videos in real time, but they produce generic subjects from text rather than specific subjects from user-provided images. Existing customization methods either require costly per-subject optimization or use pretrained conditioning networks that jointly process all video frames with bidirectional attention. Neither approach is designed for causal streaming. We present Custom Forcing, a training-free method that stores reference-based anchor frames in the persistent KV cache of a frozen autoregressive video model. However, fixed anchors face two limitations: simple conditioning allows identity to drift, and the text prompt continues to favor a generic subject. To address these problems, drift-adaptive value amplification (DVA) scales reference influence with the degree of identity drift, while anchor contrast guidance (ACG) steers generation away from the generic class prior. Over two-minute rollouts, fixed anchors fall from 0.58 to 0.42 in DINO-I, while Custom Forcing keeps it between 0.58 and 0.62 without reducing motion. Custom Forcing also achieves higher subject similarity than bidirectional customization methods and better preserves identity over 30s than causal image-to-video and reference-to-video models, while generating each frame 9.5--28.5 times faster than these long-video baselines.

AI.tldr: Custom Forcing 是一种无需训练的定制化方法，通过在冻结的自回归视频模型的持久 KV 缓存中存储基于参考的锚帧，实现实时、因果流式的特定主体视频生成。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频模型能实时生成长视频，但只能从文本生成通用主体，无法根据用户图像生成特定主体。现有定制方法要么需昂贵的逐主体优化，要么用双向注意力的预训练条件网络联合处理所有帧，二者都不适合因果流式生成。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：（1）将基于参考的锚帧存入冻结自回归视频模型的持久 KV 缓存；（2）drift-adaptive value amplification（DVA）根据身份漂移程度放大参考影响；（3）anchor contrast guidance（ACG）引导生成远离通用类别先验。
AI.result: 在两分钟以上的 rollout 中，固定锚帧的 DINO-I 从 0.58 降至 0.42，而 Custom Forcing 保持在 0.58–0.62 且不损失运动。主体相似度高于双向定制方法，30 秒内身份保持优于因果 image-to-video 和 reference-to-video 模型，每帧生成速度快 9.5–28.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: Custom Forcing 无需训练即可在因果流式自回归视频模型中实现高质量主体定制，兼顾身份一致性与生成效率。

title: Trained Agentic Context Management
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/brycesandlund/infinite-context. Under review
summary: We study long context language models. Instead of training long context natively, or designing a long context harness, we train a model over the simplest possible harness: a tool to call itself with any specified prompt and a tool to read tokens in a range from the input context. We finetune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on a diverse synthetic dataset using this harness. With only 8,000 tokens of context, our small model is as strong as GPT-5.4 with 1M tokens of context on the OOLONG-synth benchmark when document length exceeds 40K tokens.

AI.tldr: 训练一个在极简工具框架（自调用+范围读取工具）上的模型，用仅8K上下文在OOLONG-synth长文档任务上媲美1M上下文的GPT-5.4。
AI.motivation: 长上下文语言模型通常依赖原生长上下文训练或复杂的外部框架，成本高且复杂。作者希望用最简单的工具框架来替代这些方案。
AI.method: 设计最简工具框架：一个可用任意提示自调用的工具，和一个可读取输入上下文指定范围token的工具。用多样合成数据集微调Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。
AI.result: 在OOLONG-synth基准上，当文档长度超过40K token时，仅用8,000 token上下文的模型性能与拥有1M token上下文的GPT-5.4相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过极简工具框架微调小模型，可在长上下文任务上以极少上下文达到大模型长上下文的效果，提供了一种高效替代方案。

title: Lost in the Request: How Communication Variation Disrupts Retrieval and Action in Email Agents
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents
summary: An email assistant should not complete less work simply because a user phrases the same request differently. Yet most benchmarks test each task with only one canonical request, leaving this form of robustness largely unmeasured. We test whether email assistants remain reliable when the requested information, available evidence, and expected outcome stay fixed, but the communication style or English variety changes. We construct validated variants along five communication-style axes and four rule-based dialect conditions, and evaluate them on three benchmarks: a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline and two tool-using agents. Indirect requests reduce performance on all three benchmarks, while formal requests reduce performance on both agentic benchmarks. Examining the systems more closely shows that these failures have different causes. Verbose requests mainly hurt a lexical retriever by making the relevant email harder to find. By contrast, indirect and dialect variants remain harmful even when the relevant email is retrieved. In the agentic setting, indirect and formal requests mainly cause the agents to omit required actions, not to take more unsupported actions. These results show that a successful response is not enough to establish robustness: evaluations should vary how requests are expressed and separately measure whether agents complete the requested work.

AI.tldr: 测试邮件助手在请求内容不变但沟通风格/英语变体改变时的鲁棒性，发现间接请求和正式请求会导致性能下降，且失败原因各异。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多以单一标准表述测试任务，无法衡量同一请求因措辞或英语变体不同而导致的鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 沿五个沟通风格轴和四种基于规则的方言条件构造验证变体，在三个基准上评估：一个RAG流水线和两个使用工具的智能体。
AI.result: 间接请求降低三个基准的性能，正式请求降低两个智能体基准的性能；冗长请求主要影响词汇检索器；间接和方言变体即便检索到相关邮件仍有害；智能体失败主要是遗漏必要动作而非多余动作。
AI.conclusion: 成功的响应不足以证明鲁棒性，评估应变化请求表达方式并单独衡量智能体是否完成所要求的工作。

title: HARPO: Hallucination-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Faithful and Creative Language Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to generating hallucinated content, which compromises their reliability in knowledge-intensive tasks. To address this challenge without sacrificing creativity, we propose HARPO, a reinforcement learning framework designed to jointly optimize faithfulness and creativity. HARPO incorporates a Hallucination-Aware Generative Reward Model (HA-GRM), trained via verifiable feedback, to assess both faithfulness and writing quality. A Selective Activation Mechanism (SAM) activates writing rewards only for outputs judged hallucination-free by HA-GRM, while a data curriculum progressively shifts training from creative writing to hallucination-centric tasks. On RAGTruth, our Qwen3-4B-based HA-GRM achieves a response-level F1 score of 78.08%, compared with 66.37% for the supervised fine-tuning baseline. Experiments on Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 8B parameters show improvements in both faithful generation and writing quality. On Qwen3-4B, HARPO reduces the HA-GRM-judged hallucination rate on MultiHopRAG from 3.29% to 1.02%, while increasing the Arena-Hard-v2.0 creative-writing score from 16.95% to 27.54%.

AI.tldr: HARPO是一个强化学习框架，通过幻觉感知生成奖励模型、选择性激活机制和数据课程，联合优化大语言模型的忠实性与创造力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型易产生幻觉，损害其在知识密集型任务中的可靠性，同时又不希望牺牲创造力。
AI.method: 提出HARPO强化学习框架，包含：经由可验证反馈训练的幻觉感知生成奖励模型（HA-GRM）评估忠实性与写作质量；选择性激活机制（SAM）仅对无幻觉输出激活写作奖励；数据课程从创意写作逐步过渡到以幻觉为中心的任务。
AI.result: 在RAGTruth上，基于Qwen3-4B的HA-GRM响应级F1达78.08%（监督微调基线为66.37%）；Qwen2.5与Qwen3（1.7B-8B）上忠实生成与写作质量均提升。Qwen3-4B在MultiHopRAG上幻觉率由3.29%降至1.02%，Arena-Hard-v2.0创意写作分数由16.95%升至27.54%。
AI.conclusion: HARPO能有效联合提升忠实性与创造力，在多个模型规模上均具良好效果。

title: Kinematics-Induced Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation with Subject-Level Privacy
summary: Multimodal 3D Human Pose Estimation (3D HPE) combines complementary information from RGB, LiDAR, and mmWave radar, but models trained on correlated observations from the same individuals, raise privacy risks overlooked by record level analysis. We present a unified framework for multimodal 3D HPE that couples kinematics-induced sensor fusion with subject level privacy auditing and private training. First, our multimodal model aligns modality specific joint representation, injects skeletal structure and adaptively aggregates complementary sensor evidence for accurate pose prediction. Second, we formulate a black-box subject membership inference attack for 3D HPE, complemented by an empirical pointwise maximal leakage analysis, which characterizes how individual attack score outcomes change inference about the membership outcome. Third, we instantiate user-level differential privacy via Action Temporal Stratification, a population weighted within-subject sampling strategy that enforces action and temporal coverage. We evaluate our framework on the MM-Fi dataset across three diverse experimental protocols. Source-code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的多人多模态3D人体姿态估计框架，将传感器融合与受试者级隐私审计和隐私训练相结合。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态3D HPE依赖同一受试者的相关观测训练，存在被记录级分析忽视的隐私风险。
AI.method: 1) 多模态模型对齐各模态关节表征，注入骨架结构并自适应聚合互补传感证据；2) 面向3D HPE的黑盒受试者成员推断攻击与逐点最大泄漏分析；3) 通过动作-时间分层采样实现用户级差分隐私。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi数据集上的三种实验协议中评估了该框架。
AI.conclusion: 该框架兼顾准确姿态预测与受试者级隐私保护，源代码将在录用后发布。

title: Efficient Neural Field Learning via Adaptive Coverage and Focused Sampling
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) provide a flexible framework for modeling high-dimensional continuous fields, but their training is often inefficient due to uniform subsampling that ignores spatial heterogeneity. Existing adaptive sampling methods partially address this issue by prioritizing high-error samples, but typically operate at the point level, often leading to redundant sampling in localized regions and insufficient coverage of the domain. We propose ACES (Adaptive Coverage-aware Efficient Sampling), a structured sampling framework that improves training efficiency by decoupling coverage and importance. ACES constructs adaptive spatial partitions to ensure domain coverage and reduce redundancy, and applies region-level importance weighting to prioritize informative regions during training. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that adaptive partitioning reduces gradient variance by increasing within-region homogeneity, and that controlled bias in region-level weighting may improve optimization efficiency relative to standard unbiased estimators. Experiments on scientific field learning tasks demonstrate that ACES achieves faster convergence and lower error than uniform and pointwise adaptive sampling baselines, with the largest gains in fields with highly localized complexity.

AI.tldr: ACES 提出一种结构化采样框架，通过解耦覆盖与重要性来提升隐式神经表示（INR）的训练效率。
AI.motivation: INR 训练因均匀子采样忽略空间异质性而效率低下；现有点级自适应采样方法易在局部区域冗余采样且域覆盖不足。
AI.method: ACES 构建自适应空间划分以保证域覆盖、减少冗余，并对区域做区域级重要性加权以优先采样信息量大的区域；同时进行理论分析，证明自适应划分通过提高区域内同质性降低梯度方差，且区域级加权中的受控偏差可提升优化效率。
AI.result: 在科学场学习任务上，ACES 相比均匀采样和点级自适应采样基线收敛更快、误差更低，在具有高度局部复杂性的场上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、覆盖感知的区域级采样能有效提升 INR 训练效率，尤其适用于局部复杂度高的场建模任务。

title: Designing the Future of User Feedback for Generative AI
summary: Post-deployment feedback from users can be a cost-effective, scalable, and representative means to monitor and improve generative AI systems and features. When implemented effectively, giving such feedback can increase users' engagement with and trust in GenAI systems. Government regulations and industry guidelines call for post-deployment user engagement, but there is little guidance on designing mechanisms that are usable for consumers and provide actionable input for product teams. We conducted a multi-phase study as a collaboration between academic researchers and eBay. Our benchmark evaluation of current industry approaches identified common issues including lack of discoverability, unclear terminology, and inattention to user value. Based on these findings, we developed best-practice recommendations and designed and tested a prototype feedback-collection tool. The tool aimed to provide users with an efficient, flexible, and positive feedback-giving experience, and provide product teams with rich data on performance and potential problems in a usable format.

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何设计生成式AI部署后的用户反馈机制。通过与eBay合作的多阶段研究，评估现有行业方案（发现性差、术语不清、忽视用户价值），提出最佳实践建议并设计测试了一个反馈采集原型工具，兼顾用户体验与产品团队可用数据。
AI.motivation: 部署后用户反馈是低成本、可扩展、有代表性的GenAI监控与改进手段，且能提升用户参与度和信任；法规和行业指南也要求部署后用户参与，但缺乏面向消费者可用、且对产品团队有可操作性的设计指导。
AI.method: 学术界与eBay合作开展多阶段研究：先对当前行业反馈方案进行基准评估，识别问题；据此提炼最佳实践建议，并设计、测试一个反馈采集原型工具。
AI.result: 基准评估发现现有方案普遍存在发现性不足、术语不清晰、忽视用户价值等问题；原型工具旨在提供高效、灵活、正向的反馈体验，并为产品团队提供性能与潜在问题的丰富、可用数据。
AI.conclusion: 有效的GenAI部署后用户反馈机制需兼顾用户可用性与产品团队可操作性；论文给出了设计建议与经测试的原型工具作为实践指导。

title: Unmasking Propaganda: A Comparative Analysis of Masked and Causal Language Models
summary: Propaganda detection is an essential task in natural language processing (NLP), particularly in the context of manipulative political communications. However, identifying specific propaganda techniques presents a significant challenge due to their often subtle nature and reliance on context, making them difficult to distinguish from legitimate persuasive language. Propaganda often involves highlighting certain facts while downplaying or ignoring others to create a desired perception. This biased communication aims to influence attitudes, beliefs, or behaviors towards a particular cause or position. This paper explores advances in detecting propaganda techniques through a comparative analysis of modern language models, using the SemEval-2020 Task 11 dataset. We evaluated both masked language models (based on XLM-RoBERTa or DeBERTa V3) and causal models (from OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Anthropic and Meta), employing two prompting strategies: base and chain-of-thought prompting. Our results demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art models, with the best-performing MLM achieving an F1 score of 63.18 in technique classification and the best causal model achieving 63.62. We also observed that certain models excel in specific techniques, such as loaded language and name-calling, while struggling with others like bandwagon and black-and-white fallacy. These findings suggest that fine-tuning, ensemble modeling, and the use of larger datasets can further enhance propaganda detection capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文比较掩码语言模型（XLM-RoBERTa、DeBERTa V3）与因果模型（OpenAI、Google、Mistral、Anthropic、Meta）在SemEval-2020 Task 11宣传技巧检测任务上的表现，采用基础与链式思维提示策略，取得优于SOTA的结果。
AI.motivation: 宣传技巧识别因手法隐晦、依赖语境，难以与合法说服性语言区分，是NLP中的重要挑战；本文旨在探索现代语言模型在该任务上的检测能力并比较不同模型与提示方法的效果。
AI.method: 基于SemEval-2020 Task 11数据集，评估两类模型：掩码语言模型（XLM-RoBERTa、DeBERTa V3）和因果模型（来自OpenAI、Google、Mistral、Anthropic、Meta），并使用两种提示策略：基础提示与链式思维（chain-of-thought）提示进行对比分析。
AI.result: 结果优于现有SOTA模型：最佳MLM在技巧分类上F1为63.18，最佳因果模型为63.62；某些模型在loaded language、name-calling等技巧上表现突出，而在bandwagon、black-and-white fallacy等技巧上表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明微调、集成建模及更大数据集的使用可进一步提升宣传检测能力。

title: When Predicting Nothing Beats SAM 3: Revisiting Evaluation in Video Object Segmentation
summary: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) in complex and long videos is increasingly important for real-world applications, where target objects often appear only intermittently within long temporal horizons. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on temporally salient objects that remain visible for most of the video. To address this gap, we introduce FaVOS (A Benchmark for Video Object Segmentation with Fractional Temporal Visibility), a benchmark designed to evaluate VOS methods under low temporal visibility. We show that, in this regime, the standard J&F metric can collapse VOS evaluation into absence classification, because empty predictions receive high rewards on target-absent frames. Consequently, even a trivial empty-mask predictor can outperform strong models such as SAM 3, revealing a fundamental mismatch between current metrics and practical VOS performance. To mitigate this issue, we propose Volumetric J&F, which evaluates mask sequences as spatio-temporal volumes and reduces the dominance of target-absence rewards while preserving sensitivity to segmentation quality and temporal structure. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/FaVOS.

AI.tldr: 提出FaVOS基准，揭示低时间可见性VOS中J&F指标退化为"缺失分类"，并提出Volumetric J&F改进评估。
AI.motivation: 现有VOS基准多关注长时间可见的目标，忽略目标仅间歇出现的复杂长视频场景，而此场景更贴近实际应用。
AI.method: 构建FaVOS基准，评估低时间可见性下的VOS方法，并分析标准J&F指标的缺陷；进一步提出Volumetric J&F，将掩码序列视为时空体进行评价。
AI.result: 在低可见性场景下，J&F退化为缺失分类，空掩码预测器甚至优于SAM 3等强模型，暴露指标与实用性能的错配。
AI.conclusion: Volumetric J&F可降低缺失帧奖励主导性，同时保留对分割质量和时间结构的敏感性，提供更合理的评估。

title: Prompted to Discriminate: Generalizing Malicious-Input Probes in the Wild
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on activation probes as runtime monitors for prompt injection, jailbreaks, and unsafe requests, reading the model's own hidden state to catch a harmful input before the agent acts on it. A cheap, increasingly common move, borrowed from LLM-as-judge prompting, is to append a short classification instruction after the user's turn and read the probe at that point, to sharpen it: the instruction asks the model to represent the incoming request as a class, concentrating the signal the probe must separate, at negligible serving cost. But does the wording of that suffix matter, and does its benefit hold in the wild, on attack types the probe never saw in training, the regime a deployed monitor faces? We test this with a controlled ladder of post-user suffixes under strict leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation across 13 safety benchmarks (jailbreak, injection, and benign chat) and three open-weight model families (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B). On a single-position probe, a classification suffix consistently improves out-of-distribution detection over no suffix (up to ~4 AUC points); yet which suffix matters: prompting the model to classify the input, even into content-free labels, reliably wins; an off-topic or merely-attentive suffix helps little. The gain comes from the classification format, not the named criterion: a content-free suffix matches the real malicious/benign one, with the criterion adding precision only at strict thresholds. This is not an artifact of the single-position read: the benefit carries to the multi-position pooling probes used in production (attention, multi-max, MLP), though the best-performing suffix there is readout-dependent. Served through a KV-cache fork, it is a cheap drop-in for any activation-probe monitor, though not an automatic win: which suffix helps, and by how much, depends on the model and the readout.

AI.tldr: 对激活探针监测器附加"分类指令后缀"能有效提升分布外检测，关键在于分类格式本身而非具体准则。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体用激活探针做运行时监控，常用做法是在用户回合后附加简短分类指令以锐化探针信号。但后缀措辞是否有影响、在未见攻击类型上是否有效尚未验证。
AI.method: 在严格LODO评估下，跨13个安全基准（越狱、注入、良性对话）和三个开源模型家族（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-12B），构建受控的后缀阶梯进行测试，并对比单位置与多位置池化探针。
AI.result: 分类后缀在单位置探针上持续提升OOD检测（最高约4个AUC点）；内容无关的分类后缀即可匹配真实恶意/良性后缀；收益可迁移到注意力、multi-max、MLP等生产级池化探针，但最优后缀依赖读出方式。
AI.conclusion: 通过KV-cache fork部署，该方法是任何激活探针监测器的廉价即插即用改进，但并非自动获胜——后缀收益取决于模型与读出方式。

title: Batched Speech Decisions Without Decoding: Single-Token Supervision Lets a Frozen LLM Hear Beyond the Transcript
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and weights: https://github.com/adventists-ai/duplexjev
summary: Full-duplex voice agents make many small, closed decisions, which current systems answer by slow autoregressive decoding. We propose DuplexJev, which feeds ASR-encoder hidden states through a small connector into a frozen LLM and reads each question as a single-token distribution over its options. Nothing is decoded, and an 8-GPU node answers 80 decisions about eight utterances in about 0.1 s. With a last-layer connector, spoken QA stays close to reading the transcript (90% vs. 91%). DuplexJev also hears the speaker: gender and emotion accuracy both reach 90% (from 55% and 28%) with a cross-attention connector, whose spoken QA drops by only 1 point (83% to 82%). We train decisions with cross-entropy on the read-out answer token, instead of the usual transcript distillation, whose teacher never hears the voice, and keep distillation for content. Encoders and LLMs are interchangeable; we release weights, training recipe, a batched-inference pipeline for full-duplex serving and a bilingual spoken-QA set.

AI.tldr: DuplexJev 将 ASR 编码器隐状态经小型连接器送入冻结 LLM，把每个决策当作单token选项分布读取，无需自回归解码，实现全双工语音智能体的快速小决策。
AI.motivation: 当前全双工语音智能体需做大量小的封闭式决策，但现有系统依赖缓慢的自回归解码，效率低。
AI.method: 将 ASR 编码器隐状态通过连接器输入冻结 LLM，把问题读作单token的选项分布；用交叉熵在读出答案token上训练决策而非转录蒸馏；对比last-layer与cross-attention连接器。
AI.result: 8-GPU节点约0.1秒回答8段语音的80个决策；last-layer连接器下语音QA接近读转录（90% vs 91%）；cross-attention连接器下性别与情感准确率均达90%（从55%、28%），语音QA仅降1点（83%→82%）。
AI.conclusion: DuplexJev 以高效单token读出实现快速全双工决策，且能同时感知说话人属性，编解码器与LLM可互换，并开源权重、训练配方、推理管线与双语语音QA集。

title: An automated pipeline for standardised speech-unit annotation in spontaneous dialogue
summary: Quantifying conversational dynamics requires reliable identification of interactional units and their temporal boundaries, but speech activity alone does not distinguish conversational turns from listener feedback or within-turn pauses. We present an automated pipeline for extracting turns and backchannels from separate-channel recordings of spontaneous dyadic conversation, designed to provide a consistent first-pass annotation for subsequent human review. The pipeline combines voice activity detection, channel-energy filtering, temporal merging, automatic speech recognition, and context-based post-processing. We evaluated the pipeline on 99 ten-minute Danish conversations from 33 dyads using segment-level detection reliability and temporal boundary error. Conversations were recorded under both normal and asymmetric listening conditions. In the latter, speech-shaped noise was delivered to one participant through bone-conduction headphones. Overall detection reliability was F1=0.621, with similar performance for turns F1=0.624 and backchannels F1=0.618. For successfully matched segments, median absolute onset and offset errors were 0.150 and 0.160s for turns and 0.130 and 0.180s for backchannels, respectively. Mean errors were substantially larger for turn boundaries, indicating a smaller number of large boundary mismatches. Performance did not differ significantly across the two experimental listening conditions. In a four-conversation case study, pipeline-human agreement was lower and more variable than human inter-annotator agreement and varied across parameter settings. These results support the pipeline as an automated first pass within a semi-automated annotation workflow, providing a consistent basis for more standardised and reproducible annotation of conversational dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一套自动提取双人对话中话轮(turn)与反馈语(backchannel)的流水线，作为半自动标注的初筛步骤，在99段丹麦语对话上F1=0.621，时间边界误差约0.13–0.18秒。
AI.motivation: 量化会话动态需要可靠识别交互单元及其时间边界，但单纯的语音活动无法区分话轮、听者反馈与话轮内停顿，因此需要自动化的初筛标注。
AI.method: 流水线结合语音活动检测、通道能量滤波、时间合并、自动语音识别与基于上下文的后处理；在33对说话人的99段10分钟丹麦语对话（正常与不对称聆听条件）上评估，使用分段级检测可靠性与时间边界误差指标。
AI.result: 总体检测可靠性F1=0.621（话轮0.624，反馈语0.618）；匹配段的中位起止误差约0.15/0.16秒（话轮）与0.13/0.18秒（反馈语），话轮边界均值误差明显更大；两种聆听条件无显著差异；四对话案例中流水线与人工一致性低于人工间一致性且随参数变化。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线可作为半自动标注流程中的自动初筛，为更标准化、可复现的会话动态标注提供一致基础。

title: TerraVis: Towards Evaluation of World-Grounded Visual Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation via MLLM Workflows
summary: Recent text-to-image models have made substantial progress in photorealism, aesthetics, and text-image alignment. Yet visually appealing images can still violate real-world plausibility, exhibiting malformed object structures, impossible anatomy, physically implausible interactions, or inconsistent spatial relationships. Such failures are not well captured by existing fidelity, aesthetics, preference, or alignment metrics. To address this gap, we introduce TerraVis, a framework for evaluating world-grounded visual consistency in generated images. TerraVis defines a structured taxonomy of world-consistency violations spanning object-, interaction-, and scene-level failures, and employs a multi-stage evaluation framework to identify and quantify them. Given an image, TerraVis first uses an MLLM to assess its eligibility for evaluation, then detects violations across 18 taxonomy-defined types and classifies them as minor or major to derive an overall world-consistency score. Across diverse open-source and proprietary text-to-image models on two widely used benchmarks, TerraVis achieves the strongest correlation with human judgments of world consistency among existing metrics. Our benchmark results further show that models that achieve strong performance on conventional metrics can still exhibit substantial world-consistency failures. These findings highlight world consistency as a complementary evaluation dimension and demonstrate that TerraVis enables systematic quantification, diagnosis, and comparison of such failures. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShyFoo/TerraVis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TerraVis，一个评估生成图像"世界 grounded 视觉一致性"的框架，通过18类违规分类和多阶段评估量化图像在物体、交互和场景层面的现实合理性失效。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型虽在真实感、美学和文本对齐上进步显著，但仍会产生结构畸形、解剖错误、物理不合理、空间关系不一致等违反现实合理性的图像，而现有保真度、美学、偏好和对齐指标无法很好地捕捉这些失败。
AI.method: TerraVis定义了一套结构化的世界一致性违规分类法（覆盖物体级、交互级和场景级失败），并采用多阶段评估框架：先用MLLM判断图像是否适合评估，再检测18种分类定义的违规类型，并将其分为轻微或严重，从而得出整体世界一致性得分。
AI.result: 在两个广泛使用的基准上，对多种开源和专有文本到图像模型进行评估，TerraVis在与人类世界一致性判断的相关性上优于现有指标。基准结果还显示，在传统指标上表现强的模型仍可能存在大量世界一致性失败。
AI.conclusion: 世界一致性是一个互补的评估维度，TerraVis能够系统性地量化、诊断和比较此类失败。

title: The AI Theorist reveals excitonic structure in $α$-RuCl$_3$
summary: Advances in experimental instrumentation and automation generate increasingly rich datasets, but turning experimental observations into microscopic understanding remains a bottleneck in scientific discovery. To accelerate this process, we introduce AI Theorist, a system of artificial intelligence (AI) agents for autonomous discovery of physical models through hypothesis generation, first-principles calculations and evidence-driven refinement. We apply the framework to $α$-RuCl$_3$, a leading candidate material for realizing a Kitaev quantum spin liquid, to investigate its electronic structure through optical spectra. AI Theorist develops a new interpretation of the optical and photocurrent observations, identifying distinct excitonic states with contrasting optical selection rules and real-space distributions. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an AI system autonomously developing a physical model to explain previously unpublished experimental observations in a quantum material, utilizing first-principles electronic-structure and many-body calculations. Our results establish a route to autonomous theoretical discovery in materials science, in which AI agents use first-principles calculations to turn experimental observations into physical models and testable predictions.

AI.tldr: AI Theorist：一组AI智能体自主完成假设生成、第一性原理计算与证据驱动修正，为α-RuCl₃光学谱提出新的激子解释，首次实现AI自主构建量子材料物理模型。
AI.motivation: 实验仪器与自动化产生海量数据，但将观测转化为微观物理理解仍是科学发现的瓶颈，亟需自主化的理论建模手段。
AI.method: 提出AI Theorist系统，由多AI智能体协作：生成假设、开展第一性原理电子结构与多体计算、基于证据迭代修正模型；并应用于Kitaev量子自旋液体候选材料α-RuCl₃的光谱研究。
AI.result: 系统给出对光学与光电流观测的新解释，识别出具有不同光学选择定则与实空间分布的不同激子态。
AI.conclusion: 首次展示AI系统自主为量子材料中未发表的实验观测构建物理模型，确立了材料科学中"自主理论发现"的路径，并可产出可检验预言。

title: Coherence-Driven Belief Formation and Population Dynamics of Contagion in LLM Agents
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST)
summary: Models of social contagion usually assume how individuals adopt beliefs and derive population behavior from it. We instead empirically measure belief adoption in language model agents, quantifying the probability an agent adopts a claim given how many peers endorse it. We find this adoption kernel to be sigmoid, a characteristic of complex contagion, with a threshold that is sensitive to three sources: the claim's plausibility, the source's reliability, and the agent's disposition. These three dimensions are well approximated by a single effective dimension which we propose can be understood as the coherence of the incoming belief with the LLM agent's prior beliefs. Further, we observe a characteristic of complex contagion in the collective dynamics of belief adoption in a system of AI agents: further spread on clustered than random networks. These systems also exhibit a bifurcating cascade window, and self-sustaining hysteretic consensus which lead to consensus being far harder to remove than to establish.

AI.tldr: 本文实证测量LLM智能体的信念采纳概率，发现其呈S型（复杂传染特征），阈值受可信度/来源/倾向影响并可归结为单一"连贯性"维度，集体动态表现出复杂传染特性。
AI.motivation: 社会传染模型通常假设个体如何采纳信念并据此推导群体行为，但缺乏对信念采纳过程的实证测量。作者希望用语言模型智能体实证测量信念采纳，以验证社会传染理论的假设。
AI.method: 通过语言模型智能体测量信念采纳：量化智能体在多少同伴背书某一主张时采纳该主张的概率，即"采纳核"；并考察概率对主张可信度、来源可靠性和智能体倾向三因素的敏感性；在智能体系统中对比聚类网络与随机网络上的传播动态。
AI.result: 采纳核呈S型，是复杂传染的特征；其阈值对上述三个来源敏感，且三个维度可近似为单一有效维度——即传入信念与LLM智能体先验信念的"连贯性"；集体动态中，聚类网络上的传播比随机网络更远；系统表现出分岔的级联窗口和自维持的滞后共识。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体的信念采纳呈现复杂传染特征，三因素可归结为单一连贯性维度；其集体动力学具有级联窗口与滞后共识，导致共识的消除远比建立困难。

title: Ask, Relax, or Act? Evaluating Actionable Indeterminacy in LLM Preference Reasoning
summary: An LLM agent can recognize uncertainty yet still choose the wrong next step: asking when action is already justified, or seeking clarification when the constraints must change. We formalize actionable indeterminacy: act when an accepted action is shared across all admissible preferences or objectives, clarify when each possibility is feasible but no action is shared, and propose a minimum-cost permitted constraint repair when the request is infeasible. We construct a solver-grounded benchmark spanning object allocation, meeting scheduling, apartment choice, and stable matching. Matched pairs retain the same source while changing whether intervention is necessary, and evaluation separates decision correctness, matched-pair reliability, and fully correct responses. Our findings reveal a recurring difficulty in recognizing when intervention is unnecessary: models can identify situations requiring clarification or repair yet still intervene when a justified action already exists. Correct decision labels also fail to guarantee usable actions, questions, or repairs. Crucially, response requirements shape not only how decisions are expressed but also which decisions are made. Making the required content explicit substantially improves fully correct responses and can change intervention decisions, even when outputs are already parseable. These findings highlight that reliable agency requires more than recognizing uncertainty: it requires intervening only when necessary and translating the chosen next step into a verifiable response.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"可操作不确定性"框架，要求LLM智能体在存在被所有可行偏好共享的动作时直接行动、仅在无共享动作时澄清、在不可行时提出最小成本的约束修复；构建了跨任务基准揭示模型过度干预及决策标签无法保证可用响应的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽能识别不确定性，却常做出错误决策：在本可直接行动时反而提问，或在需修改约束时寻求澄清。可靠能动性需要判断"何时不必干预"，现有评估忽视了这一问题。
AI.method: 形式化"可操作不确定性"（actionable indeterminacy）：当某动作被所有可行偏好/目标共享时行动，当各可能均可行但无共享动作时澄清，当请求不可行时提出最小成本许可的约束修复。构建基于求解器的基准，涵盖对象分配、会议调度、公寓选择、稳定匹配四类任务；设计匹配对（同源但改变干预必要性），评估指标分离决策正确性、匹配对可靠性与完全正确响应。
AI.result: 模型普遍难以识别"无需干预"的情形：即便需要的是行动，仍倾向于澄清或修复；正确的决策标签也不保证产出可用的动作、问题或修复。响应要求不仅影响决策的表达方式，还改变所做出的决策本身——显式要求所需内容能显著提升完全正确率，甚至改变干预决策（即便输出已可解析）。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的能动性不仅是识别不确定性，更需在必要时才干预，并将选定步骤转化为可验证的响应。

title: Post-Training Frontier Text-to-Image Models by Composing Preference and Rubric Rewards
summary: Recent text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable visual quality, but improving them through post-training remains challenging because no single reward signal captures the full range of human preference. In this work, we develop a simple and effective post-training recipe for open-domain text-to-image generation based on the composition of complementary reward signals. Our reward system consists of two main components: a preference reward, trained on large-scale human preference data using a Bradley-Terry objective to capture overall human aesthetic and perceptual preferences, and rubric-based rewards, which explicitly evaluate prompt faithfulness and other desirable properties while providing safeguards against reward hacking. A key challenge is how to combine these heterogeneous reward signals. We show that a naive weighted average leads to suboptimal optimization behavior, and propose a simple reward composition strategy that more effectively balances preference optimization with rubric satisfaction. In the Arena text-to-image leaderboard (https://arena.ai/), our RL-trained Flux2dev achieves an Elo rating 69 points above the base model, and our post-trained Ideogram-4 surpasses every open-source model on the leaderboard, reaching an Elo of 1223.5. (Claims of state-of-the-art performance are based on the Arena leaderboard snapshot as of September 4, 2026.) Our results suggest that effective rewards for frontier generative-model training require broad coverage of user intent and robustness to exploitation under optimization. To support reproducible research, we release Arena-T2I-Training, a 1K subset of training data that recovers some gains of full-scale training, providing a resource that we hope will facilitate future work on post-training for text-to-image models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种组合互补奖励信号的文生图后训练方法，在Arena榜单上显著提升模型Elo。
AI.motivation: 单一奖励信号无法全面捕捉人类偏好，现有文生图模型后训练效果受限。
AI.method: 组合两类奖励：(1)基于Bradley-Terry在大规模人类偏好数据上训练的偏好奖励；(2)评估提示词忠实度等属性的规则化奖励，用于防止奖励黑客。并提出避免简单加权平均的奖励组合策略。
AI.result: RL训练的Flux2dev在Arena榜单上比基座模型高69点；后训练的Ideogram-4达到Elo 1223.5，超越所有开源模型（2026年9月4日快照）。
AI.conclusion: 有效的前沿生成模型奖励需广泛覆盖用户意图并对优化中的投机利用具有鲁棒性。发布Arena-T2I-Training（1K训练子集）以支持可复现研究。

title: Geometry-Aware Time Reparameterization for Flow-Map Distillation
summary: Flow-map distillation enables one- and few-step generation by learning finite-time transitions of a pretrained generative ODE. We investigate whether changing the teacher's time parameterization can make these transitions easier to learn. Motivated by the hypothesis that trajectory segments with large normal acceleration are harder to distill, we propose a geometry-aware time reparameterization that allocates more student time to these regions while preserving the teacher's geometric paths and terminal distribution. We derive a shared clock that equalizes a population normal-acceleration statistic under suitable assumptions, and construct a practical approximation from robust, regularized estimates across teacher trajectories. We incorporate this clock into Lagrangian flow-map distillation, using the transformed time coordinate to condition the student. The clock is estimated once before distillation and requires neither teacher retraining nor additional student parameters or inference-time network evaluations. Experiments on synthetic data, CIFAR-10, and CelebA-64 show improved sample quality over identity-time distillation at matched inference budgets, including improvements in one- and two-step image generation. The gains in one-step generation, where no intermediate sampling times can be adjusted, highlight the benefits of time reparameterization during distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出几何感知时间重参数化方法，让流图蒸馏在法向加速度大的轨迹区域分配更多学生时间，提升一/少步生成质量。
AI.motivation: 流图蒸馏通过预训练生成ODE的有限时间转移实现少步生成；假设轨迹段法向加速度大时更难蒸馏，因此希望通过改变教师时间参数化，使这些区域更易学习，同时保留几何路径与终端分布。
AI.method: 推导基于总体法向加速度统计的共享时钟以均衡难学区域，并从教师轨迹的鲁棒正则化估计构建实用近似；将该时钟融入Lagrangian流图蒸馏，用变换后的时间坐标条件化学生；时钟仅蒸馏前估计一次，无需重训教师、额外学生参数或推理时网络评估。
AI.result: 在合成数据、CIFAR-10和CelebA-64上，匹配推理预算下样本质量优于恒等时间蒸馏，包括一/两步图像生成提升；一步生成（无法调整中间采样时间）的增益凸显时间重参数化价值。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知时间重参数化能有效改善流图蒸馏效果，尤其在一/少步生成场景，且几乎不增加成本。

title: A GHOST in Long-Horizon Agents: Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns
summary: Long-horizon agents are now playing an increasingly significant role in assisting humans with complex problem-solving. However, it is exactly their extended interaction history that introduces an underexplored execution-safety concern. Under benign interaction conditions, an agent may execute an action that violates a safety constraint specified many turns earlier. We term this failure mode Governance Hazard from Overlooked Safety Constraints across Turns (GHOST), which may cause irreversible damage. Our experiments reveal that GHOST events are not isolated cases: this failure mode, occurring precisely under benign interaction conditions, yields an occurrence rate of 11.5% on GPT-5.5. Furthermore, we theoretically show that if the residual conditional violation hazard along each safe prefix is bounded below by a non-summable sequence, the execution enters the hazard region almost surely. Leveraging this theoretical insight, we further propose STAR-Guard, a two-layer defense coupling historical semantic safety constraint restoration with pre-execution audit. STAR-Guard restores applicable safety constraints to reduce unsafe proposals, while its deterministic audit layer prevents residual violations from reaching the environment. Consistent with this two-layer design, we observe no GHOST events in our experiments under the GPT-5.5 setup.

AI.tldr: 长时程智能体在良性交互下可能违反多轮之前设定的安全约束（GHOST），GPT-5.5出现率11.5%。理论证明残余违反风险若不可求和则几乎必然进入危险区；提出STAR-Guard两层防御，实验消除了GHOST事件。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体用于复杂问题求解，但其漫长交互历史带来被忽视的执行安全问题：智能体可能执行许多轮之前所指定安全约束相违背的动作，造成不可逆伤害，且该失效在良性交互条件下即会发生，此前研究不足。
AI.method: 提出GHOST失效模式并测量其发生率；理论上分析：若每个安全前缀上的残余条件违反风险下界为一个不可求和序列，则执行几乎必然进入危险区域。据此设计STAR-Guard两层防御：第一层用历史语义恢复适用的安全约束以减少不安全提议，第二层确定性预执行审计阻止残余违反触达环境。
AI.result: GHOST在良性交互下发生率达11.5%（GPT-5.5）；理论上证明了在不可求和风险下界下几乎必然进入危险区域；在GPT-5.5设置下使用STAR-Guard未观察到GHOST事件。
AI.conclusion: 长时程智能体的跨轮安全约束违反是被低估的执行安全风险，且可用理论刻画；结合约束恢复与确定性预执行审计的两层防御可有效消除该风险。

title: Emergent Structure in the Marginal Attention Space of Language Models
summary: While representation similarity across independently trained language models is well-documented, how internal mechanics such as attention behave across models remains far less characterized. Inspired by this gap, we examine the structure of post-softmax attention weights by marginalizing over query positions, mapping them into a joint token-head "marginal attention space". Evaluating across 60+ diverse LLMs, we find that different properties emerge when reducing this space along its token and head axes. When reduced token-wise, marginal attention yields a text-intrinsic signal robustly conserved across models. To explain this property, we empirically connect marginal attention to the input-output Jacobian of the network, and prove theoretically that under a smoothness assumption, models with similar next-token distributions are guaranteed to have similar input-output Jacobian statistics. When reduced head-wise, it forms a model-private signature conserved across documents. Practically, this provides a natural way to estimate a per-head budget for key-value (KV) cache eviction, effectively decoupling model-specific budget allocation from text-intrinsic token scoring. On standard eviction benchmarks, a per-head budget precomputed offline on pretraining text, combined with a training-free token score, shows competitive performance with methods that recompute the budget on every document or train it per target. Code available at https://github.com/Flegyas/marginal-attention

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM内部注意力机制跨模型的结构规律，通过对post-softmax注意力在query位置边缘化得到"边缘注意力空间"，发现token维度上具有跨模型稳健的文本内在信号，head维度上则是模型私有签名，并据此提出无需训练的每头KV cache预算方法。
AI.motivation: 模型间表示相似性已被广泛记录，但注意力等内部机制跨模型的行为特征仍鲜有刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对post-softmax注意力权重在query位置边缘化，映射到token-head联合"边缘注意力空间"，在60+个LLM上分别沿token轴和head轴降维分析；并将边缘注意力与网络输入-输出Jacobian经验关联，辅以理论证明。
AI.result: token维度降维得到跨模型稳健守恒的文本内在信号；head维度降维形成跨文档守恒的模型私有签名。基于此的每头KV cache驱逐预算，离线在预训练文本上预计算并结合免训练token打分，在标准基准上与需逐文档重算或逐目标训练的方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 边缘注意力揭示了注意力跨模型的文本内在性与模型私有性二元结构，并为KV cache驱逐提供自然的预算分配方式，将模型特定的预算分配与文本内在的token打分解耦。

title: Rethinking Fixed Temporal Grids: Frequency-Disentangled Motion Generation
summary: Most human motion generation methods encode motion as tokens on a uniform temporal grid, where every token spans the same fixed time window. Human motion, however, is temporally heterogeneous: slowly evolving global trajectories coexist with rapid transient events such as foot contacts and joint impulses. Forcing such multi-scale dynamics onto tokens of identical temporal resolution entangles motion frequencies, leaving slow regions redundant while smoothing out the rapid details that distinguish realistic motion. We propose \textbf{FreqMo}, a scale-adaptive motion representation that decomposes motion into wavelet frequency bands, separating dynamics across temporal scales while preserving temporal localization and exact reconstruction. Unified Frequency Residual Quantization (UFRQ) then encodes all bands within a single shared codebook, compressing the token sequence threefold and enabling stable single-stage generation. Experiments show FreqMo attains SOTA fidelity with substantially improved high-frequency preservation, and the same decomposition transfers to continuous diffusion backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出FreqMo，用多尺度小波频带分解替代均匀时间网格表示人体运动，实现三倍压缩并提升高频细节保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有人体运动生成方法将运动编码为均匀时间网格上的token，每个token覆盖固定时间窗。但人体运动时间上是异质的：缓慢演化的全局轨迹与脚部接触、关节冲击等快速瞬态事件共存。统一时间分辨率会纠缠运动频率，导致慢速区域冗余、快速细节被平滑。
AI.method: FreqMo将运动分解为小波频带，跨时间尺度分离动态，同时保持时间定位与精确重建；统一频率残差量化（UFRQ）在单一共享码本中编码所有频带，压缩token序列三倍并支持稳定的单阶段生成。
AI.result: 实验表明FreqMo达到SOTA保真度，高频保留显著改善，且该分解可迁移到连续扩散骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: 尺度自适应的小波频带运动表示优于均匀网格token化，为高质量运动生成提供高效通用方案。

title: CRISP: A Framework for Clause-Reconstructed Interpretable NeuroSymbolic Propositions
comment: Preprint for an accepted paper at International Symposium of the Tsetlin Machine (ISTM) 2026 Conference
summary: Deep neural networks achieve high accuracy through layered numerical transformations, yet their decisions remain difficult to audit because decision evidence is encoded in hidden activations rather than explicit rules. This paper introduces CRISP, a framework that reconstructs the last-layer activation vector (LLAV) of binary neural teachers as Tsetlin Machine (TM) clauses. CRISP sign-binarizes the teacher's penultimate pre-logit activations, and assigns one Individual TM (ITM) to each LLAV neuron. Each reconstructed hidden bit is represented by propositional clauses over Booleanized input features, which gives a direct symbolic trace from named input thresholds to a named teacher neuron. CRISP is evaluated on MNIST, KMNIST, FashionMNIST (FMNIST), SVHN, and CIFAR10 using a BinaryConnect convolutional neural network (BCCNN) teacher and a fully binary neural network (BNN) teacher, with an additional study on binary thresholding, thermometer encoding, and quartile binning at multiple bit depths. The results show that LLAV sign-binarization does not reduce teacher-head accuracy in the tested BNN setting, while ITM reconstruction error is the main limiting factor. Quartile one-bit Booleanization gives the strongest reconstruction fidelity on SVHN at 87.52% test fidelity and is competitive on CIFAR10, and the reconstructed LLAV preserves 78.41% teacher-head accuracy on FMNIST.
